episodes.title: Ep 1: Scroobius Pip
episodes.summary: Scroobius Pip's fast-food-heavy dream meal runs from Pizza Hut cheesy garlic bread and his self-invented 'Meadsy base' stuffed pizza to Camden Market halloumi fries, a gin-and-Pepsi-Max 'Scroobius 2018' and three scoops of Ben & Jerry's.

recommendations.item: Tap water
recommendations.reason: He wants plain tap water so nothing interferes with the flavours of the food, with a dose of 'Essex cheapness'.
recommendations.quote: there's an element of Essex cheapness that I'm like well still and tap are the same thing just at a different price
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with extra mango chutney
recommendations.reason: He picks poppadoms over bread, but only likes the mango chutney dip so wants four pots of it.
recommendations.quote: the only dip of the Poppadoms I like is the Mango Chutney, so don't worry with the rest of them, just bring more Mango Chutney
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Garlic bread with cheese (mixed four-cheese version), in the box
recommendations.reason: He calls Pizza Hut's cheesy garlic bread slices the best starter ever; he used to work in a Pizza Hut kitchen and prefers the old mixed-cheese version.
recommendations.quote: what is the best starter ever, and it's the reason I went for Poppadoms rather than bread because I'm going for garlic bread with cheese
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: 'Meadsy base' ham pizza (cheese-stuffed base and crust)
recommendations.reason: A pizza he invented while working at Pizza Hut as a teenager: cheese sandwiched between two thin bases with a stuffed crust, topped simply with ham.
recommendations.quote: in Pizza Hut I was still known as David Meads. And there, I invented the 'Meadsy base'.
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Halloumi fries (hold the pomegranate)
recommendations.reason: Deep-fried halloumi fries from a KERB street-food stall at Camden Market, served with mint sauce and pomegranate (which he leaves off).
recommendations.quote: It's from Camden Market, is it Off The Kerb? Or something... they do these haloumi fries that have got pomegranates sprinkled on and some mint sauce
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: 'Scroobius 2018': Slingsby Rhubarb Gin and Pepsi Max, double, poured flat over ice
recommendations.reason: His own signature cocktail from his podcast, upgraded with rhubarb gin; even a sceptical friend admitted it was tasty.
recommendations.quote: I'll go for a Scroobius 2018, Slingsby Rhubarb Gin and Pepsi Max. A good serving of ice, please, sir.
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Three scoops of Ben & Jerry's: chocolate fudge brownie, peanut butter cup, then a cookie flavour
recommendations.reason: He orders the same three scoops in a precise order at the cinema, building it like a sundae; ice cream is the one thing he'd keep.
recommendations.quote: I want Ben and Jerry's, but I have a specific 3 scoops from the scoop station
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Butter chicken
recommendations.reason: His first ever curry, aged 20-something; its spicy butter chicken was the best curry he's had and nothing since has matched it. The restaurant has since closed.
recommendations.quote: there was a place near me called Bombay Nights... it was the best curry I've ever had
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Baconator and Baconator fries
recommendations.reason: His 'honourable munch-ion': he rates Wendy's above In-N-Out and always goes when in America.
recommendations.quote: I've had In N Out burger over there, all these ones that people hype, I think Wendy's is the best.
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Cookie cupcakes
recommendations.reason: His runner-up dessert: cookie cupcakes loaded with chocolate fondant-style icing.
recommendations.quote: You see my second choice on the desserts was Millie's Cookies do cookie cupcakes.
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

recommendations.item: Frozen yoghurt
recommendations.reason: His LA treat after Wendy's; James likens it to build-your-own Ben & Jerry's.
recommendations.quote: It was that and Pinkberry for a while.
recommendations.speaker: Scroobius Pip

episodes.title: Ep 2: Grace Dent
episodes.summary: Grace Dent's dream menu mixes London fine dining (Trullo's beef shin ragu, a religieuse with jasmine tea at Hide) with northern comfort: chips and curry sauce from a Carlisle chippy, plus Little Owl's green beans and a piña colada.

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with raita, mango chutney, mint sauce and onion on a spinning pickle tray
recommendations.reason: She avoids filling up on restaurant bread and loves the very British ritual of poppadoms and dips arriving on a little silver stand.
recommendations.quote: I think that there's something about that whole ritual of poppadoms coming and everybody getting one, and crunching them, and spooning things.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Glass of Taittinger champagne (aperitif)
recommendations.reason: Her usual first drink when out; her favourite widely available champagne, which takes the edge off the day.
recommendations.quote: No, I like a glass of Taittinger and, yes, that always just takes the edge off the day.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Beef shin ragù with fresh tagliatelle
recommendations.reason: A slow-stewed, rich dish she and her friends always ordered, so good some friends had it for starter and main; she misses it now she is almost vegan.
recommendations.quote: it's the beef shin ragù with probably, it's like freshly made tagliatelle, and it's at a restaurant called Trullo in Islington.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Chips and curry sauce
recommendations.reason: Northern comfort food; she ate them walking home in sleet from a bad festival night and found them the nicest thing in a world of fussy fine dining. From an unnamed, now-closed Currock chip shop.
recommendations.quote: There's a chip shop in Currock in Carlisle, where I'm from, and it's gone now, but it had really, really good chips
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Green beans with nuts in a soy honey glaze
recommendations.location: West Village, Manhattan, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: Eaten on a birthday, it changed how she thought about vegetables and showed her sides could get as much love as the main.
recommendations.quote: I remember it really made me rethink how we do vegetables in this country.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Piña colada
recommendations.reason: She dislikes bitter cocktails; a piña colada is sweet, comforting and uncool, and makes everyone at the table relax and have a good time.
recommendations.quote: When it's a hot day, and you're somewhere, and everyone has a piña colada, it is impossible not to have a good time.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Religieuse with duck-egg-blue icing and chilled jasmine tea
recommendations.reason: A beautiful work-of-art pastry at a lavish new opening, but the chilled jasmine tea served with it was the headline - the greatest thing she had tasted.
recommendations.quote: the jasmine tea was the greatest thing, I think, that I've tasted.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Salmon poke bowl
recommendations.reason: James's nicest meal of the week: raw salmon poke with crispy onions, rice and lots of guacamole.
recommendations.quote: the nicest thing I've had to eat this week, I went to Bone Daddies and I had the poke bowl there, the salmon poke.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: On-the-bone ribeye steak and desserts
recommendations.reason: Ed and James shared a massive ribeye there after their flight was delayed and ordered every pudding; James swore at the chocolate mint icebox cake because it was so good.
recommendations.quote: we'll say the last meat that I ate was I shared a massive steak with James in a restaurant called the Dutch in Soho in New York.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Nostalgic tasting menu
recommendations.reason: Grace praises Simon Rogan's cooking for evoking childhood flavours like a Fox's Glacier Mint at her grandma's.
recommendations.quote: There's a place in London called Fera, a chef called Simon Rogan. He's got Michelin stars.
recommendations.speaker: Grace Dent

recommendations.item: Lunch tasting menu
recommendations.reason: One of Ed's favourite eating experiences, a lunch with other comics while gigging in Ulverston.
recommendations.quote: I was going to mention L'Enclume, which is one of my favourite eating experiences.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 3: Richard Osman
episodes.summary: Richard Osman picks tap water, warm bread with salted butter, Cora Pearl's toasted ham and cheese sandwiches, his grandmother's 1970s two-meat Christmas dinner, Berners Tavern's oxtail mac and cheese, a Mint Viennetta and Coke Zero.

recommendations.item: Tap water
recommendations.reason: He would normally order tap water for environmental reasons, then compensate by ordering a pricier main so he doesn't look cheap.
recommendations.quote: So, tap water, but then I'd order a more expensive main course than I previously would've done.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Warm bread with soft salted butter
recommendations.reason: He loves warm bread at the start of a meal, as long as the butter is salted and soft enough to spread.
recommendations.quote: I like it when you go to a posh restaurant and they do, like, bread when it's warm.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Toasted ham and cheese finger sandwiches
recommendations.reason: He thinks a toasted ham and cheese sandwich is close to the best food in the world, and Cora Pearl finally served one as a starter.
recommendations.quote: at Cora Pearl they bring you out this, sort of, artisan-, you've got three finger sandwiches of-, it's a toasted ham and cheese sandwich... It's unbelievable.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Late-1970s/early-80s Christmas dinner with turkey and beef, roast potatoes, no veg
recommendations.reason: His grandmother's Christmas dinners from his childhood, always with two meats, eaten with the family he loves.
recommendations.quote: Yes, of course because it was Christmas and you're with your family and you're with people you love.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Mac and cheese with oxtail
recommendations.reason: A rich mac and cheese topped with oxtail, so big he guarantees nobody can finish it.
recommendations.quote: they do a mac cheese which is the greatest mac cheese in the history of the world.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Mint Viennetta
recommendations.reason: He loves mint choc chip and thinks a mint Viennetta is the definitive pudding; he could eat a whole one.
recommendations.quote: Mint Vienetta. I don't see anything beating it.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Coke Zero
recommendations.reason: He doesn't really like alcohol; his first choice is diet cola, specifically Coke Zero because it feels slightly more 'boysy'.
recommendations.quote: My first choice would be Diet Coke. Isn't that awful?
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Sweets from around the world, sour sweets, dark chocolate Snickers
recommendations.reason: He praises the sweet shop near the studio for its international sweets and dozens of chocolate bar variants.
recommendations.quote: that's the thing about Kingdom of Sweets they do dark chocolate versions of virtually everything
recommendations.speaker: Richard Osman

recommendations.item: Fries dipped in a vanilla milkshake
recommendations.reason: James recommends dipping In-N-Out's fries in their vanilla milkshake.
recommendations.quote: I've recently started dipping fries into milkshakes. Very nice.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 4: Nish Kumar (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Nish Kumar's Christmas menu is full of family cooking: his gran's poppadoms, lamb kebabs from a shack behind a Leicester pub, his cousin's goose and Coke ham with goose-fat roasties, Malbec, and the peach cobbler from Jackson & Rye.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He finds sparkling water pointless; he only enjoys it from a sparkling tap, which he sees as low-level witchcraft.
recommendations.quote: Because I don't feel the need to enhance the taste of water with the sensation of burps.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Homemade fried poppadoms (the puffy, air-pocketed kind)
recommendations.reason: When he was a child his gran would fry about twenty greasy, puffy poppadoms and leave them on a plate in the middle of the room.
recommendations.quote: as they get fried they fill up with pockets of air, so it's like, it's fluffy and crispy.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Lamb seekh kebabs with tomato and mint chutney
recommendations.venue: The Owl and Pussycat (kebab shack behind the pub)
recommendations.reason: A Pakistani cook ran a kebab shack behind a pub near his grandparents' house, and eating his kebabs marked the start of the family Christmas holiday.
recommendations.quote: they used to have a, like, little shack out the back of The Owl and Pussycat where this Pakistani bloke used to cook kebabs
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Slow-roast Christmas goose and Coke-soaked ham (with pancetta sprouts and pigs in blankets)
recommendations.reason: His cousin cooks a goose for hours plus Nigella-style Coke ham, which turned Nish into a goose convert.
recommendations.quote: I'm here to tell you, I'm a goose convert. Christmas goose, absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Roast potatoes cooked in goose fat
recommendations.reason: His cousin cooks the roast potatoes in goose fat so they come out crunchy.
recommendations.quote: He makes excellent roasties
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Glass of Malbec (Prosecco before, strong coffee after)
recommendations.reason: He drinks red wine with Christmas dinner and a strong coffee afterwards so he stays awake for family chats.
recommendations.quote: I will be drinking a glass of Malbec with my dinner.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Peach cobbler with vanilla custard
recommendations.reason: His favourite dessert, eaten on New Year's Eve; he stopped going when they took it off the menu and campaigns to 'bring back Kumar's cobbler'.
recommendations.quote: I had a peach cobbler at a place called Jackson and Rye... it's my favourite dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: High-end Indian food
recommendations.reason: Nish credits it with finally getting high-end Indian food right.
recommendations.quote: there are a couple of restaurants in London, Gymkhana and Trishna, that have really nailed high-end-
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: High-end Indian food
recommendations.reason: Nish credits it, along with Gymkhana, with nailing high-end Indian food.
recommendations.quote: there are a couple of restaurants in London, Gymkhana and Trishna, that have really nailed high-end-
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Hometown curry house
recommendations.reason: James's beloved local curry house from his hometown, where he discovered his favourite dishes.
recommendations.quote: The Raj in Kettering is one of my favourite Indian restaurants, I love it so much.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Indian delivery
recommendations.reason: Ed's childhood Indian delivery: a curry house that is literally a house on a residential road.
recommendations.quote: we'd always get it from the House of Spice, absolutely delicious
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Kebabs and street food eaten off a car bonnet
recommendations.reason: A famous shack behind the Taj hotel that a disgruntled chef started; you eat off your car bonnet and the food is insane.
recommendations.quote: it became the hottest restaurant in Mumbai... And the food is insane, it is absolutely insane.
recommendations.speaker: Nish Kumar

recommendations.item: Beef brisket sandwich with red cabbage slaw and pickles
recommendations.reason: James had the best brisket sandwich of his life there; the place has since shut but put the recipe online.
recommendations.quote: There's a place called Honey Trap in New Zealand in Auckland and they did the best beef brisket sandwich I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 5: Aisling Bea
episodes.summary: Aisling Bea orders still tap water, sourdough with Kerrygold, salt and pepper calamari with aioli, a post-vomiting lobster at Burger & Lobster in Soho, homemade mash, a 'Love Me Good' rye cocktail from a New York speakeasy, and her neighbours' hazelnut and pecan tart.

recommendations.item: Still tap water (BRITA-filtered)
recommendations.reason: She always takes still tap water and is proud of the BRITA filter tap she bought for her London kitchen with panel-show money.
recommendations.quote: Still always please James. I like a water that runs deep.
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Sourdough with Kerrygold Irish butter
recommendations.reason: She loves bread and wants it slathered in real Kerrygold butter, which makes her feel connected to Ireland.
recommendations.quote: I would love some sourdough. And loads of real butter. I don't want olive oil. I want real Kerrygold Irish butter
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Salt and pepper calamari with aioli and a squeeze of lemon
recommendations.reason: Not from one place: she orders battered calamari wherever she goes for the rubbery squid and crunchy breadcrumbs, but no chilli.
recommendations.quote: there's something about the rubberiness of a squid with the breadcrumbiness of-, crunchy, crunchy bread and just a big bowl of them with a dip
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Lobster with chips
recommendations.reason: Her first ever lobster, eaten in a bib with Dara O'Briain, Ardal O'Hanlon and Barry Murphy after a St Patrick's Day gig she did while hungover and being sick.
recommendations.quote: to go to a restaurant when you're that empty of food, and be given a bib and a little stick to get the buttery fish out of the lobster tail
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Creamy mashed potato with Kerrygold (floury Queens potatoes)
recommendations.reason: She makes good mash herself with floury Irish Queens potatoes, Kerrygold, milk, salt and pepper, even though it doubles up with the chips.
recommendations.quote: Is it from anywhere in particular? / My own hand.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster / Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: 'Love Me Good' cocktail (rye, vermouth, cherry liqueur)
recommendations.reason: A boozy, dessert-like rye cocktail from a New York speakeasy whose name she couldn't remember; it made her feel very grown-up.
recommendations.quote: it tasted desserty and whisky-ish, and I love, love whisky. It just covered my tongue in yumminess and I just felt so adult drinking it in this speak easy in New York.
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Hazelnut mousse tart with glazed roasted pecans
recommendations.reason: Made by her new English neighbours when she was about eleven; it was her first taste of pecans and hazelnuts and seemed impossibly posh.
recommendations.quote: she had made a cake, like a tart rather, with a hazelnut mousse, bits of hazelnut thrown into the mousse, then set it and put roasted pecans on top
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Calamari
recommendations.reason: James loves the signature Thai calamari at Busaba Eathai and would put it in his dream banquet.
recommendations.quote: I like the calamari in chain restaurant Busaba... that calamari's so good that it's got its own special little box on the menu that says that it's their signature.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Young coconut 'calamari'
recommendations.reason: Aisling says the earnest LA vegan restaurant's food is delicious, especially its deep-fried young coconut calamari substitute.
recommendations.quote: in this place, they did young coconut, which is a calamari substitute. And it was so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Aisling Bea

recommendations.item: Lobster roll
recommendations.reason: James loves the lobster roll and would have it in his dream banquet.
recommendations.quote: I'd also have the lobster roll from Burger & Lobster at my banquet.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 88: Mae Martin
episodes.summary: Mae Martin's hungover dream meal is mountain-stream water, baguette with churned butter, a 'cornucopia of shrimp' inspired by a Sydney yacht trip, roast lamb with horseradish and cauliflower cheese, lobster mac and cheese, a Jameson whiskey soda and Canadian pumpkin pie.

recommendations.item: Ice-cold still water straight from a mountain stream, diverted into the restaurant
recommendations.reason: She loved drinking ice-cold water straight from a rushing mountain stream in France and wants that freshness on tap.
recommendations.quote: My friend drove to France one time and we went in a mountain stream and drank like, it was just bursting out of the mountain. It was ice cold, it was clear, that's what I want really.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: Warm toasted crusty baguette with freshly churned butter
recommendations.reason: Chose bread over poppadoms because of butter on a warm crusty baguette; she'd like to churn the butter herself, as on a childhood school trip.
recommendations.quote: I really thought bread, only because of the butter and like a toasted baguette. There is few things nicer than that.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: 'Cornucopia of shrimp': shrimp tempura, shrimp dumplings and fresh jumbo prawns with watermelon and lime
recommendations.reason: Her own invention, inspired by huge fresh prawns with watermelon and lime served on a heckler's yacht in Sydney during a tour with James Acaster.
recommendations.quote: It's called a cornucopia of shrimp but it's inspired by, actually a lot of my best culinary experiences weirdly James were on that like one day in Sydney
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: Roast lamb with good gravy, horseradish, rosemary roast potatoes and cauliflower cheese (plus roasted broccoli)
recommendations.reason: A classic roast eaten hungover, with horseradish instead of mint sauce; the cauliflower cheese recalls her dad's cheap 90s version at home, inspired too by Steen Raskopoulos's slow-cooked Greek lamb.
recommendations.quote: I just kept coming back to that I want a lamb roast with really good gravy and I want horseradish instead of mint sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: Lobster mac and cheese
recommendations.reason: Big chunks of lobster and black pepper; rich, so just a couple of spoonfuls served in a little pot.
recommendations.quote: Big chunks of lobster, lots of black pepper on top, yeah cos it's rich, you don't want a whole thing, you want a couple of big spoonfuls I think.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: Whiskey soda (Jameson, soda water and fresh lime)
recommendations.reason: Her go-to drink since about 20, adopted because Jude Law drinks them in The Talented Mr Ripley.
recommendations.quote: I'm going with a classic whiskey soda. So, a shot of Jameson, I know I was down on soda water before but soda water and fresh lime. Very refreshing.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

recommendations.item: Pumpkin pie with freshly whipped cream
recommendations.reason: Switched from cheap white birthday cake to the Canadian Thanksgiving classic, with nutmeg, cinnamon and condensed milk.
recommendations.quote: It's a Canadian classic, yeah, pumpkin pie... a good pumpkin pie, nutmeg, cinammon, pumpkin mix with whipped cream, like freshly whipped.
recommendations.speaker: Mae Martin

episodes.title: Ep 92: Sue Perkins
episodes.summary: Sue Perkins chose still water, karate-chopped poppadoms with mango chutney, crispy duck pancakes, a Southern Indian (beetroot) curry with masala dosa, bison grass vodka plus a cup of tea, and Christmas pudding every which way.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She has never liked sparkling water and believes an internet claim that it leaches calcium from your bones.
recommendations.quote: I'm not an animal so it's gonna be still, I mean please.
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney (and a poppadom cheese sandwich)
recommendations.reason: A poppadom is one giant crisp to karate chop at the table; she also loves leftover poppadoms reheated as a cheddar 'sandwich'.
recommendations.quote: popadoms are a giant, one giant crisp right? Who's not going to want to begin a meal with a giant crisp.
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Crispy duck pancakes on a lazy susan
recommendations.reason: Her first taste of 'interesting food' at 19, at an unnamed Chinese restaurant with her friend Nick's family, with her first lazy susan.
recommendations.quote: it reminds me of the first time I ate interesting food, which was when I was 19, and I was taken to a Chinese restaurant
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Southern Indian curry (beetroot curry) with curry leaves and coconut
recommendations.reason: She cooks curry about five times a week, including in her camper van, which has a cupboard of nothing but Indian spices.
recommendations.quote: My favourite, which is what I'd plump for, would be Southern Indian. Loads of curry leaves, coconut
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Masala dosa
recommendations.reason: She loves food wrapped in a comforting pancake; she makes dosas herself with fermented batter, potato, onion, mustard seeds and curry leaves.
recommendations.quote: it's stuff wrapped in a big you know comforting mitt of kind of pancake style stuff
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Zubrowka bison grass vodka
recommendations.reason: Her favourite spirit; she picks it even though it doesn't match the food, in the spirit of a friend who eats whatever arrives.
recommendations.quote: bison grass, preferably Zubrowka but any bison grass vodka would be very very
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Cup of tea with skimmed milk and honey
recommendations.reason: She has a cup of tea with every meal, so has it alongside the vodka.
recommendations.quote: normally I have tea with skimmed milk and a bit of honey and I'm gonna stick to that
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Christmas pudding with brandy, custard, ice cream and caramel
recommendations.reason: She loves a hot, filthy steamed pudding and makes Christmas pudding for herself even though nobody in her family likes it.
recommendations.quote: I love Christmas pudding and no one in my family likes it
recommendations.speaker: Sue Perkins

recommendations.item: Vegan burger (recipe box)
recommendations.reason: Ed praises the Honest Burgers vegan burger he had at one of their restaurants, after producer Benito was sent a recipe box.
recommendations.quote: I've had the Honest burger vegan burger at one of the restaurants before, back when they were a thing, and it was delicious
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 93: Jessica Fostekew
episodes.summary: Jessica Fostekew picks a seafood 'Benito box' starter, chef Ian Simpson's surf and turf from the Swanage hotel she worked at as a teenager, sag aloo from Babur in Brockley, Dom Perignon and her mum's lemon meringue roulade.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water ('jaggy water')
recommendations.reason: Her favourite water, which feels like a treat since she avoids plastic bottles day to day.
recommendations.quote: I love fizzy water the most of all the waters but it's one of those things I feel like I have to earn.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips, including some bendy next-day 'flopadoms'
recommendations.reason: She loves poppadoms for the dips and secretly enjoys them stale and bendy the next day.
recommendations.quote: I am gonna go popadoms over bread because, purely for the love of the dips. For the love of dips.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Seafood trio: just-caught calamari, a big Scottish oyster with Tabasco and lemon, and barbecued octopus with chilli and garlic
recommendations.reason: A seafood-sharing-platter style 'Benito box'; the calamari recalls squid she watched landed fresh on a Greek quay.
recommendations.quote: I had it in Greece once and I watched the ship, like ship, this tiny little boat come in and the squid's come off it
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Surf and turf (fillet steak with garlic butter and shell-on prawns) by chef Ian Simpson
recommendations.reason: She worked there as a teenage chambermaid and waitress, then saved up to eat there and the surf and turf blew her mind.
recommendations.quote: I ordered this surf and turf and it blew my mind... I just had no idea that prawns or steak could taste like that. It was life changing.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Sag aloo
recommendations.reason: A high-end but reasonable Indian restaurant whose sag dishes and soft paneer amazed her.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to say Babur in Brockley. It's like a, a sort of very high-end Indian restaurant but it's still super reasonable.
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Triple fried chips
recommendations.venue: End of the Road Festival chip stall
recommendations.location: End of the Road Festival, Larmer Tree Gardens, Dorset/Wiltshire, UK
recommendations.reason: Best chips she has ever had, eaten after recovering from post-Edinburgh gastric flu; considered as her side.
recommendations.quote: triple fried chips from a really specific stall at End of the Road Festival, cos once, they're the best chips I've ever had
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Fried octopus with chilli, garlic and salt
recommendations.reason: Ed praises its fried octopus as phenomenal.
recommendations.quote: at Dumplings Legend in Chinatown they do a fried, just a fried octopus with chilli and salt... And it is phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Dom Perignon champagne (ideally a 1983 vintage)
recommendations.reason: Her dad worked for Moet & Chandon and gave her a bottle from her birth year, which she drank when her son was born.
recommendations.quote: he got me a bottle from the year I was born 1983, and I drank it when my son was born. And it was like all, like biscuity and almost creamy
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue roulade (great auntie Penny's recipe)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's family recipe, so sharply lemony it tastes almost fizzy yet stays light and refreshing.
recommendations.quote: the lemony bit is like, so sharp, that it almost tastes fizzy like sherbert. But it's also really light
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

recommendations.item: Amaretto coffee
recommendations.reason: To finish with the dessert; she rediscovered it recently and wondered why she didn't have it more.
recommendations.quote: with it to come just as I'm finishing it, can I have like an amaretto coffee?
recommendations.speaker: Jessica Fostekew

episodes.title: Ep 94: Todd Barry
episodes.summary: Todd Barry's dream menu is a New York-flavoured carb feast: Via Carota's cacio e pepe, extra-hot Japanese chicken katsu curry, well-done fries, half-sweet iced tea and a vanilla cake with vanilla icing.

recommendations.item: Still water, cold, with crushed ice and a squeeze of lime
recommendations.reason: He wavered towards half-and-half but settled on cold still water with crushed ice.
recommendations.quote: Yeah, even ice, I'll take some ice. Squeeze of lime.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Poppadoms
recommendations.reason: After being baffled by the question he picked poppadoms for the crunch, while still praising warm bread with oil and balsamic.
recommendations.quote: Well let's go popadom... Yeah, crunchy.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe with a side of chilli flakes
recommendations.location: West Village, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: He loves simple food and cacio e pepe, just cheese and black pepper, is the ultimate; Via Carota does a really good one.
recommendations.quote: There's a place called Via Carota in the West Village that has a really good caci y pepe.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Japanese chicken katsu curry with rice, extra hot
recommendations.reason: He's been eating lots of Japanese curry lately, likes places with a 1-10 spice scale and orders it hot; no single venue chosen.
recommendations.quote: I like it when you can go to a place and there's a spice level... there's one place I go to on the Lower East Side where there's spice level one to ten.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Well-done crispy fries
recommendations.reason: He likes almost everything well done and wants very crunchy fries 'dancing on the line' of burnt, with a whisper of vinegar.
recommendations.quote: Not necessarily black but like teetering on the edge of, just really dancing on that line.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Iced tea, half sweet and half unsweetened, with lemons and a lime
recommendations.reason: A southern-style black iced tea is his treat instead of a second coffee; he also fondly recalls a peach iced tea during a Dallas pedicure.
recommendations.quote: Half unsweetened, half sweet, with a few lemons. Maybe even a lime.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Vanilla cake with vanilla icing
recommendations.reason: He considered lemon sorbet and tiramisu but went for a simple birthday-style vanilla cake.
recommendations.quote: I just said how about a nice piece of vanilla cake with vanilla icing.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Rigatoni with turkey sausage
recommendations.location: East Village, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: Todd's pasta recommendation near the recording studio, praising its rigatoni with turkey sausage.
recommendations.quote: It's called Lavagna, L-A-V-A-G-N-A... And they have a rigatoni with like turkey sausage in it that's, oh it's good.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe and crispy fried onions
recommendations.location: Great Jones Street, NoHo, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: He recommends it for its cacio e pepe and fried onion pieces that he almost picked as his starter.
recommendations.quote: There's a good restaurant called Vicks there that has a Caci y Pepe... That's on Great Jones Street.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Double-fried Belgian fries with dipping sauces
recommendations.reason: A fries-only restaurant doing double-fried Belgian fries with many dipping sauces.
recommendations.quote: Just fries. Belgian, yeah, with many dipping sauces, as you would imagine.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Fast food
recommendations.reason: One of his favourite fast food places, an all-night sit-down spot in the heartland.
recommendations.quote: There's one called steak and shake, that's one of my favourite fast food.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Coffee
recommendations.reason: Todd names it as a good London coffee shop and Ed agrees it's nice.
recommendations.quote: There's one called Kaffeine that I've been to that's... I like that one.
recommendations.speaker: Todd Barry

recommendations.item: Coffee
recommendations.venue: Department of Coffee and Social Affairs
recommendations.reason: Ed shouts out its really good coffee despite being annoyed by the name.
recommendations.quote: It's good coffee though so shout out.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Coconut yoghurt with cashews
recommendations.reason: Ed raved about its coconut yoghurt and James enjoyed a tuna poke bowl there.
recommendations.quote: It was from a place called Broken Coconut in New York which says it's healthy food but if that's healthy, oooh, I'll be going there every day.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Sweet potato fries topped with seafood chowder
recommendations.reason: James recommends its sweet potato fries with chowder dumped on top.
recommendations.quote: they've got these sweet potato fries that you just dump seafood chowder on top of and that's great.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Warm welcome cookie
recommendations.reason: All three enthuse about the warm check-in cookie; James once went back down for a second.
recommendations.quote: That cookie is, and it's so warm
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 95: Rosie Jones
episodes.summary: Rosie Jones builds a grazing feast on a rotating table: tap water, poppadoms, three hours of crisps, a full tapas spread, a posh pork-and-black-pudding scotch egg, an espresso martini and bowls of childhood sweets.

recommendations.item: Tap water
recommendations.reason: She distrusts restaurant water bills after once spending £40 on bottled water, and hates sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: Tap. Just give me a bit of tap water cos I don't trust you.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Warm poppadoms with mango chutney, raita and the red onion chutney
recommendations.reason: She always picks poppadoms over bread, loving the dips with a warm poppadom eaten quickly before it goes soggy.
recommendations.quote: I love all the dips and a warm poppadom.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Three hours of crisps and bar snacks (Twiglets, Pringles, Bacon Rashers, Nik Naks, Mini Cheddars, Space Raiders etc.) in separate bowls
recommendations.reason: She wants all her favourite snacks in one place on a rotating doughnut-shaped table she controls.
recommendations.quote: But it's more about the environment. I'm having all my favourite snacks in one place.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Tapas of every kind: patatas bravas, pan con tomate, chipirones, sardines, albondigas, chorizo, hams, Manchego, mushroom croquetas
recommendations.reason: She loves to graze, and her Spanish nanna could be put in the kitchen to cook everything.
recommendations.quote: my nanna is spanish. So you can just rope her in. Pop her in the kitchen and she'll cook everything.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Posh scotch egg with runny yolk, pork and black pudding filling, poppadom crumb
recommendations.reason: Something you don't get at a tapas restaurant: a posh scotch egg with a runny yolk and the crispiest outside.
recommendations.quote: We're talking, runny yolk, big sausage filling, maybe two types of meet in that sausage, and the nicesest, cripiest, crumbliest outside.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Espresso martini
recommendations.reason: A pep-up after seven hours at the table; she claims caffeine doesn't affect her.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to have a little pep up. I'm having an espresso martini.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Bowls of sweets: Moams, jelly babies, Dolly Mixtures, strawberry laces, Revels, chocolate buttons, white chocolate mice
recommendations.reason: Pick-and-mix style sweets that remind her of childhood, especially the white chocolate mice.
recommendations.quote: I do recognise that it is shit chocolate. I do get that, but thats why I like it. It's your childhood in a little mouse.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Jones

recommendations.item: Scotch egg and a pint of lager
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls the gastropub's famous scotch egg while waiting for a late friend as one of his happiest moments.
recommendations.quote: I had a big scotch egg and a pint of lager... I've never been happier than I was with that scotch egg and a pint of lager.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Tasting menu and cold brew coffee kombucha
recommendations.reason: James describes a very special meal there ending with a boozy cold brew kombucha he couldn't stop drinking.
recommendations.quote: It was a very, very special meal... cold brew coffee kombucha that had a bit of booze in it. And it was so good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Bagel box
recommendations.reason: The hosts loved the bagel and babka cook-at-home box sent by The Good Egg.
recommendations.quote: I really loved the bagel box from the good egg. Delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 96: Thanyia Moore
episodes.summary: Thanyia Moore's dinner-party menu features warm lemon water, poppadom sandwiches, ackee and saltfish in fried dumplings, a seafood boil, wings or salad, paired white wines and a cherry crumble with cherries made by her chef mum Joyce.

recommendations.item: Warm lemon water (two-thirds boiling, one-third cold, half a lemon)
recommendations.reason: She always starts a meal with warm lemon water to cleanse the palate before the flavours arrive.
recommendations.quote: So all lemon water to just like cleanse your mouth a bit. Get ready to taste some good, some good flavours.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Poppadom sandwich with onion salad and mango chutney
recommendations.reason: She breaks off poppadom pieces and sandwiches onion and mango chutney between them for extra crunch.
recommendations.quote: Pre meal, definitely poppadoms with the with the onion salad and mango chutney slash that into a sandwich, poppadom sandwich, you're good to go.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Ackee and saltfish in a fried dumpling
recommendations.reason: A Jamaican dish close to her heritage: a golden, fluffy fried dumpling topped with ackee, steamed saltfish, onions and peppers; she says her mum's Caribbean food beats any restaurant.
recommendations.quote: when you take it out, it's golden on the outside, but fluffy on the inside... And then you get the ackee and the saltfish.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Seafood boil with crab legs, king prawns, potatoes, corn and lashings of sauce (no sausage)
recommendations.reason: She loves the garlicky, peppery seafood boil sauce and keeps it fish-only to match the starter.
recommendations.quote: the sauce is the main thing because it's like fish seasoning with lots of garlic and peppers and onions cooked down
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Salad or honey-soy sticky chicken wings, depending on the guest
recommendations.reason: She thinks the boil needs no side herself, but would offer guests oven wings glazed with honey soy and brown sugar, or a simple salad.
recommendations.quote: you breakaway and it's nice sticky crisp on the outside and the chickens nice on the insidem it's just perfect.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Pinot Noir from New Zealand or South Africa (small glass with starter)
recommendations.reason: She pairs different wines with courses, a small glass to accompany the ackee and saltfish dumpling.
recommendations.quote: I like one from New Zealand, so it would be for New Zealand or South Africa actually. That would be a nice small glass of wine
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Sauvignon Blanc (large glass with the main)
recommendations.reason: A slightly sweeter white to stand up to the spicy seafood boil.
recommendations.quote: It's a little bit sweeter than the pino, so it's better.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Cherry crumble with custard (and ice cream)
recommendations.reason: Her mum Joyce makes the cherries and Thanyia makes the crumble topping, crisped with crumbled bread; a favourite since she switched from blackberry at 16.
recommendations.quote: So Joyce will have made the cherries. Yeah. And th en I just make the crumble and then put that in the oven.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Mum Joyce's home-cooked lunch boxes and cottage pie
recommendations.reason: Her mum is a chef who sells five-pound lunch boxes from home; her cottage pie is Thanyia's favourite dish of hers.
recommendations.quote: my favourite meal my mum makes is a cottage pie, it's just really bloody good.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: Caribbean food
recommendations.reason: She cites it as an example of genuinely Caribbean food compared with 'Caribbean inspired' chains, saying it is nice.
recommendations.quote: If you go to like Reflex or something like that. Yeah, that's Caribbean.
recommendations.speaker: Thanyia Moore

recommendations.item: New Orleans shrimp boil meal kit
recommendations.reason: Ed had Decatur's New Orleans shrimp boil kits delivered throughout lockdown and says they are the absolute best.
recommendations.quote: all over lockdown I've been getting a meal kit from a place called Decatur who do New Orleans shrimp boils
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 97: Munya Chawawa
episodes.summary: Munya Chawawa's menu is still water, cold toast with a thick layer of butter, mushroom arancini, oxtail with rice and peas, plantain, a mojito and the chocolate bomb from The Ivy.

recommendations.item: Still water (tap)
recommendations.reason: He loves being able to drink tap water safely in England and finds sparkling water an unpleasant 'electric' experience.
recommendations.quote: in a restaurant, if I had the luxury, I probably would go still. Because I think if you go sparkling, there's just something wrong with you.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Cold toast with a thick layer of solid butter
recommendations.reason: He likes to actually taste the butter, so he layers cold butter onto cooled toast; a choice that caused controversy on his Instagram. He picked bread because his dad once served Quavers as poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: I like the toast to be cold and rock hard but still toast, and then to layer the butter as a solid over the top of it.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Mushroom arancini (golf-ball sized)
recommendations.reason: He recently made giant bowling-ball arancini at home from a cookbook, then discovered the proper size at a market; he wants someone else to make them.
recommendations.quote: I'm gonna have mushroom arancini.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Oxtail with rice and peas
recommendations.reason: He loves Caribbean food and enjoys the gamble of local Caribbean takeaways, where a good oxtail carries you for days.
recommendations.quote: When they get the oxtail right, it is just a delight for the senses. You know, the meal carries you for days.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Plantain
recommendations.reason: Chosen to stay on theme with the Caribbean oxtail main.
recommendations.quote: if you're gonna have ox towel recipes, you got to sort of stick within the theme.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Mojito
recommendations.reason: It is the only cocktail he feels safe with after an almond-syrup cocktail triggered his nut allergy at a secret Chinatown bar.
recommendations.quote: my go to drink would be a Mojito. Yeah. Yeah. Nice and simple... that's the only cocktail I feel safe with.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Cocktails and dim sum at an unnamed secret bar
recommendations.reason: He loves this tiny, hidden upstairs bar in Chinatown for its amazing cocktails and dumplings, but deliberately refuses to name it.
recommendations.quote: There's a bar. I love it. I go to it in Soho. It's a secret bar. I'm not even gonna tell you what it is because I like it when it's empty.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

recommendations.item: Chocolate bomb
recommendations.reason: He has the chocolate bomb at The Ivy, with a tipsy ritual of nodding to the gnomes tiled in the toilets, which he credits with letting him finish it.
recommendations.quote: I eat this chocolate bomb when I go to this restaurant called The Ivy... If you go in the Ivy toilets, there's these gnomes on the wall.
recommendations.speaker: Munya Chawawa

episodes.title: Ep 100: Ed Gamble and James Acaster (with special guest genie Claudia Winkleman)
episodes.summary: For the 100th episode the hosts give their own menus to waiter-genie Claudia Winkleman: James picks Cawston Press, Alter's pizza-dust bread, Atelier Crenn's Tomato and Basil 3.0, Ron Gastrobar's beef Wellington, Aulis's Berkswell pudding and his flatmates' Netflix cake, while Ed has Guinness, Yard Sale's Marmite garlic bread, chargrilled oysters, a London barbecue meat tray, Lucky & Joy sesame noodles and Hawksmoor's peanut butter shortbread.

recommendations.item: Rhubarb Cawston Press with crushed ice made of Cawston Press (James)
recommendations.reason: James drinks it so often it feels like water to him, so he swaps it in for the water course.
recommendations.quote: It's my water is Cawston Press.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pint of draught Guinness (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ed refuses to waste the course on tap water and argues Guinness is basically better water; a pub landlord once said he drank it like water.
recommendations.quote: It's better water essentially. Someone's made better water.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Garlic bread with cheese and Marmite (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ed's favourite garlic bread: pizza dough with garlic butter, Marmite and mozzarella, which he says nowhere else does.
recommendations.quote: I order a pizza from Yard Sale, but I always order the garlic bread with Marmite and cheese, and I think that's my favourite bit.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pizza-crust bread fingers dusted in a pizza-flavoured herb and spice rub, with aioli (James)
recommendations.location: Leman Street, Whitechapel, London, UK (originally a pop-up next to The Dairy, Clapham)
recommendations.reason: Its fluffy bread that tasted exactly like a whole pizza was the one bread that beat poppadoms for James.
recommendations.quote: That bread you gave me at the start, that has knocked off poppadoms for me.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Folded cone poppadoms (James's favourite poppadoms)
recommendations.reason: A curry house a few doors from James's old Edinburgh house that folds its poppadoms into extra-crispy cones in the fryer.
recommendations.quote: while they're in the fryer they fold them up somehow... And it's just even crispier than a normal poppadom. And those are my favourite poppadoms in the world.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Deep-fried anchovy-stuffed olives
recommendations.reason: Ed's runner-up for the bread course; the Russell Norman restaurant has closed, though he thinks Polpo serves them too.
recommendations.quote: they are the saltiest thing you will ever eat and absolutely phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Tomato and Basil 3.0 (James)
recommendations.reason: A tasting-menu plate of raw tomato, tomato raisins, gels, sorbet and tomato water that made James understand what a tomato really tastes like.
recommendations.quote: it was like the most rich, just satisfying, exciting, vibrant, tomato flavours. It was like I was seeing colours and shapes when I was eating it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: South American smoothie, served with the starter (James)
recommendations.reason: The best smoothie James has ever had, with a secret recipe that tastes like a giant raspberry Petits Filous. Order the smoothie, not the juice.
recommendations.quote: if you do go to Tropicana in Melbourne, then you've got to get the South American smoothie, not the South American juice.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Chargrilled oysters with garlic pecorino butter, from a meal kit (Ed)
recommendations.location: London, UK (delivery meal kit cooked at home)
recommendations.reason: Ed used to insist on raw oysters until he barbecued these New Orleans-style ones from the Decatur kit, with butter bubbling into the fire.
recommendations.quote: The butter goes into the fire, it bubbles up, it chargrills the sides... and it is phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Harris Gin martini with four olives, served with the starter (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ed's pairing for the oysters.
recommendations.quote: I will be having that with a Gin Martini made with Harris Gin with four olives in it.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Korean fried chicken
recommendations.reason: One of Ed's honourable mentions for the starter.
recommendations.quote: the Korean fried chicken from Bone Daddies
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Keralan fried chicken
recommendations.reason: James loves it but left it out because he assumes there's a better version in Kerala itself.
recommendations.quote: Another shout out is the Keralan fried chicken from Kricket. Now, I absolutely love it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Tricolore salad with tomato water, tomato oil, mozzarella and basil oil
recommendations.reason: Ed's comparison for James's tomato dish: a chef boiling a tomato down to its essence.
recommendations.quote: there's a dish at Da Terra in Bethnal Green, where they do like a Tricolore Salad... And it is, it's phenomenal!
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Beef Wellington for two, plus whipped butter with puffed pork scratchings (James)
recommendations.reason: After a bad year James walked 90 minutes to this place in January, ate a sharing Wellington alone and felt his life turning around. He'd also bring its pork-scratching butter for the bread.
recommendations.quote: It was just the most delicious... The steak on its own would have been one of the best steaks I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Unnamed local sour beer, served with the main (James)
recommendations.reason: James's first sour beer, ordered out of guilt after using an unnamed Amsterdam pub's toilet on his walk home from Ron Gastrobar.
recommendations.quote: it was the most refreshing, delicious drink I'd ever had at that point.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Barbecue meat tray, part 1: beef brisket (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ed's main is a barbecue tray of favourites from several places, and he calls Smokestak London's best barbecue restaurant.
recommendations.quote: I'm having Beef Brisket and I'm having that from Smokestak in London. That is the best barbecue restaurant in London
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Barbecue meat tray, part 2: Tamworth belly ribs (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Pork belly ribs Ed rates as incredible, included on his tray.
recommendations.quote: I'm having the Tamworth Belly Ribs from Hawksmoor, they're going on there as well: pork belly — incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Barbecue meat tray, part 3: beef ribs and pickled shiitakes (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Beef ribs for the tray, plus the pickled shiitakes Ed made from Pitt Cue's cookbook.
recommendations.quote: I'm having the Beef Ribs from Pitt Cue in London.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Barbecue meat tray, part 4: Bacon Holy Fuck sauce (Ed)
recommendations.reason: One of the sauces on Ed's barbecue tray.
recommendations.quote: including The Rib Man Bacon Holy Fuck sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Barbecue meat tray, part 5: cauliflower shawarma with tahini (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Chargrilled cauliflower with tahini from a Middle Eastern open-flame grill, which Ed argues belongs on the tray.
recommendations.quote: I'm having the Cauliflower Shawarma from Berber & Q — absolutely incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pappy Van Winkle bourbon, served with the main (Ed)
recommendations.reason: An extremely rare, expensive bourbon Ed has only had once, as a splurge in a New Zealand bar.
recommendations.quote: I've picked Pappy Van Winkle bourbon because it's the Dream Restaurant and it's so expensive
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Beef brisket, added to Ed's tray by James
recommendations.reason: The best brisket James has ever had; he ate there twice in two days in Dallas.
recommendations.quote: Best beef brisket I've ever had was at Pecan Lodge in Dallas.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Skate wing tacos
recommendations.reason: A main-course honourable mention for James: skate so perfectly cooked it combs off the bone for DIY tacos.
recommendations.quote: it is so perfectly cooked that you get a fork and you're just combing the fish off the bone.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Berkswell pudding (James)
recommendations.reason: Simon Rogan's savoury croissant bread-and-butter pudding with Berkswell cheese, eaten at a tasting night. Chef Tom Barnes snuck the hosts a second portion.
recommendations.quote: It made me close my eyes and out loud vocalise how amazing it was.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Rosé Smash cocktail, served with the side (James)
recommendations.reason: A rosé vermouth cocktail in a cold metal cup with a flavour James can't place.
recommendations.quote: It comes in a lovely cold metal cup, and it's probably the best cocktail I've ever had anywhere.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Vegetarian rice cakes
recommendations.reason: A side-dish honourable mention that James calls one of the best side dishes he's had.
recommendations.quote: I think that's one of the best side dishes that I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Wasabi king prawns (circa 2016-2018 recipe)
recommendations.reason: A long-running James favourite, though he says the sauce was better before they changed it.
recommendations.quote: Wasabi King Prawns from Tao Tao Ju — circa 2016 to 2018, before they changed the sauce.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Cold sesame noodles with Lao Gan Ma crispy chilli oil (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Egg noodles in a creamy sesame sauce from a Clapton Chinese restaurant Ed orders from a lot; he loves the sesame punch.
recommendations.quote: There is a Chinese restaurant in Clapton called Lucky and Joy it is an absolute delight.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Little Bastard natural wine (Staffelter Hof), served with the side (Ed)
recommendations.reason: Ed first tried it at chef Santiago Lastra's test-kitchen dinner party in Acton and now buys it regularly; its stone-fruit sweetness suits spicy food.
recommendations.quote: I've never tasted anything like it. It's kind of sweet. It's got, like, a lot of stone fruit flavour to it
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Xian Bing pork pastry dumplings
recommendations.reason: Ed always double-orders these pie-like pork dumplings at the Taiwanese restaurant.
recommendations.quote: XU in Soho, which is a wonderful Taiwanese restaurant... that is one thing I will always double order
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Bottle of Californian Cabernet Sauvignon (Ed)
recommendations.reason: A heavy, jammy red that reminds Ed of US holidays with James.
recommendations.quote: just a fruity, jammy, oaky, tobacco-y, Californian Cabernet Sauvignon, and I will have the whole bottle to myself.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Whisky-barrel-aged vintage cider (James)
recommendations.location: A cider farm near Newquay, Cornwall, UK (name unknown)
recommendations.reason: The first alcoholic drink James ever liked; he took bottles home and drank it with his breakfast Weetabix.
recommendations.quote: it was cider that was kept in whisky barrels, so that the flavour of the whisky gets into the cider.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Peanut butter shortbread with salted caramel ice cream, with an espresso martini (Ed)
recommendations.reason: He chose it on the meal at Hawksmoor that first got him into restaurants; the shortbread isn't too sweet and the ice cream tops it off.
recommendations.quote: It is the first time I started going to restaurants properly and really discovered a love for restaurants.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: French toast, ordered for the table
recommendations.reason: An honourable mention on both menus, so James orders it for them to share.
recommendations.quote: So I'd like to order the Shack-Fuyu French Toast for the table please.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Triple-layer chocolate raspberry cake with salted caramel cream and white chocolate ganache, with his mum's peanut butter slice ice cream (James)
recommendations.reason: His flatmates baked it for the viewing party the day his Netflix specials came out. He wants it with his mum's homemade Reese's-style ice cream.
recommendations.quote: Oh my God, this cake — I think about it all the time. I couldn't stop eating it all week.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Salted caramel thick shake, served with dessert (James)
recommendations.reason: A massive drum of shake from around 2014, before the recipe changed, so good it made life worth living.
recommendations.quote: it was so good that it just made all of life worth living.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Banana jam pie
recommendations.reason: One of James's dessert honourable mentions.
recommendations.quote: Banana Jam Pie from Chin Chin
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Banana pudding
recommendations.reason: One of James's dessert honourable mentions.
recommendations.quote: Banana Pudding from Magnolia Bakery in New York
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Coffee kombucha, with charcuterie by the fire (James)
recommendations.reason: James calls Noma the best meal out he's ever had. He stayed up all night with Nish drinking these, and his dream restaurant is modelled on Noma.
recommendations.quote: I would like that coffee from Noma and I'd like to sit and watch Ed have a cheese board to himself
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: House whisky, with petit fours by the fire (Ed)
recommendations.reason: A chef friend bought Ed a glass of the restaurant's own whisky to celebrate his engagement on the night he proposed.
recommendations.quote: that is just the most comfortable and happy and warm, I think I've ever felt.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Dream restaurant setting
recommendations.reason: Ed models his dream restaurant on Kadeau and wants to go there first once international travel reopens.
recommendations.quote: Mine is Kadeau in Copenhagen.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Motorway services food with a big window
recommendations.reason: James names Tebay alongside Noma as one of the two best places he's had a meal.
recommendations.quote: The two best places I've ever been for a meal– were Noma and Tebay.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 101: Julie Adenuga
episodes.summary: Julie Adenuga's Nigerian-restaurant menu: room-temperature still water, poppadoms topped with madras and rice, no starter, her mum's ground rice with egusi and tomato stew and beef, plantain, Copella cloudy apple juice and apple crumble with warm custard.

recommendations.item: Still water, room temperature, no ice, no lemon
recommendations.reason: She abhors sparkling water as an unnatural ruining of the purest thing on earth, and avoids ice and lemon too.
recommendations.quote: Stupid question, still. Next question.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Poppadoms broken into quarters topped with rice and madras
recommendations.reason: After initially rejecting both as carbs, she chose poppadoms because she likes to pile rice and curry on a quarter and eat it like pizza.
recommendations.quote: I like to balance rice on top of it with a bit of a madras and then eat it like a pizza.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: No starter (pass)
recommendations.reason: She doesn't believe in starters - when she's hungry she wants all the food at once.
recommendations.quote: I don't believe in Starters... I think they're stupid.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Ground rice with egusi stew, tomato stew and beef
recommendations.reason: A Nigerian dish that has to be made by her mum (with her dad making the ground rice); restaurant versions never match it.
recommendations.quote: Absolutely, it has to be mum's one... I've been to a few restaurants and had it, but it's just not the same
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Nigerian stews
recommendations.reason: Recommended as a place to get good Nigerian stews.
recommendations.quote: I would say there's a place called 805, literally those numbers. 805 in Hendon, North London.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Nigerian stews
recommendations.reason: Her other recommendation for good Nigerian stews in London.
recommendations.quote: Then you have a place called Enish in Brixton.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Plantain
recommendations.reason: Sweet, goes perfectly with the egusi and always makes her smile while eating.
recommendations.quote: my Side Dish is Plantain because it's sweet... it always makes me smile whilst I'm eating.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Copella cloudy apple juice
recommendations.reason: Her favourite juice, discovered via her friend Cyan whom she once teased for loving it; she doesn't drink alcohol.
recommendations.quote: one day, I just Copella'd and I've never gone back.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Apple crumble with warm custard (equal or more crumble than apple)
recommendations.reason: The greatest dessert of all time when the crumble ratio is right; custard seeps into the crumble, unlike ice cream which she abhors on crumble.
recommendations.quote: the way the custard seeps into the crumble, it's like a marriage of fucking beauty and fucking deliciousness.
recommendations.speaker: Julie Adenuga

recommendations.item: Cherry pie
recommendations.reason: The hosts were sent a frozen cherry pie by Chin Chin that they loved hot and cold.
recommendations.quote: We both got sent a cherry pie from Chin Chin ice cream... And it was pretty amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 102: Rafe Spall
episodes.summary: Rafe Spall orders a gargantuan 'eat myself to death' feast for the table, from a Spotted Pig cheeseburger and Chicago-style porterhouse to $100 truffle macaroni from The Waverly Inn, finishing with Ben & Jerry's Caramel Chew Chew.

recommendations.item: Fizzy water with Robinson's orange squash
recommendations.reason: He guzzles fizzy water all day from his SodaStream and calls fizzy water with orange squash one of his favourite drinks in the world.
recommendations.quote: probably my favourite drink in the world, up there, is fizzy water with orange squash.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Sourdough with salted butter and extra salt
recommendations.reason: A former fat kid who never 'filled up on bread', he wants double salt on his sourdough.
recommendations.quote: I'm gonna have some sourdough bread. And I want to put butter on it and salt.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Two dry vodka martinis with olives, plus a half of lager while waiting
recommendations.reason: His favourite feeling is sitting with friends after two martinis choosing from the menu; in Atlanta restaurants they bring a small beer while your cocktail is made.
recommendations.quote: Is to be a table with your friends, and I've had two martinis and I'm looking at the menu deciding what to eat.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Sharing starters: tricolore salad, tuna nigiri, grilled halloumi, hummus with pitta, creamed polenta with mushrooms
recommendations.reason: He orders a spread of sharing plates for the table; creamed polenta with parmesan and cream is something he loves cooking at home.
recommendations.quote: Creamed polenta, you put a bit cream in it and parmesan. It's easy and lovely.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Watermelon, duck and cashew salad
recommendations.reason: A pan-Asian restaurant version with caramelised cashews, fresh watermelon and shredded duck.
recommendations.quote: they do it at a sort of pan-Asian restaurant called E-N-O. The cashews are sort of caramelised and then the watermelons really fresh
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Watermelon, duck and cashew salad
recommendations.reason: He says the salad can be had at The Ivy (read back as his source on the menu).
recommendations.quote: You can get it in the Ivy, right?
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Cheeseburger with string fries
recommendations.location: West Village, New York City, USA (now closed)
recommendations.reason: The best burger he has ever had, served with very thin fries, at the now-closed New York gastropub.
recommendations.quote: they had a burger there which, for me, and I've had many is probably the best one I've ever had. That's a cheeseburger with string fries.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Porterhouse steak cooked Chicago style (black and blue) with English mustard; melanzane parmigiana
recommendations.reason: He loves steak charred outside and very rare inside, plus aubergine parmigiana for any vegetarians.
recommendations.quote: it's very, very chard on the outside and very rare on the inside.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Chicken burrito with guacamole
recommendations.reason: While filming in LA he went every evening and ate the same chicken burrito; Mexican is the cuisine he could eat forever.
recommendations.quote: a restaurant in Venice Beach called Casa Linda and I would go there every evening and have that.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Fries, dauphinoise potatoes, pickled cucumber salad, tomato and red onion salad, zucchini fritti, sauces
recommendations.reason: Thin salty fries, dauphinoise to dip chips into and vinegary salads to cut through the richness.
recommendations.quote: You got to cut through it with the vinegar in the pickled cucumber salad.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Truffle macaroni cheese ($100 special)
recommendations.location: West Village, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: The fancy New York restaurant always offers its $100 truffle mac as a special; he has never dared order it until now.
recommendations.quote: there's this restaurant, a fancy restaurant in New York City called The Waverly... the special that we have on is this macaroni cheese with truffle on it.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Diet Coke
recommendations.reason: He was addicted to it for 15 years before giving it up, so it's a dream-restaurant indulgence.
recommendations.quote: i'd have five cans a day easy for about 15 years.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Château Latour claret, around 1990
recommendations.reason: A wine collector, he picks an extravagant 30-year-old claret since money is no object.
recommendations.quote: there's a fancy wine from a place called Château Latour, which is a claret, and it will probably be from maybe 1990.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Ben & Jerry's Caramel Chew Chew, softened 10-15 minutes, then an espresso
recommendations.reason: Ice cream is his favourite food and he loves caramel and toffee; Ben & Jerry's are among the finest purveyors.
recommendations.quote: Also the caramel swirl that goes down to the middle of it, its Heaven. It's lovely. I love ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Rafe Spall

recommendations.item: Big crispy chips
recommendations.reason: Ed says he'd pick thick chips over thin only somewhere like Hawksmoor where they're legitimately crispy.
recommendations.quote: Someone like Hawksmore that do big chips. But they're like, they're really crispy. I'd go for them.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 103: Bimini Bon Boulash
episodes.summary: Vegan drag queen Bimini Bon Boulash orders sparkling water with lime, a spiced Margate carrot amuse-bouche, a warm white crusty roll, her mum's leek and potato 'Heather soup', Purezza's Parmigiana Party pizza, Cajun fries, a frozen chilli margarita and sticky toffee pudding.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with ice, a slice of lime and her own metal straw
recommendations.reason: Sparkling adds glamour to a glass of water, and lime is edgier and 'more punk' than lemon.
recommendations.quote: Always sparkling. Because I think it just adds that level of glamour to a glass of water that you need at all times.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Whole spiced carrot on yoghurt pesto (amuse-bouche)
recommendations.reason: A whole carrot cooked in cinnamon and cumin at a newly opened rooftop restaurant in Margate whose name she can't remember; the best carrot she's ever had.
recommendations.quote: I can't remember the restaurant. I can't remember where it was. It was on a rooftop in Margate and they've just opened up the place.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Warm white crusty roll with salted vegan butter (Sainsbury's), plus a taste of raw dough
recommendations.reason: Nostalgia for fresh crusty rolls from a little corner shop near her aunty's house that she visited every Saturday as a kid.
recommendations.quote: it was just like a little corner shop, but they made this like fresh bread in the mornings. And we would get like, these crusty rolls
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Leek and potato soup ('Heather soup') made by her mum
recommendations.reason: Her mum Heather's standout dish, so famous among locals in the Bahamas they named it after her; full of childhood nostalgia.
recommendations.quote: all of the locals used to call it Heather soup. Her name is Heather. so they used to call it Heather soup.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Parmigiana Party vegan pizza
recommendations.reason: All-vegan pizzeria with house-made nut-based cheeses that has won pizza awards against dairy rivals; she and her boyfriend go monthly and always order the Parmigiana Party.
recommendations.quote: It's all vegan pizza. And it is the best pizza you will ever eat. I'm not even I'm not even like being vegan and biassed here.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Cajun salted fries with vegan garlic mayo and sriracha dips
recommendations.reason: Slightly smaller than chip-shop chips, soft inside and very crunchy, inspired by a chip shop she visited in Margate.
recommendations.quote: They're they're just a bit smaller than your average chip shop chip, but they're cooked crunchier.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Frozen chilli-salted margarita
recommendations.reason: Reminds her of lockdown summer evenings in the garden with her housemates; she got into margaritas from watching Real Housewives of Beverly Hills.
recommendations.quote: I am going to go with a chilli salted Margarita.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with hot vegan custard
recommendations.reason: Chosen over strawberry cheesecake as the 'gritty, punky' side of her personality.
recommendations.quote: I've got the sticky toffee bit more gritty, bit more punky side.
recommendations.speaker: Bimini Bon Boulash

recommendations.item: Free curry and poppadoms
recommendations.reason: James praises the Edinburgh curry house, which gave him free food for life after he shouted out its poppadoms.
recommendations.quote: I shouted out some poppadoms from Namaste Katmandu and they're given me free food for life. A wonderful curry house in Edinburgh.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Burger kits with corn ribs and kombu seasoning
recommendations.reason: The hosts loved Fallow's at-home burger kits, especially the deep-fried corn ribs, which James has since made four times.
recommendations.quote: Thank you to the good people at Fallow who sent us some amazing burger kits, including these things called corn ribs
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 104: Martin Freeman
episodes.summary: Martin Freeman's dream menu runs from sparkling water and The Wolseley's bread and butter to smoked salmon with capers, a Sorrento-style prawn and spinach linguine with chips, Pinot Noir plus a Coke, and lemon meringue pie.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (with an oxygen tank)
recommendations.reason: Usually a tap-water person, but he'll pay for sparkling because he (wrongly) believes the bubbles perk you up; it feels like a treat.
recommendations.quote: I'm gonna say sparkling because it is like a little treat.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Bread and butter
recommendations.reason: On his last family meal out before lockdown the bread and perfectly salted butter at The Wolseley was so good it was like a meal in itself; he likes that it's a place worth dressing up for.
recommendations.quote: the quality of butter is just the right amount of saltedness, Oh man, so gorgeous. It's like a meal in itself.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Smoked salmon with onions, capers, lemon and black pepper
recommendations.reason: A lean starter that leaves room for later; he's a recent convert to capers, which he says set off the salmon.
recommendations.quote: a nice bit of smoked salmon without loads of other carby bits around it is really nice. sets off your palate nicely.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Prawn and spinach linguine in white wine sauce
