recommendations.reason: The best version he's had was at an unnamed restaurant in Sorrento, where he holidays with his kids and can truly relax.
recommendations.quote: It might actually be somewhere in Sorrento, the name of which I can't remember... it is truly a place where I feel very relaxed.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Fat chips
recommendations.reason: He loves a carb overload of creamy pasta with chips, a mouthful of each.
recommendations.quote: you know, a mouthful a pasta a chip, heaven.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Glass of Pinot Noir
recommendations.reason: He discovered Pinot Noir while filming The Hobbit in New Zealand, where everyone knows about wine, and it's been his go-to since.
recommendations.quote: Pinot Noir was what I really discovered in New Zealand and that's kind of been my go to since then.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Bottle of Coca-Cola with ice and lime
recommendations.reason: Full-sugar classic Coke to start the meal alongside the water, as part of a big blowout; no diet versions.
recommendations.quote: Yeah, with ice in lime is in lime in my coke. Yeah. Nice.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue pie
recommendations.reason: He loves the zesty lemon, sugary meringue and crusty pastry, and it feels light.
recommendations.quote: I think a wellmade lemon meringue pie is quite gorgeous, you know. It's got that that zesty flavour of the lemon.
recommendations.speaker: Martin Freeman

recommendations.item: Lemon meringue pie with towering meringue
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends Gloria's lemon meringue pie, whose meringue is about 30cm high.
recommendations.quote: The lemon meringue pie, Gloria, a restaurant in Shoreditch, where they have the normal lemon bit and then the meringue bit is probably about 30 centimetres high.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 106: Josh Gondelman
episodes.summary: Josh Gondelman's butter-heavy dream menu: tap water with lots of ice, a wholegrain roll with honey salted butter from the late Rye, Rucola's escarole salad, a warm buttered lobster roll, thin fries, a blue-cheese-olive dirty vodka martini and a molten chocolate lava cake for his wife's face.

recommendations.item: Tap water with lots of ice
recommendations.reason: Prefers still/tap to keep costs down and likes all drinks as cold as possible, stacked with ice.
recommendations.quote: I like a still water with a lot of ice. I like my beverages as cold as possible at all times.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Dark wholegrain roll with honey salted butter
recommendations.location: Williamsburg, Brooklyn, New York, USA (now closed)
recommendations.reason: Their favourite restaurant where both sets of parents first met; the sweet salted butter was so good his diabetic wife would budget for the bread.
recommendations.quote: we took both our parents out to meet at this restaurant called Rye, in our old neighbourhood, we lived in Willamsburg, Brooklyn and they just had the greatest butter.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Escarole salad with goat's cheese, toasted almonds and honey elderflower vinaigrette
recommendations.location: Boerum Hill, Brooklyn, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: A salad he and his wife took a chance on that became his all-time favourite; the dressing is perfectly balanced.
recommendations.quote: there's a restaurant called Rucola in Brooklyn that has this great salad. It's escarole goat's cheese, toasted almonds and this light dressing
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Warm buttered lobster roll
recommendations.reason: Grew up in lobster roll country; fond family memories of eating seafood on picnic benches at Woodman's, where he now buys his parents gift certificates.
recommendations.quote: my family used to go to this place called Woodman's which is like up on the north shore of Massachusetts... I have very fond memories of it
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Thin French fries with ketchup
recommendations.reason: Skinny fries pair naturally with the lobster roll and can be dunked three at a time into ketchup.
recommendations.quote: skinny French fries that you can dunk like three at a time into ketchup.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Dirty vodka martini with blue-cheese-stuffed olives
recommendations.location: East 14th Street, Manhattan, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: Every time it's offered he reacts as if it's a wonderful new thing; the blue cheese complements the salty olive. He thinks Beauty Bar, a casual bar that also does manicures, serves it.
recommendations.quote: I think Beauty Bar has it, which is like, not, it's not hard... you just go in, and they do manicures and stuff and it's like a cute place.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Molten chocolate lava cake
recommendations.reason: His wife, a type 1 diabetic, has it only twice a year; watching her face as she eats it is one of his favourite moments of the year.
recommendations.quote: the look on her face when she eats like her twice yearly molten chocolate lava cake is one of my favourite times of the whole year
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Family recipe apple pie (pie crust) with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic family recipe; as a child he ate the crust while his coeliac uncle ate the apples. The hosts threw in the crust as a bonus.
recommendations.quote: we have a great family recipe for apple pie which is Great warm with vanilla ice cream and I have a real nostalgia for it.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Fried chicken from Los Pollos Hermanos (Breaking Bad)
recommendations.reason: Almost chose this fictional chicken as his main; the hosts added it as a bonus.
recommendations.quote: I almost went with the chicken from the chicken restaurant in Breaking Bad. Because people loved it so much they didn't notice that they were making that they were making meth downstairs.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Pho and banh mi
recommendations.location: MacDougal Street, Greenwich Village, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: His recommendation for one place the hosts should eat in New York; always been happy with the pho and banh mi.
recommendations.quote: they have pho and bahn mi at this place called Saigon Shack on McDougall Street and that's a that's a fun spot.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Restaurant
recommendations.reason: Endorsed as a great choice when the hosts mention it is on their New York list.
recommendations.quote: Right, Mission Chinese is a great choice so far
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

recommendations.item: Lobster roll
recommendations.location: Chain: London, UK and New York, USA
recommendations.reason: James's first ever lobster roll and possibly still his favourite; he likes pouring the butter over the fries.
recommendations.quote: And their lobster roll, that was the first lobster roll I'd ever had and it still maybe my favourite lobster roll.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Beef brisket sandwich with coleslaw and pickles
recommendations.reason: James's favourite sandwich ever, eaten yearly at the Auckland comedy festival; the place has since shut.
recommendations.quote: there was a place called Honey Trap and they did this sandwich and it was the best like beef brisket sandwich... My favourite sandwich ever. And it's shut.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Beef brisket sandwich
recommendations.reason: Josh's favourite brisket sandwich, from a now-closed barbecue place.
recommendations.quote: I also have a favourite beef brisket sandwich at a place that no longer exists. A barbecue place in Boston called Soul Fire that's gone.
recommendations.speaker: Josh Gondelman

episodes.title: Ep 107: Joe Wicks
episodes.summary: Joe Wicks goes all-in on indulgent food: sticky toffee pudding first, calamari and truffle arancini, a Flat Iron wagyu burger with truffle parmesan fries, sushi on the side and a passionfruit mojito.

recommendations.item: Still water with fresh lemon on the side
recommendations.reason: He likes still water with a slice of lemon brought separately so he can add it himself.
recommendations.quote: I'm a still water kind of guy with just a little bit of fresh lemon on the side will be nice.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Gin and tonic (double gin, Fever-Tree Mediterranean tonic, raspberries/blueberries)
recommendations.reason: He swaps the water for a fruity gin and tonic, a nightly ritual from his home gin bar.
recommendations.quote: I normally have like a double shot with like one Mediteranean FeverTree Tonic. I like a bit of fruit so I put like a few raspberries or blueberries
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Sticky toffee pudding with extra toffee sauce and vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: A classic British pub Sunday-roast dessert he remembers from school; he loves the warm and cold combination and wants it swimming in sauce.
recommendations.quote: it's warm and it's got like that massive sticky toffee sauce on the top and the warm and cold combination is always something that I love.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Sourdough toast with chunky orange marmalade
recommendations.reason: His kryptonite at home: he can eat a whole loaf of sourdough with craft marmalade in a day.
recommendations.quote: if there's a good bit of sourdough in my house and there's orange marmalade, I'm like Paddington Bear
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Crispy calamari rings with alioli
recommendations.reason: He loves light, fluffy battered calamari rings with a garlic or chilli mayo dip; no specific venue.
recommendations.quote: I just love crispy calamari with a nice a little garlic alioili dip
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Truffle arancini
recommendations.reason: He first discovered truffle arancini at The Ivy in Richmond and now orders it whenever he sees it.
recommendations.quote: I think I had it at The Ivy Brasserie in Richmond... they do truffle arancini which is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Wagyu beef burger with béarnaise sauce, crispy bacon and BBQ sauce on a brioche bun
recommendations.reason: His favourite burger: an occasional wagyu special at Flat Iron Soho that is crispy outside, with béarnaise dripping down your chin; he texts the manager to check if it's on.
recommendations.quote: Flat Iron Steak in Soho, they do a wagyu beef burger with a béarnaise sauce and it's like, they almost deep fry the burger
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Truffle parmesan fries
recommendations.reason: His choice of chips with the burger, going 'double truffle'.
recommendations.quote: I want truffle parmesan fries believe it or not.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Spicy tuna, yellowtail and prawn tempura sushi with crispy onions
recommendations.reason: He wants Asian-fusion style sushi like at Sushi Samba, Nobu and Zuma, double-dipped in soy, roe flicked off.
recommendations.quote: I love spicy tuna sushi and yellowtail sushi with the crispy onions on top.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Passionfruit mojito
recommendations.reason: He loves tall, fruity, ice-filled cocktails; in a London restaurant he'd go for a passionfruit mojito.
recommendations.quote: if I was in London in a restaurant I would probably go passionfruit mojito, believe it or not.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Piña colada
recommendations.reason: His favourite summer holiday drink, with an umbrella and a cherry on top.
recommendations.quote: A piña colada, little umbrella like cherry on top, that would be like my favourite like summer holiday drink.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Wagyu meat sushi blow-torched at the table
recommendations.reason: Salt Bae's rice topped with thin wagyu, garlic butter and crispy potato, blow-torched in front of him, was one of the best mouthfuls he's ever had.
recommendations.quote: It really is one of the best, like ever mouthfuls of food I've ever had
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Prawn tempura 'devil' sushi roll
recommendations.reason: James raves about a prawn tempura roll topped with tuna and sauce with perfectly bubbly crispy tempura.
recommendations.quote: Everything about it is perfect and I could eat it forever and I really, I really want it.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Sushi
recommendations.reason: Eating at Zuma in London (and Nobu Malibu) showed him what sushi should really taste like.
recommendations.quote: when I first went to like Nobu in Malibu or Zuma in London I was like, 'oh my God, this is what sushi should taste like'.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Sushi
recommendations.reason: Along with Zuma, the place that opened his eyes to proper sushi.
recommendations.quote: when I first went to like Nobu in Malibu or Zuma in London I was like, 'oh my God, this is what sushi should taste like'.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Sushi on the outdoor terrace
recommendations.reason: One of the first restaurants he and his wife booked after lockdown, for sushi on the terrace.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to Sushi Samba in Covent Garden with my wife which we like
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

recommendations.item: Farm-to-table garden house restaurant
recommendations.reason: He praises its outdoor garden house restaurant using produce from its own allotment.
recommendations.quote: they've got an amazing like outdoor garden house restaurant where they grow the food on the allotment it's quite like farm to table style which is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Wicks

episodes.title: Ep 108: Dan Aykroyd (Bonus Episode)
episodes.summary: Dan Aykroyd hosts his dream meal at his Ontario lake home 'Lune Lodge': Crystal Head martinis and cheese, pappardelle pesto, a huge Canadian mixed grill, Caesar salad, Chardonnay and a dessert spread, before switching to a full Indian feast with poppadoms.

recommendations.item: Jugs of warm lemon water
recommendations.reason: Served at the end of his dream dinner party at his lakeside cabin as guests get up from the porch.
recommendations.quote: And then jugs of warm lemon water, as everyone gets up from the porch. Lots of lemon water jugs
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Poppadoms
recommendations.reason: He picks poppadoms and says he would happily eat Indian food every night.
recommendations.quote: Oh! Popadom. Oh yeah, popadoms for sure.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Pecorino and stilton with red pepper jelly, crackers, olives and pickles, then pappardelle pesto
recommendations.reason: Served on arrival with a martini at his cabin; he searches the world for a good pesto and thinks pappardelle suits it best.
recommendations.quote: I love a good pesto, I search the world for pesto. And pappardelle noodles, for me the best noodles to use with pesto.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Canadian mixed grill: baby lamb chops with mint jelly, half-inch T-bone with jus and horseradish, lemon half chicken, Yorkshire pudding, maple-glazed sprouts, garlic mash
recommendations.reason: He fell in love with T-bones grilled at the family farm with meat from the local grocer; the bone gives the flavour and jus.
recommendations.quote: the bone the bone the bone, they just, if it's cooked right, the flavour comes out of that bone, you get an au jus out of it
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Chopped Caesar salad, more lemony than cheesy
recommendations.reason: Served after the mixed grill, chopped up and lemony.
recommendations.quote: we would have a chopped Caesar salad, not cheesy, more lemony than cheesy you know, chopped up.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Crystal Head vodka Bar Car martini, with Chateau Margaux and Californian Chardonnay through the meal
recommendations.reason: His own additive-free Crystal Head vodka, shaken with ice chips, greets guests; wine is served throughout.
recommendations.quote: they would be greeted with my bar staff serving a Bar Car martini, that's the Crystal Head, two and a half ounces of it.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Mocha dacquoise, lemon squares, black velvet and black forest cake with a Crystal Head espresso martini; grilled butter-rolled donuts by the bonfire
recommendations.reason: A dessert spread with an espresso martini, followed by plain donuts rolled in butter and grilled at the bonfire.
recommendations.quote: we will do a plain donuts. Just plain donuts but rolled in butter and then grilled.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Dream Indian meal: sag aloo, sag gosht, tandoori, butter chicken, dal, raita, chapatis, lassi
recommendations.reason: After choosing poppadoms he swaps to a full Indian feast, saying he could eat Indian every night.
recommendations.quote: Butter chicken, the dahl, the raita, a few chapatis maybe. A lassi to cool it all off at the end and some ice cream.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Pan-cooked garlic buds
recommendations.reason: Chef Ben deForest's restaurant, which he calls world renowned; Ben's speciality is pan cooking.
recommendations.quote: Ken 'N' Becks is a world renowned restaurant ... Ben does the beautiful garlic buds in the little pan there and his specialty is pan cooking
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Spring rolls and Vietnamese-style salad
recommendations.reason: Where he plans to eat after the recording, ordering spring rolls and a cha gio salad.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to go to Chez Piggy's and I'm going to order the spring rolls and the châ giô salad
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Fish
recommendations.reason: One of the magnificent restaurants he lists in Kingston.
recommendations.quote: there are magnificent restaurants in this in this town. Dianne's Fish Bar
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: Listed among Kingston's great restaurants.
recommendations.quote: we've got Atomica pizza cafe, Woodenheads pizza cafe
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: Listed among Kingston's great restaurants.
recommendations.quote: we've got Atomica pizza cafe, Woodenheads pizza cafe
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Tapas
recommendations.reason: He calls it a beautiful tapas bar in Kingston.
recommendations.quote: there's a beautiful tapas bar, Tango Nuevo.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Italian restaurant
recommendations.reason: Named as one of the great Canadian restaurants.
recommendations.quote: Oh well of course, Il Latini in Montreal and Canoe in Toronto
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Fine dining
recommendations.reason: Named as one of the great Canadian restaurants.
recommendations.quote: Oh well of course, Il Latini in Montreal and Canoe in Toronto
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Crystal Head vodka cocktails
recommendations.reason: His favourite place in Canada to drink his own vodka; the bartenders know how to use it.
recommendations.quote: The guys in there are fantastic, they love the product, they know how to use it, make it all different kinds of ways.
recommendations.speaker: Dan Aykroyd

recommendations.item: Sourdough donuts rolled in lamb fat, chargrilled, then salt and sugar
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about the donuts that finished his meal there.
recommendations.quote: they finished off the meal with sourdough donuts rolled in lamb fat and then chargrilled and then rolled in salt and sugar. Absolutely phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 110: Ross Kemp
episodes.summary: Ross Kemp's globe-trotting dream meal features Oysters Kilpatrick at L'Unico in Cairns, Szechuan soft shell crab from Hutong in Hong Kong, Lebanese sides, pinot noir and his mum's birthday Baked Alaska.

recommendations.item: Scottish mountain spring water
recommendations.reason: He loves the slightly peaty water from Scottish mountain springs he drank from while hill-walking.
recommendations.quote: I would like some mineral water from Scotland in a glass bottle rather than a plastic bottle please.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Afghan flatbread
recommendations.reason: Giant, crispy, bubbled flatbread straight off a skillet, which reminds him of the generosity of Afghan people he met.
recommendations.quote: it's gonna be sort of like Afghan flat bread. They make the best bread and it's it's ginormous.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Oysters Kilpatrick
recommendations.reason: Hot grilled oysters with Worcestershire sauce, eaten with his (future) wife looking out to sea in her home town; a relief after dangerous filming trips.
recommendations.quote: there's a restaurant I go to there called L'unico, it's full of lunatics.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Crispy soft shell crab with Szechuan chillies
recommendations.location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Kowloon, Hong Kong
recommendations.reason: Deep-fried soft shell crab smothered in chillies, served in a wooden basket with a view over Kowloon; he describes it in very physical terms.
recommendations.quote: my favourite I will go for is from the Hutong restaurant in Hong Kong
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Baba ganoush and fattoush salad
recommendations.reason: He loves Lebanon, its people and its food, especially fattoush with fried pitta, pomegranate molasses and thin radishes.
recommendations.quote: I love Lebanese people and I love the food so I love that kind of baba ganoush stuff, or like kind of, or fattoush salad
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Pinot noir (or Albariño)
recommendations.reason: Allergic to most grapes, he sticks to pinot noir, having toured New Zealand vineyards with his best mate.
recommendations.quote: I do like pinot noir wine, the grape and the wine that goes with it
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Mum's birthday Baked Alaska
recommendations.reason: His mum made it from a SuperCook book for his birthdays aged 8-13; it transports him back to her kitchen like the scene in Ratatouille.
recommendations.quote: I am transported back to that kitchen every time I taste Baked Alaska so it will always be Baked Alaska.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Black tea
recommendations.reason: He wants a proper cup of tea at the end, not the posh 'sniffing tea' he was once served in Madrid.
recommendations.quote: I don't want sniffy tea, I want proper tea. I'll have a cup of tea, I love a cup of tea.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

recommendations.item: Cheese quiche
recommendations.reason: His runner-up starter: a treat when he lived in Battersea, with great French staff and an unbeatable cheese quiche.
recommendations.quote: they make a cheese quiche that I I defy anyone to beat.
recommendations.speaker: Ross Kemp

episodes.title: Ep 112: Simon Amstell
episodes.summary: Simon Amstell's sparing vegan menu: filtered still water, Manna's nachos especial, his own grilled aubergine and pesto pasta, a side of olive oil, homemade kombucha and his boyfriend's courgette chocolate cake.

recommendations.item: Still water (filtered tap, or a fancy non-plastic bottle)
recommendations.reason: He drinks as much water as possible, from the filtered tap in his kitchen.
recommendations.quote: It's actually from a filtered tap but if you have a fancy bottle then I'd take that as well. Although ideally not plastic.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Poppadoms (to take home)
recommendations.reason: He nearly passed, as he doesn't eat much bread and wanted room for his crunchy starter, so took poppadoms in a doggy bag.
recommendations.quote: okay I'll have the popadoms but I might, I might take them home.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Nachos especial with black beans and cashew cheese, to share
recommendations.reason: A fun communal sharing dish done so well there were no dry layers; the vegan restaurant has since closed and he can't recreate them at home.
recommendations.quote: I guess the reason that I'm mentioning the nachos from Manna is that they did them so well that there were none of these problems
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Fusilli with grilled aubergine, spinach, toasted pine nuts and walnuts and vegan pesto
recommendations.reason: His own easy comfort pasta that he makes about once a week; he walks through the recipe, including wilting spinach in the pasta water.
recommendations.quote: it's, pasta with grilled aubergine, spinach, pine nuts toasted, walnuts toasted and pesto.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Beetroot burger (main course option)
recommendations.reason: His first main course option, because the vegan beetroot burger is very delicious.
recommendations.quote: I would like us to go to Cafe Kino for the beetroot burger. Because it's very delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Vegan dishes (main course option)
recommendations.reason: His second option: a funny, ridiculous vegan restaurant where every dish has an affirmation name like 'I am glorious'; Ed and James saw Moby there.
recommendations.quote: I mean you must have spoken about it then because it's such a funny ridiculous place.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Extra virgin olive oil
recommendations.reason: Too full for a side, he chose olive oil bought in a big tin from a local shop and decanted into a bottle with a pourer.
recommendations.quote: we get a big tin from a local shop here that's like an enormous tin, and then we decant that into a bottle
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Pure homemade kombucha
recommendations.reason: He hasn't drunk alcohol since about 25; he and his boyfriend brew unflavoured kombucha (or James's mum's version).
recommendations.quote: But kombucha, if we're talking about a different drink to water, I would have to say kombucha, no problem.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Boyfriend's courgette chocolate cake with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: His boyfriend's cake made with courgette was the moistest, most delicious thing he's eaten, possibly the best chocolate cake ever.
recommendations.quote: My boyfriend the other day made a chocolate cake out of courgette somehow. It was the most moist delicious thing I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: Simon Amstell

recommendations.item: Vegan doughnuts (jam doughnut)
recommendations.reason: Simon's boyfriend loved a vegan jam doughnut there; James also loves the extravagant doughnuts.
recommendations.quote: Did you get a doughnut from there? Because I love doughnut time!
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 114: Shaparak Khorsandi
episodes.summary: Shaparak Khorsandi orders a lunch of San Pellegrino, a baguette, jumbo prawns barbecued by her old Australian nanny, a pot of garlic mussels with skinny chips and lager, mashed garlic from The Stinking Rose, an espresso martini plus doogh, and 1980s school-dinner chocolate sponge with chocolate sauce.

recommendations.item: Edamame beans with loads of salt (waiting-area nibble)
recommendations.reason: She loves salty edamame as a nibble because it's essentially a civilised way of eating salt.
recommendations.quote: edamame beans because they're just sort of soggy vegetables with tonnes of salt so it's delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (San Pellegrino)
recommendations.reason: She drinks a bottle of very fizzy San Pellegrino every day as her substitute for alcohol.
recommendations.quote: I'm drinking San Pelligrino, which is my sparkling water of choice.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Bog-standard baguette
recommendations.reason: Bread over poppadoms every time; she calls bread the food of the gods.
recommendations.quote: a bread is the food of the gods, no disrespect to popadoms.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Jumbo king prawns barbecued with lots of garlic
recommendations.venue: Cooked by her son's old Australian nanny, Judy
recommendations.reason: She admires how generously Australians cook and feed people, and misses barbecued shrimp from her trips to Australia.
recommendations.quote: I just think Australians just don't muck about with food, they appreciate it, they feed you.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Giant pot of garlic mussels with skinny chips
recommendations.reason: She wanted something fiddly and picky rather than troughing, ideally shared with her funny friend Andy.
recommendations.quote: maybe a giant pot of mussels with some really skinny chips.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Cold lager with the mussels (instead of bread)
recommendations.reason: She argues lager counts as food because it is liquid bread.
recommendations.quote: can I have a cold lager with that.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Bowl of mashed garlic
recommendations.location: North Beach, San Francisco, California, USA
recommendations.reason: A garlic-themed restaurant where they give you a bowl of mashed garlic to spoon straight in; she loves garlic so much she wishes she were made of it.
recommendations.quote: you sit down at this restaurant and they give you a bowl of mashed garlic that you just spoon into your gob.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Espresso martini
recommendations.reason: She loves espresso martinis with all her heart and pictures herself at a bar with friendly people holding one.
recommendations.quote: Espresso martini please. Thank you. I love espresso martinis with all my heart.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Doogh (salty fermented Iranian yoghurt drink with mint)
recommendations.reason: A drink you only love if raised on it; she picked it to bring her Iranian heritage to the meal.
recommendations.quote: anyone that hasn't been raised with it that drinks it always goes ahh it's like sea water, but it is the most delicious thing
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: 1980s school-dinner chocolate sponge with chocolate sauce
recommendations.venue: Her primary school canteen (Montpellier school), served by dinner lady 'Edie'
recommendations.reason: Her family never had puddings at home, so the school chocolate sponge, with an extra helping from a kind dinner lady, was the point of school.
recommendations.quote: that chocolate sponge and chocolate sauce as a child was the entire point of school for me.
recommendations.speaker: Shaparak Khorsandi

recommendations.item: Bucket of mussels with skinny fries
recommendations.reason: Ed's go-to when his parents visited him at the Edinburgh Fringe as a student; the mussels and skinny fries tasted so good.
recommendations.quote: it would always be a bucket of muscles and some skinny fries. And oh god, they tasted so good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 116: Bob Mortimer
episodes.summary: Bob Mortimer time-travels through his meal: crusty bread crusts, an Odeon cinema hot dog, a vindaloo from the New Dewaniam on Camberwell New Road with chips and a shallow-fried turbot, an ice-cold citrusy IPA, and his wife's syrup sponge with custard.

recommendations.item: Still bottled water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water reminds him of Andrews Liver Salts, and tap water can be dreary in temperature and taste.
recommendations.quote: I'll have still, thank you. The stillest of the bottle or the tap. I think I will indulge in the bottle one
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Crusts of a white crusty loaf with olive oil and butter
recommendations.reason: Crust is his favourite part; he eats around the soft middle so he doesn't spoil his appetite, and he wants it in a 1960s restaurant.
recommendations.quote: A white loaf, crusty loaf, because I like the crust best.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Hot dog with Heinz ketchup and mustard swirled together with his finger
recommendations.reason: He and his son are obsessed with the soft, salty, traditional cinema hot dog; he swirls the sauces with a finger and says 'It's good to be alive.'
recommendations.quote: One of my favourite things to eat is an Odeon Cinema hot dog. Me and my son we're obsessed with them
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Chicken vindaloo (or madras) with three poppadoms and beef-dripping chips
recommendations.reason: A perfect vindaloo is his sweet spot, and he trusts the New Dewaniam, circa 1990, to get the heat right.
recommendations.quote: if it's the perfect vindaloo, which I think the New Dewaniam is the best guarantee I can think of, that's what I go for.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Shallow-fried turbot (caught by a fading sportsman like Peter Beardsley)
recommendations.reason: He loves fish and regretted not choosing it for his main, so he takes trout and then turbot on the side.
recommendations.quote: And you know, fuck it, turbot.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Minus-twenty-degree citrusy American-hopped IPA
recommendations.reason: With curry he wants a very cold craft beer with American hops; he drinks them every night.
recommendations.quote: Minus twenty, a citrusy IPA, thank you.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Syrup sponge pudding with custard
recommendations.reason: He has always loved it and his wife makes a superb golden-syrup version; he thinks it beats any crème brûlée.
recommendations.quote: So, I'm going to choose syrup sponge pudding with custard. I've always loved it.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Boost bar in a hollowed-out hot dog baguette
recommendations.reason: An invented treat for the walk home that grew out of James's rollover hot dog story.
recommendations.quote: My instinct is it would be perfect. It would be absolutely, what did you call that, flush at the end of the roll
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

recommendations.item: Craft beers, e.g. the Kiss The Alderman vanilla, coffee and chocolate stout
recommendations.reason: Bob brewed beers with this one-man brewery and thinks it is the best in the country, praising its real, hand-scraped ingredients.
recommendations.quote: a brewery called Alpha State in Kent, just one young lad who's got a lean-to. I believe him to be the best brewery in the country.
recommendations.speaker: Bob Mortimer

episodes.title: Ep 117: Ainsley Harriott
episodes.summary: Ainsley Harriott orders still water in a heavy glass, warm bread with olive oil and rock salt, the tuna tartare with Osetra caviar from the Four Seasons in New York, his own slow-cooked garlic-and-anchovy lamb with cauliflower cheese, an extra-dry gin martini with four olives, and Gary Rhodes's bread and butter pudding.

recommendations.item: Still water, no lemon or cucumber, in a heavy glass
recommendations.reason: He wants plain water with nothing floating in it, served in a nicely weighted glass to set the meal up.
recommendations.quote: Just plain old water, a glass of water, beautiful glass, that really starts off the meal properly.
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Warm bread selection (sourdough) with olive oil and rock salt
recommendations.reason: Warm bread reminds him of his mum's hard dough bread straight from the oven; good bread needs only olive oil and extra salt.
recommendations.quote: My mum used to make her little hard dough bread or something and she'd take it out of the oven and we would just put the butter straight on it
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Tuna tartare with Osetra caviar, diced avocado, chive and caramelised chilli rings
recommendations.reason: He first had it at the Four Seasons in New York, eaten slowly on crackers, alongside a superb Pinot Noir; he loved the decor and the company.
recommendations.quote: My first experience of it was at The Four Seasons in New York and it was very, very beautiful
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Slow-cooked leg of lamb studded with garlic and anchovy paste
recommendations.reason: His own recipe, cooked for at least four hours with stock then crisped up; succulent comfort food that reminds him of his mum's marinades.
recommendations.quote: the thing that identifies with me more than anything else is food that is really succulent and luscious and you want to go back and that's my slow cooked lamb.
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Cauliflower cheese
recommendations.reason: Baked until the cauliflower is soft, with the lamb's tray juices drizzled over; even dairy-avoiders love it.
recommendations.quote: cauliflower cheese, as I said, it just works, doesn't it? And people just love it
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Extra-dry gin martini with four olives, no lemon
recommendations.reason: What he drinks out with his agent; he likes the clean, steady feel of a spirit drink.
recommendations.quote: If I'm out with my agent, it's going to be a Martini, gin Martini, extra dry
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Gary Rhodes's bread and butter pudding with crème anglaise
recommendations.location: London, UK (Gary Rhodes's restaurant, not named)
recommendations.reason: Eaten at the restaurant of his late friend Gary Rhodes, cooked in a water bath and glazed with apricot; he gets emotional remembering him.
recommendations.quote: his bread and butter pudding was to absolutely die for, little bit of crème anglaise
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

recommendations.item: Late-night meals and drinks with chef Tony Tobin
recommendations.reason: He fondly recalls visiting his mate Tony Tobin's restaurant and drinking late with George Best in the corner.
recommendations.quote: when I'd go down Reigate to see my mate, The Dining Room. Tony Tobin, who was a mate, still a pal of mine.
recommendations.speaker: Ainsley Harriott

episodes.title: Ep 118: Edgar Wright (Live at Royal Festival Hall)
episodes.summary: Edgar Wright's live menu is iced still water, Spanish bread with garlicky aioli, Busaba's squid, haddock and chips from Fission Chips in St Agnes, Little Dom's grilled summer corn, a gin martini then amaretto on ice, and River Café chocolate nemesis cake followed by a cheeseboard.

recommendations.item: Still water with ice, no lemon
recommendations.reason: He wants plain still water with ice and hates lemon being added or warm sparkling water.
recommendations.quote: Still. Still, still, still. With ice... Also, please no lemon in the still water.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Spanish bread with lots of really garlicky aioli
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms were ruined by sad late-night takeaways; he loved the bread with heaps of aioli on a recent trip to Spain.
recommendations.quote: I just went to Spain, actually, and the bread there, they always have, like, tons and tons of aioli. Really garlicky aioli. That's the best.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Grilled squid ('crack squid') in an inky sauce with peppercorns and garlic
recommendations.reason: He'll order from Busaba just to get this addictive squid; James is a huge fan too.
recommendations.quote: if I see it on Deliveroo, I will go to that restaurant just to get the starter and that's the squid at Busaba
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Burrata from the mozzarella bar
recommendations.reason: A contender for starter: an LA restaurant with a mozzarella bar of nothing but burratas.
recommendations.quote: There's a place in LA, Osteria Mozza, that has a mozzarella bar that's just all burrata's. It's, like, it's too decadent before anything even starts.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Fried haddock and chips with lots of salt and vinegar
recommendations.reason: After a week of poor food while writing alone in Cornwall, his last-night fish and chips from the local chippy were a joyful, non-sad solo takeaway.
recommendations.quote: the fish and chips were orgasmic and I just, kind of, had my little Ratatouille moment
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Spaghetti and meatballs
recommendations.reason: His runner-up main: he can't not order the spaghetti and meatballs here or at the Chateau Marmont.
recommendations.quote: There's two places in LA, actually, that I just-, I can't not have it when I'm there. Have you ever been to that restaurant Little Dom's
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Spaghetti and meatballs
recommendations.location: Sunset Boulevard, West Hollywood, Los Angeles, USA
recommendations.reason: The other LA spot whose spaghetti and meatballs he always has.
recommendations.quote: the spaghetti and meatballs at the Chateau Marmont hotel or, like, Little Dom's, both of which I can't not have it
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Grilled summer corn (a big plate of sweetcorn with garlic, butter and cheese)
recommendations.reason: Comfort food: a whole plate of buttery, cheesy sweetcorn he shovels down himself, echoing eating sweetcorn from the tin as a kid.
recommendations.quote: it is literally like a big plate of sweetcorn, with, like, garlic and butter and cheese. And I will, like, shovel that down my gob without anybody else touching it
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Corn ribs with kombu seasoning
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about the deep-fried corn ribs he and James had at Fallow.
recommendations.quote: We've had some from a place called Fallow, where you chop them and it's basically deep-frying bits of sweetcorn and then they've got this amazing Kombu seasoning
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Kebabs (with plenty of vinegar)
recommendations.location: Parsons Green, Fulham, south west London, UK
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls living near this kebab shop, where his girlfriend was known as the vinegar lady.
recommendations.quote: we used to live near an amazing kebab shop called Kebab Kid in south west London
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Gin martini with a twist of lemon
recommendations.reason: His main drink: a concentrated, sophisticated way to get drunk quickly.
recommendations.quote: Main drink would be a gin Martini with a twist of lemon, which I think is, like, a really, highly concentrated, sophisticated way to get really drunk really quick.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Amaretto on ice (end-of-night drink)
recommendations.reason: His favourite late-night drink, like liquid marzipan, to close the evening.
recommendations.quote: my favourite late night drink is an amaretto on ice... It's basically like liquid marzipan.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Chocolate nemesis cake with ice cream
recommendations.reason: A sucker for anything chocolatey, he picks the River Café's gooey, fondant-like chocolate nemesis cake (ordered with ice cream).
recommendations.quote: let's say a chocolate nemesis cake which is pretty amazing. There's a few, the River Café does chocolate nemesis cake.
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard of mostly hard cheeses with quince jelly
recommendations.reason: Treats cheese as a separate course after dessert, with plenty of quince.
recommendations.quote: I would like more hard cheeses than soft cheeses... And it's got to have the little quince cubes
recommendations.speaker: Edgar Wright

episodes.title: Ep 119: Jamie Oliver
episodes.summary: Jamie Oliver chose cold still water, a spread of South Indian poppadoms with dips, an avocado prawn cocktail, a curry feast (Rasa-style crab curry, tandoori chicken, green spinach paneer) with naan and paratha, a triple single malt whisky by the fire, and his mum's/nan's trifle.

recommendations.item: Cold still tap water (curing a hangover on the first sip)
recommendations.reason: He thinks sparkling water just gives you wind and loves cold tap water on a hangover.
recommendations.quote: Still. I have no respect for sparkling, it just gives you wind.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Assorted South Indian poppadoms (celebration, piped and battered) with coconut, garlic-lemon pickle and tamarind dips
recommendations.reason: He did a three-week stage at the South Indian restaurant Rasa, learned about many poppadom styles there, and says it is still worth a visit.
recommendations.quote: By the way, Razza's still going and it's East London. Definitely worth a visit, really good value.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Avocado prawn cocktail
recommendations.reason: Aged eight in his parents' pub, a chef excitedly put the newly available avocado into a prawn cocktail and it felt like a miracle; he wants his memory of avocados erased to rediscover it.
recommendations.quote: I remember eating that and thinking I totally understand, this is a miracle.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Curry feast: Keralan crab curry, tandoori-style chicken and paneer in green spinach sauce with rice
recommendations.reason: The crab curry he had while working at Rasa, with black pepper, curry leaves, mustard seeds and coconut, blew his mind; he'd mix it with chicken and paneer curries.
recommendations.quote: when I worked in Rasa, they did this crab curry which was like nothing I'd ever
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Naan and paratha
recommendations.reason: He loves naan but says flaky, beaten paratha works like an edible fork for scooping curry.
recommendations.quote: There's this bread that is potentially better than naan called a paratha
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Triple shot of fruity single malt Scotch whisky with an ice cube
recommendations.reason: A membership his wife gave him taught him to love single-cask, not-smoky, not-peaty whisky, enjoyed by the fire with music once the kids are in bed.
recommendations.quote: my favourite drink would probably be a triple shot of really good, single malt whisky, definitely quite fruity
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Craft beers with the curry (e.g. Zot, Posh, Slag)
recommendations.reason: A little beer shop in his town sources great Belgian, German and Dutch beers he thinks would be amazing with curry.
recommendations.quote: I've got a little beer shop that's opened in my little town and he sources beers, great beers from everywhere.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Mum's (nan's) trifle with Bird's custard, tinned mandarins, jelly and blancmange
recommendations.reason: The old-fashioned family trifle makes him feel the world is okay and is the one thing he can't stop eating.
recommendations.quote: It would be my mum's, which by default is my nan's trifle.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Chips with prawns and Port Isaac crab and kimchi-sriracha mayo
recommendations.reason: His college friend's outdoor summer street-food spots on Cornish farms served him chips with crab and prawns that he thought was genius.
recommendations.quote: He's got a couple of them called Craftworks and he does like street food... I ate it and thought he was a genius.
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

recommendations.item: Sweet potato fries topped with clam chowder
recommendations.reason: James still thinks about the chowder-topped fries he had there in 2017.
recommendations.quote: we went to a place called extra fancy and they serve us these sweet potato fries and they just dumped clam chowder on the top of it. It was so good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Chocolate Nemesis
recommendations.reason: Where he worked; its Chocolate Nemesis was so loved that customers took leftovers home in his foil 'Prada' handbags.
recommendations.quote: this specific dessert called a Chocolate Nemesis which was, like, the most incredible expression of chocolate
recommendations.speaker: Jamie Oliver

episodes.title: Ep 120: Miriam Margolyes
episodes.summary: Miriam Margolyes chooses Eastern European Jewish comfort food: chopped liver from Panzer's, chicken soup with matzo balls, her mother's fried plaice with braised vegetables, a green salad, a Virgin Mary and coffee and chocolate ice cream from Nardulli's.

recommendations.item: Still water with cucumber or lemon slices
recommendations.reason: She gave up sparkling because it made her fart; likes lemon slices squeezed with a spoon.
recommendations.quote: Still water, with either cucumber in it or slices of lemon. I used to have sparkling but it made me fart to much
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: 'Serious bread': heavy sourdough or good brown bread
recommendations.reason: She dislikes challah and flimsy supermarket bread and wants something heavy with goodness in it.
recommendations.quote: I like, serious bread, which would be a heavy sourdough or a brown, a good brown bread that's what I like
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Chopped chicken liver, roughly chopped
recommendations.reason: Her mother made it brilliantly; Panzer's in St John's Wood is where she has had good chopped liver.
recommendations.quote: I think there's a restaurant in St John's Wood called Panzer's, that's where I've had it and it was good.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Round crispbread to go with the chopped liver
recommendations.reason: She loves the big round crispbread from the IKEA shop, 'like a very craggy ryvita' - the only reason to go to IKEA.
recommendations.quote: they also have a big round crisp bread wrapped in paper. I don't know what it's called but its absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Soup course: chicken soup with matzo balls, carrots, celery, onion, neck, heart and pupik
recommendations.reason: Her favourite soup, a hearty Jewish chicken soup rather than a clear consomme; her mother made matzo balls with ground almonds.
recommendations.quote: I don't know any Jewish person who wouldn't immediately want chicken soup with matzo balls
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Mummy's fried plaice in olive oil with matzo meal batter
recommendations.reason: Her late mother was splendid at it; she chose this over roast chicken.
recommendations.quote: I love fried plaice. That's what mummy always used to do and she was really splendid at it.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Fried plaice / fish and chips
recommendations.reason: Her go-to fish and chip shop for fantastic fried fish, her first pick before choosing her mother's.
recommendations.quote: There's a shop in Mitcham, a fish and chip shop called Mitcham Plaice, like the fish, and they just to do fantastic fried fish.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Roast potatoes, small frozen peas, braised celery and braised carrots
recommendations.reason: Classic accompaniments to the plaice; she champions braised celery.
recommendations.quote: And then I'd like roast potatoes, frozen peas, small ones, braised celery and braised carrots.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Celery remoulade and carottes rapees
recommendations.reason: Her favourite restaurant in London: a former hotel ballroom with great service and ambience and a gorgeous celery remoulade.
recommendations.quote: My favourite restaurant in London is called Brasserie Zedel... they do a celery remoulade which is absolutely gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Salad course: green salad of romaine, endive and rocket with homemade French dressing
recommendations.reason: She insists on a salad; the garlicky dressing is the one thing she makes herself.
recommendations.quote: I like a French dressing on the side, olive oil, cider vinegar, bit of mustard, bit of salt and pepper, and lots of garlic.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Virgin Mary, no ice, plenty of Worcestershire, lemon and celery
recommendations.reason: She doesn't drink alcohol and loathes elderflower, but loves a Bloody Mary without vodka.
recommendations.quote: A virgin Mary. No ice, plenty of Worce stershire, slice of lemon, bit of celery sticking out. Gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Coffee and dark chocolate ice cream
recommendations.location: The Pavement, Clapham Common, London, UK
recommendations.reason: The best ice cream she has ever tasted; she buys big tubs to share with chums and says it converts coffee ice cream haters.
recommendations.quote: there is an ice cream parlour on Clapham Common called Nardulli's. Nardulli's, and they make the best ice cream I've ever tasted.
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Thai food
recommendations.reason: A small husband-and-wife Thai restaurant with delicious food.
recommendations.quote: there's a very good Thai restaurant called Cher, Cher Thai. C,H,E,R, 22 North Street, Clapham. Just a small place, husband and wife
recommendations.speaker: Miriam Margolyes

recommendations.item: Porterhouse steak, pork ribs, chips and pickled red cabbage (cook-at-home kit)
recommendations.reason: The hosts thank Hawksmoor for a cook-at-home box and rave about the ribs, steak and slaw.
recommendations.quote: I texted you probably after every single chew that I had because it was so delicious. The pork ribs
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 121: Sarah Keyworth
episodes.summary: Sarah Keyworth goes all-in on carbs: a post-swim chip cob, crispy duck pancakes plus Nottingham tapas, her 'stolen' mac and cheese, Flesh & Buns tenderstem broccoli, bottomless Campo Viejo and just a mouthful of someone else's dessert.

recommendations.item: Both still and sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She wants both on the table: still to rehydrate for a boozy evening and sparkling so she doesn't miss out on fizz.
recommendations.quote: I like both and I want it all on the table.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Chip cob (chip butty in a bread roll) with loads of butter and ketchup
recommendations.reason: A childhood memory of the chip cob she got after swimming at the pool in Edwinstowe, eaten nicely tired after a swim.
recommendations.quote: It's from a swimming pool in Walthamstow. Walthamstow, no, Edwinstowe.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Crispy duck pancakes with hoisin sauce and cucumber, all you can eat
recommendations.reason: Her favourite treat from the rare birthday Chinese takeaways as a child, before she became vegetarian.
recommendations.quote: when we got Chinese takeaway, my favourite thing would be duck pancakes with hoisin sauce, and little strips of cucumber.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Triple-cooked patatas bravas (starter tapas)
recommendations.reason: She loves tapas and adds this Nottingham bar's triple-cooked bravas to her starter.
recommendations.quote: there's a tapas place in Nottingham, it's called Bar Iberico, and they do triple cooked patatas bravas.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Crispy chilli and ginger glazed cauliflower (starter tapas)
recommendations.reason: A sweet, salty, glazed popcorn-style cauliflower from the same tapas place.
recommendations.quote: It's like a, sort of, popcorn cauliflower, but it's sweet, and salty, and glazed, and it's just fucking great.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: 'Stolen' mac and cheese with three cheeses, breadcrumbs and crispy onions
recommendations.reason: She still makes an American ex-girlfriend's mum's recipe years after the break-up, now improved with crispy onions.
recommendations.quote: I have continued in the six, or seven years since I was with this girl, I've continued to make her mums mac and cheese. So, it's stolen.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Smoky barbecued tenderstem broccoli with orange zest
recommendations.reason: The best broccoli she's ever had; she has been known to order two portions.
recommendations.quote: it's, sort of, smoky and barbecued with orange zest on top, and it's the best broccoli I've ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Campo Viejo red wine, bottles kept coming
recommendations.reason: Her whole extended family became loyal to this affordable, tasty Rioja, and she wants a bottle on entry.
recommendations.quote: They do a good job. They do what they do and they do it well.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: A mouthful of someone else's dessert
recommendations.reason: Not a sweet-toothed person, she only wants to pinch a bite of whatever someone else ordered.
recommendations.quote: I don't want a dessert, thanks. I'd have a mouthful of someone else's.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Espresso martini (if pushed at dessert)
recommendations.reason: If everyone else has dessert and she's pressured, she'd have an espresso martini in its dessert-like glass.
recommendations.quote: if I was pushed, I'd have an espresso Martini.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Mac and cheese with crispy onions
recommendations.reason: The Fringe food van whose crispy-onion mac and cheese inspired her own topping.
recommendations.quote: There's a food van at Underbelly bit of the Edinburgh Fringe Festival called Mac Shack, and they do crispy onions on their mac and cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Sausage and mash with unlimited gravy
recommendations.reason: Her comfort-food favourite at the Fringe, sitting at a tiny table on a rainy day.
recommendations.quote: I'm a big fan of mums in Edinburgh, the sausage and mash
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Italian food
recommendations.reason: She did a Fringe show there, befriended the owner Franco and is treated like family every year.
recommendations.quote: I'm good friends with the owner of Ciao Roma, his name's Franco
recommendations.speaker: Sarah Keyworth

recommendations.item: Japanese food
recommendations.reason: Ed's regular Japanese spot near Mum's during the Fringe (name as heard; uncertain).
recommendations.quote: There's a good Japanese restaurant just down the road from Mum's, I think it's called Kuyama as well, where I go a lot during the Fringe.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Bang bang cauliflower
recommendations.reason: Ed calls it one of the best chain side dishes and Sarah has ordered two at once.
recommendations.quote: Huge shout out to the bang bang cauliflower at Wagamama, which is, I think, one of the best chain restaurant side dishes out there.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Butterscotch gelato
recommendations.reason: James was already a fan and rates their butterscotch as the best around.
recommendations.quote: the butterscotch one is, like, just sublime, best butterscotch ice cream out there in my humble opinion
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Chicken kebab with peanut butter (ManiLife collaboration)
recommendations.reason: Ed had an incredible collab meal there including peanut-butter chicken kebab and aubergine ceviche.
recommendations.quote: I had an amazing chicken kebab with, like, peanut butter and a broccoli with tahini peanut butter dressing... It was an incredible meal
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 122: Meera Syal
episodes.summary: Meera Syal chooses sparkling water with lime, crusty bread, Dishoom's aloo papri chaat, a Barcelona beachside seafood paella, samphire, a Dishoom rose lassi and an Eton mess with mango and passion fruit.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with ice and thin slices of lime
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water makes her feel like she is out, as she wouldn't have it at home.
recommendations.quote: It just makes me feel like I'm out because I wouldn't have it at home.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Crusty French loaf or warm rolls with melting butter
recommendations.reason: She's a bread freak who loves crusty bread with a soft centre that steams when broken open.
recommendations.quote: I very much like crusty bread with a soft, yielding centre.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Aloo papri chaat
recommendations.reason: Indian street food with layers of potato, chickpea, yoghurt, tamarind and crispy papri; she makes her own but rates Dishoom's highly.
recommendations.quote: But, Dishoom. Dishoom do great chaat.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Seafood paella with crispy socarrat
recommendations.reason: The best paella she's ever had, at an unnamed beachside restaurant Barcelona friends took her to; she still thinks about it.
recommendations.quote: It was a restaurant right next to the beach in Barcelona. Barcelona friends had taken us there and said, 'You will never eat better paella.'
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Samphire with lemon and garlic
recommendations.reason: She discovered it at a fish restaurant in Brighton and loves that it tastes of the sea.
recommendations.quote: And, I ate it and I thought, I'm eating the sea.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Rose lassi
recommendations.reason: Her go-to order at Dishoom, a rose-flavoured yoghurt drink so rich it's like a pudding.
recommendations.quote: It's rose lassi. Rose-flavoured lassi and you get it at Dishoom.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Eton mess with chewy meringue, summer fruits, passion fruit and mango ('Ro-Mess Mangonathan')
recommendations.reason: Her favourite dessert, as long as the meringue is chewy rather than dry, with tart passion fruit.
recommendations.quote: It's got to have that chewy, not quite cooked centre.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

recommendations.item: Chaat bombs
recommendations.reason: James became addicted to Mowgli's chaat bombs and sought out branches while on tour.
recommendations.quote: I was really addicted to it. I was then, like, obsessed with where Mowgli's where around the UK
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Shrimpster burger with deep-fried shrimp and samphire
recommendations.location: Southbank Centre food market, London, UK
recommendations.reason: James had a delicious samphire-loaded shrimp burger at the food market outside the Royal Festival Hall.
recommendations.quote: I got the Shrimpster burger that had, like, a bunch of deep-fried shrimp in it and then loads of samphire in a burger. It was so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Prawn cocktail (her first prawn)
recommendations.location: Near the bus station, Walsall, UK
recommendations.reason: Where she ate her first prawn at eighteen, a fond memory of feeling she had arrived.
recommendations.quote: I remember my first prawn, it was at the Acropolis Greek restaurant in Walsall near the bus station. And, I thought, I've arrived.
recommendations.speaker: Meera Syal

episodes.title: Ep 123: Jeff Rosenstock
episodes.summary: Vegetarian musician Jeff Rosenstock picks sparkling water in a metal cup, Cheesecake Factory brown bread, Xi'an Famous Foods cold skin noodles, Vinnie's pineapple and veggie spare rib pizza, a Soy and Sake volcano roll, Other Half Green City IPA and a Friendly's Wattamelon Roll.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a little ice in a metal cup
recommendations.reason: He wants sparkling water in the kind of cold metal cups served at Joy in LA, with about a third of ice.
recommendations.quote: Okay. So, metal cup, and now that it's in that metal cup, give me a little bit of ice.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Brown bread with butter
recommendations.reason: A go-to chain on tour because it has something for everyone in his vegetarian/vegan band, and the brown bread in a basket with butter is great.
recommendations.quote: I'm going chain restaurant, the brown bread from the Cheesecake Factory. Fuck it... It's sick. It's great.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Cold skin noodles
recommendations.location: New York City, USA (Brooklyn and Queens branches; started in Flushing, Queens)
recommendations.reason: Hand-pulled western Chinese noodles with a very specific chilli oil, bean sprouts and seitan; a cheap lunch he walks over to get.
recommendations.quote: You see them pull them and slap them on a steel table and rip them, and it's got a really very specific chilli oil
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Mashed potato pizza (runner-up starter)
recommendations.reason: An honourable mention: individual deep-dish pizza with mashed potato, cheddar, bacon bits and sour cream.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to Pizza Uno and I'm getting their mashed potato pizza as the starter... Because it's fucking tight
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Two slices of pizza with pineapple, vegetarian spare rib and a drizzle of sweet chilli sauce
recommendations.reason: He rates Vinnie's as the best slice in New York, with great specials and a stoner staff who once added sweet chilli sauce for him.
recommendations.quote: Vinnie's is the best slice for sure.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Laksa with fake meats (runner-up main)
recommendations.reason: His runner-up main: Malaysian coconut curry noodle soup with fake meats.
recommendations.quote: There's a place in Sydney, Australia called the Golden Lotus which has a bunch of fake meats and stuff in it which is good
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Tofu laksa
recommendations.reason: Another laksa option he likes, done with tofu.
recommendations.quote: there's just a regular ass place in Melbourne called Viet Rose which just does it with tofu. It's good.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.location: Near Montrose Ave L stop, Brooklyn, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: Near where he used to live; its standard slice is as good as Vinnie's or even a touch better.
recommendations.quote: their standard is equally as good if not even just a touch better, but I don't know if that's just nostalgia shit.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Fancy pizza
recommendations.reason: One of his picks for a fancy pizza.
recommendations.quote: if I'm going for a fancy ass pizza I'll go to either Paulie Gee's in Greenpoint or Roberta's in Bushwick
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: Jeff's other fancy pizza pick; James has been several times and calls it amazing, despite a very sweet sour beer.
recommendations.quote: I love Roberta's, I've been there a few times. It's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Pepperoni and cheese slices
recommendations.location: Orchard Street, Lower East Side, New York, USA
recommendations.reason: Ed had a pepperoni then a cheese slice there and found it really cool and nice.
recommendations.quote: It was really cool. Yes, it was really nice.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: 99 cent pizza slice
recommendations.reason: Jeff says the 99-cent slices are also good.
recommendations.quote: You didn't go to, like, Two Brothers, which is 99 cent pizza, which is also good.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Volcano roll (vegan sushi) on wilted spinach
recommendations.reason: A now-closed vegan sushi place doing imitation spicy tuna and volcano rolls better than anywhere; he was sad it shut.
recommendations.quote: Nobody does this anywhere near as good,' but it's gone, so that would be my side dish.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Mango habanero ('mango fire') cheese
recommendations.reason: He'd put its spicy mango habanero cheese on his barbecue burger.
recommendations.quote: There's this place called the Mouse House in Wisconsin that has mango habanero cheese. It's called mango fire cheese. So fucking good.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Restaurant with metal cups
recommendations.reason: He calls it great, awesome and not too expensive, and loves its cold metal water cups.
recommendations.quote: there's this restaurant Joy in LA, which is great. If you have the time, it's fucking awesome and it's not too expensive
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Green City IPA by Other Half Brewing
recommendations.reason: A 7-8% hazy IPA he has only had at the Alamo Drafthouse cinema, his treat night out with a veggie burger and a film.
recommendations.quote: Every time I'm just like, 'This is the best beer' and I've never really seen it anywhere else other than there
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Unsweetened ginger-peach green iced tea and hot tea
recommendations.reason: Brought throughout the meal by Ice-T in the dream restaurant.
recommendations.quote: I've been having a nice unsweetened gingery, peachy, greeny, somewhere in that flavour palette tea
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Wattamelon Roll
recommendations.location: Chain: various US branches and supermarkets
recommendations.reason: A childhood ice cream chain favourite: lime sherbet rind, watermelon sherbet and chocolate chip seeds, perfect on a warm day.
recommendations.quote: the watermelon part is watermelon sherbet, and instead of seeds it's got little dark chocolate chips.
recommendations.speaker: Jeff Rosenstock

recommendations.item: Special salmon skin roll
recommendations.reason: James praises its salmon skin roll.
recommendations.quote: There's a sushi place called Edo in Crystal Palace in London that does a special salmon skin roll... it is so good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Fake duck rolls (vegan sushi)
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends this vegan sushi place's fake duck rolls.
recommendations.quote: There's a place in Brighton called Happy Maki which is a vegan sushi place that does fake duck... Fake duck rolls. So good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 124: Michelle Keegan
episodes.summary: Michelle Keegan's bread-heavy menu is still tap water, her neighbours' doorstop bread and butter, gambas pil pil, pesto linguine from a café in Genoa with cheesy garlic bread, a build-your-own chip butty, a run of drinks from piña colada to Bread & Butter Chardonnay, and a cheeseboard.

recommendations.item: Still tap water (a pint by the bed)
recommendations.reason: She finds fizzy water gassy and not thirst-quenching, and keeps a pint of tap water by her bed to drink with her eyes shut.
recommendations.quote: It's a pint. Not a mug, not a cup. A pint of water.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Thick doorstop-cut crusty bread with real butter
recommendations.reason: As a three- or four-year-old she climbed over the fence to her neighbours, who gave her thick-cut bread with real butter, unlike the margarine at home.
recommendations.quote: I remember the cut was so thick, it was just like a door stopper. She used to use real butter that my mum and dad never used to have.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Gambas pil pil with warm baguette for dipping
recommendations.reason: She loves tapas and the sizzling garlic and chilli prawns, dipping fresh warm baguette into the olive oil straight away.
recommendations.quote: it's like a garlic and chilli king prawn dish in sizzling olive oil that I would have with freshly made bread, still warm, that I can dip into the olive oil.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Spanish tapas
recommendations.reason: A family-run Spanish restaurant near her with no bookings and no phone, always full, with food she calls insane and fresh.
recommendations.quote: It's a family ran Spanish restaurant and the food in there is insane... it's called San Juan. San Juan in Chorlton
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Pesto linguine with parmesan and chilli flakes
recommendations.reason: Filming Who Do You Think You Are? in Genoa, where her ancestors came from, she had the best pesto pasta of her life at a tiny café next to her hotel, served by a singing, larger-than-life waiter.
recommendations.quote: there was, like, this little tiny café next to our hotel... and it was the best pesto pasta I've ever had in my entire life, ever.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Cheesy garlic bread on a thin pizza-style base
recommendations.location: Near her home, Greater Manchester area, UK (uncertain)
recommendations.reason: An extra side with her pasta; a local Italian makes it thin with crisp edges and just the right garlic and cheese.
recommendations.quote: There's a good Italian actually, near me, called San Giovanni... they just get it so right in that restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Build-your-own chip butty: chippy chips, Warburtons thick sliced bread with Lurpak, curry sauce, gravy and mayo
recommendations.reason: She makes a one-layer chip butty, squashes it flat, then dips it in gravy, curry sauce and mayo in turn.
recommendations.quote: One layer because you can taste the salt and vinegar, you can taste the gravy, you can taste the butter, the thin.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Creamy piña colada (before the meal)
recommendations.reason: Her pre-meal 'amuse-bouche' drink, which has to be properly creamy rather than juice.
recommendations.quote: I'd have a pina colada but I like it to be like James said a creamy one. I hate when it's been made and it's, like, juice.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Orange cordial with ice (during the meal)
recommendations.reason: She doesn't like to drink much while eating, so wants something easy to wash the food down.
recommendations.quote: You know what I'd have while I'm eating? A nice orange cordial. Because it's an easy drink, it's easy to drink.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Picante cocktail (tequila, lime and chilli)
recommendations.reason: Her top cocktail since discovering it this year; she likes its heat and savoury, clean taste.
recommendations.quote: for me, Picanti has to be my top choice as a cocktail.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Bread & Butter oaky vanilla Chardonnay (with dessert)
recommendations.reason: She is the only one of her friends who drinks Chardonnay and found this oaky one at Majestic, before realising it is called Bread and Butter.
recommendations.quote: With Chardonnay I found a really nice one from Majestic Wines... called bread and butter.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Cheeseboard: Camembert, truffle Brie, applewood smoked, Gorgonzola, quince, chutney and raw rosemary sprigs
recommendations.reason: She's a 'savoury gal' who always orders a cheeseboard in restaurants, to James's fury after she beat him on Bake Off.
recommendations.quote: At the end of the meal, I like to have a nice sip of wine with some Camembert.
recommendations.speaker: Michelle Keegan

recommendations.item: Grapow sub and kimchi cheese toasties
recommendations.reason: James has had many subs there while working nearby and raves about the wet, spicy Grapow minced pork sub and the kimchi toasties.
recommendations.quote: round the corner is this place called Dom's Subs and I have had so many subs from there. Absolutely amazing. The Grapow is my favourite.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 125: Ed Sheeran
episodes.summary: Ed Sheeran's menu: still water, poppadoms with mango chutney, medium fatty tuna nigiri from The Araki, vodka rigatoni from his own Bertie Blossoms, a bowl of fat chips, a pint of Asahi then Burgundy and Bordeaux, and apple strudel.

recommendations.item: Still water (sparkling with lemon on nights he's not drinking)
recommendations.reason: He normally picks still, but orders sparkling with lemon when he's staying sober so people assume it's a gin and tonic.
recommendations.quote: you can go out for a night out, have a squeeze of lemon and sparkling water and no one comes up to you and goes, 'Why aren't you drinking?'
recommendations.speaker: Ed Sheeran

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney
recommendations.reason: He never fills up on bread before a restaurant meal but always eats the poppadoms, mainly with mango chutney.
recommendations.quote: In a restaurant, I would never eat bread on a table... But I would always have poppadoms.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Sheeran

recommendations.item: Mango chutney, butter chicken with rice, and cook-at-home kits
recommendations.reason: He's been going for seven or eight years, always piles into the mango chutney, and sends friends with new babies its meal kits for a date night at home.
recommendations.quote: there's a really fantastic Indian restaurant I go to in London called Gymkhana
recommendations.speaker: Ed Sheeran

recommendations.item: Medium fatty tuna nigiri (omakase)
recommendations.reason: He and his wife go to this roughly ten-seat omakase counter for their anniversary. He loves having the choices taken out of his hands and calls it his favourite restaurant in the world.
recommendations.quote: It's one of these places where... it's a wait to get into so when you're there, you really, really appreciate it.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Sheeran

recommendations.item: Spicy vodka rigatoni
recommendations.location: Portobello Road, Notting Hill, London, UK
recommendations.reason: He first had vodka rigatoni at Carbone in the US and put it on the menu at his own Notting Hill bar. He calls it his favourite pasta in London.
recommendations.quote: I'd say it's my favourite pasta in London, and I'm not just saying that because it's my place
recommendations.speaker: Ed Sheeran
