recommendations.reason: The only Chinese in the countryside near her but excellent for vegan food.
recommendations.quote: It has, like, no rights being good but it's excellent, especially for vegan stuff.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Steamed rice with three roast meats (belly pork, char siu, roast duck) and deep-fried king prawn rice paper rolls ('prawn dicks')
recommendations.reason: A now-closed Manchester Chinese with Lazy Susans, dim sum until three and unbeatable roast meats; venue not named.
recommendations.quote: it's just called, like, 'Meat roasted three ways.' ... it's so delicious and succulent
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Plant-based Chicken Royale
recommendations.reason: Admits she is clinically addicted to it because it's deliberately spongy, salty, shit-chicken perfection.
recommendations.quote: clinically addicted to the plant based Chicken Royale from Burger King.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Flavoured mayos incl. tarragon mayo
recommendations.reason: Small-business vegan tarragon mayo bought at a garden centre shop; a shop worker later gave her a jar.
recommendations.quote: we just take a punt on tarragon mayo from What A Pickle!
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Kottu
recommendations.reason: Had it on holiday in Sri Lanka in 2019: chopped paratha stir-fried with vegetables and spices, chewy like meat, about GBP2.
recommendations.quote: it comes out, kind of, chewy like meat. So, it feels like you're getting meat but you're not and it's so delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Dwynwen strawberry beer
recommendations.reason: A syrupy strawberry beer from a small Anglesey brewery, named after the Welsh patron saint of love.
recommendations.quote: it's a strawberry beer from Bragdy Mona, Mona brewery on the island and it's really delicious
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Dark Matter brownies (mint, raspberry, marmalade; cherry wished for)
recommendations.reason: Vegan mail-order brownies, dense, gooey and crispy at the edges.
recommendations.quote: I love Dark Matter brownies so, so much. ... They are so gooey and good and they're vegan as well.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Stollen, mum's marzipan Christmas cake and clotted cream
recommendations.reason: A Christmassy slider of stollen and her mum's boozy cherry-brandy-soaked cake with clotted cream.
recommendations.quote: it's really moist and boozy and that smell of like that cake-y boozy smell is so lovely.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Truffle baking camembert (vegan)
recommendations.reason: A vegan cheese shop run by Welsh women; they ordered six of the bakeable truffle camemberts after trying one.
recommendations.quote: they do a Camembert that you can bake that's truffle flavoured and we ordered six of them
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Brazilian rodizio buffet
recommendations.reason: Loves the red/green card system and the buffet in the middle of this Brazilian grill.
recommendations.quote: the Bem Brasil ones, in Manchester, the buffet in the middle, absolutely banging and doesn't need to be.
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Dessert supper club
recommendations.reason: A little cafe that ran an eight or nine course dessert supper club, including a cookie fry-up with marzipan beans.
recommendations.quote: They had a fry up made of cookies and stuff. It was wild and the baked beans were marzipan
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

recommendations.item: Nokota beer
recommendations.reason: Says it is absolutely amazing and that Ed would love it.
recommendations.quote: it's called Nokota and it's absolutely amazing
recommendations.speaker: Kiri Pritchard-McLean

episodes.title: Ep 146: Jamali Maddix
episodes.summary: Jamali Maddix's eclectic menu: still water, poppadoms with chutney, a FEBO croquette in a white roll, alligator and shrimp cheesecake from Jacques-Imo's in New Orleans, hand-cut chips from a now-closed Bethnal Green cafe, berry lemonade and trifle.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He hates sparkling water - it never quenched his thirst - and wants still water just to lubricate the throat while eating.
recommendations.quote: I think if you drink sparkling water, you're mental. I think you're sick.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney and the green dip (plus the other dips to look at)
recommendations.reason: Bread is already a big part of his diet, so poppadoms feel like a treat - hot with a snap.
recommendations.quote: there's something about poppadoms. They're hot, the snap on it.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Bread
recommendations.reason: He loves the bread at Harvester and grew up on its early bird specials and Rocky Horror sundae - nostalgic British comfort.
recommendations.quote: Do you know what my favourite bread is? When I go Harvester. Oh, I'll eat so much bread at Harvester.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Dutch beef/veal ragout croquette in a white bread roll with hot mustard
recommendations.reason: Dutch fast-food bar food he loves; get it from the FEBO hot-food windows, or ask at the front for a freshly cooked one.
recommendations.quote: my starter, would be a croquette in which they put like a little white bread hot dog roll. You get them from FEBO.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Alligator and shrimp cheesecake
recommendations.location: Oak Street, Uptown, New Orleans, Louisiana, USA
recommendations.reason: Several locals told him to go to this heaving spot when he was gigging in New Orleans; the savoury Cajun-spiced cheesecake was insanely good.
recommendations.quote: they had a thing called alligator and shrimp cheesecake and I'm like, 'I'm going for it.' It was fucking delicious man.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Fried chicken
recommendations.location: French Quarter, New Orleans, Louisiana, USA
recommendations.reason: Another New Orleans recommendation for delicious fried chicken.
recommendations.quote: Coop's. Great. Coop's has like fried chicken, delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe udon
recommendations.reason: Ed had a fantastic cacio e pepe udon at this David Chang restaurant.
recommendations.quote: At a restaurant called Nishi in New York, which is a David Chang restaurant... It was fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Deep dish pizza
recommendations.reason: Jamali rates a slice of Pizza Hut deep dish as the best pizza in the world; Ed agrees about the large deep-dish pepperoni feast.
recommendations.quote: Best pizza, deep dish, Pizza Hut. You ain't beating that bruv.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Tater tots with cheese and bacon, cocktails, hot dogs
recommendations.location: St Marks Place, East Village, New York City, USA
recommendations.reason: Ed loved the hidden cocktail bar reached through the phone booth in Crif Dogs, with great cocktails and bowls of loaded tater tots.
recommendations.quote: It's this beautiful little cocktail bar but, then, also, you can get this massive bowl of tater tots with cheese and bacon
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Handmade cafe food - real chicken nuggets, homemade beans, potato waffles
recommendations.reason: Jamali recommends the cafe for elevated classic cafe food made by hand; Ed loves their Instagram.
recommendations.quote: it's café food but they hand make it all or use really good ingredients... they do potato waffles in there, man, shit, it's fire.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Devil's Mess breakfast
recommendations.location: Silver Lake, Los Angeles, California, USA
recommendations.reason: Ed's jet-lagged breakfast spot in LA, with a huge turkey, egg, sour cream and guacamole dish.
recommendations.quote: I would go to this place, 'Millie's.' In Silver Lake... get something called, 'Devil's Mess.'
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Hand-cut chips (egg, beans and chips)
recommendations.venue: Unnamed cafe by Bethnal Green station (now closed)
recommendations.reason: An East End owner insisted everything came with his hand-cut chips, and they were great; the starch would balance the cheesecake.
recommendations.quote: he'd go, 'Everything comes with chips.'... And I remember he'd make you have these chips and they were fucking great.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Egg, beans and chips
recommendations.location: Bethnal Green Road, Bethnal Green, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Since his chip cafe has closed, he recommends the famous Bethnal Green cafe for good chips.
recommendations.quote: Pellicci, they do good chips... you want egg, beans and chips from them.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Raspberry berry lemonade
recommendations.reason: Sour and sweet, it cleanses the palate; oddly, mediocre Mexican restaurants tend to nail it.
recommendations.quote: it's always those weird places, like really shitty Mexican restaurants, that will have a really good berry lemonade.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

recommendations.item: Trifle (very cold, with thick cream)
recommendations.reason: Swapped from key lime pie for being too like his main; he'll eat a whole M&S trifle - cream, jelly and cake.
recommendations.quote: I'll go for a trifle. I fucking love trifle. Again, I'll go Marks and Spencer and I'll buy a-, I'll eat a full trifle.
recommendations.speaker: Jamali Maddix

episodes.title: Ep 147: Sikisa
episodes.summary: Sikisa hacks the menu with Ribena and tortilla chips with salsa and guac, then has garlic-butter scallops and dim sum, Bajan pudding and souse with homemade macaroni pie, a TGI Fridays June Bug, and apple and blackberry pie with double cream.

recommendations.item: Original Ribena
recommendations.reason: She hacks the water course because Ribena reminds her of good old times.
recommendations.quote: I think Ribena just reminds me of, like, good old times. I don't know what good old times, but good old times.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Tortilla chips with chunky mild/spicy salsa and guacamole
recommendations.reason: She wants a lighter, flavourful snack instead of carb-heavy bread; she singles out Wahaca's guacamole as a benchmark.
recommendations.quote: Oh, Wahaca do a banging guacamole, do a banging, oh, sexy guacamole.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Scallops in garlic butter (slightly underdone) and prawn and pork dim sum
recommendations.reason: She loves seafood in anything, and the prawn and pork dim sum; scallops must be cooked perfectly, slightly underdone.
recommendations.quote: I love prawns generally. I love seafood in anything I eat, but, like, in a dim sum, it's very nice.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Pudding and souse (Bajan boiled 'pickled' pork with cucumber, peppers and steamed sweet potato pudding) with breadfruit
recommendations.reason: The traditional Saturday meal of Barbados, where her family is from; her mum cooked it for the independence celebrations.
recommendations.quote: We have it traditionally on a Saturday for lunch and for dinner. So, it's called souse
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Homemade macaroni pie with onions, sweet peppers and mild and yellow cheese
recommendations.reason: It must be genuinely homemade, firm enough to cut into a square; she takes it home from christenings, weddings and parties.
recommendations.quote: It has to be a genuine, home- made macaroni pie, and it's got to involve onions
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: June Bug cocktail (melon liqueur, coconut rum, banana liqueur, pineapple) with no ice and a plastic straw
recommendations.reason: Her favourite cocktail from TGI Fridays 'when it was hip', where people went for parties and gatherings.
recommendations.quote: what I would pick for my dream drink is what is called a June bug. It is a cocktail which has melon liqueur in it.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Apple and blackberry pie with double cream
recommendations.reason: Apple alone is too bland for her; blackberry makes it, and she makes a banging pie herself.
recommendations.quote: But I really do love an apple and blackberry pie. I don't really like it if it's just go apple in it.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Food market stalls
recommendations.reason: She goes regularly and ends up buying several meals from different stalls in one day.
recommendations.quote: There's a very good one in Exmouth's market in Angel and they've got, like, maybe five or six stalls there
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Tempura sushi, ebi bites, cauliflower with black truffle
recommendations.reason: James, Ed and Sikisa all rave about it; Sikisa orders it on Deliveroo and Ed loves the truffle cauliflower.
recommendations.quote: That cauliflower, the cauliflower in the black truffle sauce is just incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Authentic West Indian food
recommendations.reason: Sikisa told James to go there for genuine West Indian food instead of Rum Kitchen; James later agreed he should have.
recommendations.quote: There's Wings 'n' Tingz around the corner. Go to a genuine, authentic West Indian restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Traditional Trinidadian rotis
recommendations.reason: Her recommendation for proper Trinidadian food; she's such a regular they know her order.
recommendations.quote: go to Roti Joupa in Clapham, which is absolutely banging. They do proper traditional Trinidadian rotis.
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

recommendations.item: Seasoned fries
recommendations.reason: On his only visit, for a stag do, James found the fries some of the best he's ever had.
recommendations.quote: Still to this day, I remember that they were some of the best fries I've ever had. I'm not joking.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: McDonald's apple pie combined with KFC Avalanche ice cream
recommendations.reason: When working in the Wandsworth Arndale she'd combine the McDonald's apple pie with KFC's ice cream, her favourite fast-food hack.
recommendations.quote: I used to go to McDonald's and get their apple pie, and then go across to KFC and get their ice cream
recommendations.speaker: Sikisa

episodes.title: Ep 148: Jarvis Cocker
episodes.summary: Jarvis Cocker keeps it light: lightly sparkling water, Melba toast, a shrimp cocktail, a vegan doner kebab from a Holloway Road cafe, a Yorkshire pudding with Henderson's relish, orange wine like he had at Sargasso in Margate, hot rice pudding with cinnamon and raisins, then mint tea.

recommendations.item: Lightly sparkling water (San Pellegrino-level fizz)
recommendations.reason: Something in the middle: bubbles to celebrate, but not so fizzy you're burping like with Perrier.
recommendations.quote: let's have some bubbles but not too much bubbles that will give us kind of like we're burping all the time
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Melba toast with a tiny scraping of butter
recommendations.reason: He's trying to be a bit gluten free and doesn't want to fill up on bread; thin brittle Melba toast is a first for the podcast.
recommendations.quote: Could you have like a Melba toast?
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Shrimp cocktail with Marie Rose sauce
recommendations.reason: A classic that paces you before the main; small shrimp rather than king prawns, which put him off after giant paella prawns on holiday in Spain.
recommendations.quote: a nice prawn cocktail is really good and it fulfils the criteria of a starter
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Vegan doner kebab with garlicky white sauce
recommendations.reason: A cafe on Holloway Road whose name he can't remember served a surprisingly tasty vegan kebab.
recommendations.quote: it's up on Holloway Road there's this cafe but I can't remember the name of it and they had a vegan kebab
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Yorkshire pudding with Henderson's relish
recommendations.reason: As a Yorkshireman he's spent years perfecting his own Yorkshire puddings; Hendo's is the Sheffield condiment that's 'very versatile'.
recommendations.quote: I was kind of embarrassed that I didn't know how to make one, so it's over the last kind of four or five years I've been persevering
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Dry French orange wine
recommendations.location: Margate Harbour Arm, Margate, Kent, UK
recommendations.reason: He first tried orange wine at Sargasso in Margate out of novelty and found it really good, without red wine's sleepiness.
recommendations.quote: in this place I went to in Margate, they had orange wine, and I thought, 'Hmm, not heard of that,' so I tried it, and I thought that was really good.
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Hot rice pudding with cinnamon and a few raisins
recommendations.reason: Simple and comforting; he prefers it hot, which he finds more interesting than cold.
recommendations.quote: To go back to the dessert, I know this sounds boring, but rice pudding is nice.
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Peppermint Jungle mint tea (Dragonfly Teas)
recommendations.reason: A mint blend his band made with Dragonfly Teas, with lyrics on the tabs; mint tea rounds off a meal.
recommendations.quote: I think it's nice to have a mint tea at the end of a meal.
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Parmesan fritters (cheese profiterole-style balls)
recommendations.location: Margate Harbour Arm, Margate, Kent, UK
recommendations.reason: The best side dishes he's come across recently: round cheese fritters like savoury profiteroles.
recommendations.quote: I went to a restaurant in Margate called, 'Sargasso' I think it was called and they had these kinds of parmesan fritter things
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Baked potato with caviar and soured cream
recommendations.location: Place de la Madeleine, Paris, France
recommendations.reason: One of the swankiest meals he's had: the poshest imaginable baked potato, topped with caviar.
recommendations.quote: one of the most swanky meals I ate was a baked potato with caviar on it.
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Candy floss signature dessert
recommendations.reason: A sophisticated, now-closed restaurant full of mid-century art whose signature dessert was a big dome of candy floss.
recommendations.quote: there was a place called The Four Seasons and it was quite an amazing place, you know, quite, kind of, sophisticated
recommendations.speaker: Jarvis Cocker

recommendations.item: Ever-changing soufflé (e.g. sticky toffee soufflé)
recommendations.reason: James was taught to make soufflé by Mark Greenaway and always orders the soufflé at his Edinburgh restaurant; the sticky toffee one was exceptional.
recommendations.quote: every time I go there's a different flavour soufflé on the dessert menu and I have to have it. He did a sticky toffee one last time and it was exceptional.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Celeriac shawarma
recommendations.reason: James recommends Ottolenghi's Rovi for its amazing celeriac shawarma.
recommendations.quote: There's an amazing celeriac shawarma at a place called, 'Rovi' in London
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 149: Adam Buxton
episodes.summary: Adam Buxton, a reformed picky eater, picks hard tap water, takeaway garlic naan with twelve pots of mango chutney, the mystery tasting dishes at Les Ambassadeurs in Paris, a homemade cauliflower taco bowl, inari, Carlsberg and a Gü Zillionaire pudding one and a half times the size.

recommendations.item: Hard tap water
recommendations.reason: Nick Helm put him off sparkling water by warning that it rots your teeth, and he loves the bracing, flavourful hard water where he lives.
recommendations.quote: I like tap, and we live out in a hard water area out here in South Norfolk and I love hard water.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Garlic naan with twelve pots of mango chutney
recommendations.reason: From his local Indian takeaway when he and his wife bought their first house in south London, binge-watching 24; he loved their mango chutney so much he ordered twelve pots.
recommendations.quote: I used to like garlic naan when I was in my Indian takeaway days in south London, Stockwell.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Any of the elaborate tasting-menu courses
recommendations.location: Place de la Concorde, Paris, France
recommendations.reason: A wildly opulent, Versailles-like restaurant booked for his wife's birthday in 2006; the meal cost about £1,000 but every unidentifiable little artwork of a course was amazing and he'll remember it forever.
recommendations.quote: every single one of those little tiny art pieces was amazing
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Cauliflower taco bowl
recommendations.reason: His current go-to lunch from a recipe box: spiced roasted cauliflower in a baked tortilla bowl with black beans, tomatoes and carrot ribbons, a symbol of how far he's come from hating vegetables.
recommendations.quote: it is the cauliflower taco bowl. And it represents to me an encouraging chapter in my eating evolution.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Inari (seasoned fried tofu pouches filled with rice)
recommendations.reason: He could eat hundreds of the classic rice-filled tofu pockets he orders at sushi restaurants.
recommendations.quote: I will usually have just the classic rice pocket, with the tofu bean wrapping. Yum, it's amazing. God it's good.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Carlsberg lager
recommendations.reason: He likes a fizzy, fairly low-alcohol lager he can drink in volume without getting hammered.
recommendations.quote: I do like Carlsberg because it's fizzy. I like a fizzy larger that is fairly low in alcohol.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Gü Zillionaire chocolate cheesecake pudding (1.5x size)
recommendations.reason: He was obsessed with these layered supermarket puddings for five years, still keeps about 500 of the glass ramekins and wrote a stand-up bit about them.
recommendations.quote: I think you're dealing with about four layers of joy.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Sparkling lychee wine and Chinese food
recommendations.reason: A huge multi-floor Chinese restaurant his girlfriend called 'the factory'; the service was surly but the food was incredible and they drank sparkling lychee wine.
recommendations.quote: But the food was incredible and we used to have this sparkling lychee wine
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

recommendations.item: Sushi and warm sake on an early date
recommendations.reason: One of his first dates with his wife was at a Tsunami sushi restaurant, where the deal was sealed over warm sake and he fell for sushi.
recommendations.quote: the deal was sealed in the sushi restaurant over some warm sake.
recommendations.speaker: Adam Buxton

episodes.title: Ep 150: Angela Hartnett
episodes.summary: Chef Angela Hartnett's simple, Italian-leaning dream menu: sparkling water, Richard Corrigan's soda bread and focaccia, spaghetti puttanesca, classic roast chicken, green beans with fresh almonds and peaches, a Piedmont red, a cheese course, Gary Usher's vanilla tart and Vin Santo with madeleines.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Has always liked it as refreshing and thirst-quenching; makes it at home from Thames tap water with a SodaStream.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling. I do like sparkling water, yes. I don't know why, but I've always liked it... I find it thirst-quenching.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Soda bread and focaccia
recommendations.reason: Richard Corrigan does a great combination of breads; soda bread is great fresh or stale and toasted and soaks up butter, and she loves focaccia's crunch.
recommendations.quote: I'll tell you who does a great combo of breads is old Mr Corrigan... He does a great soda bread, which I think is delicious
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Pasta puttanesca with chilli, tomato, garlic, basil, capers, olives and anchovies
recommendations.reason: A go-to dish made from store-cupboard staples, spicy and full of tomato flavour, with bread to mop up the sauce; ideally eaten by the sea.
recommendations.quote: a really delicious, simple bowl of pasta with chilli, tomato sauce, garlic in there, fresh basil, probably like a puttanesca with capers, black olives in there.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Roast chicken with sage and onion stuffing, lemon, thyme, rosemary and garlic
recommendations.reason: Chicken is her favourite meat; she loves the juices and simple accompaniments, and cites versions by Mark Hix and a friend who served it over juice-soaked bread.
recommendations.quote: Main course is, well, I'm sure someone's said it, roast chicken. I just absolutely love it.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Roast chicken served over bread to soak up the juices
recommendations.location: Columbia Road, Bethnal Green, London, UK
recommendations.reason: A friend's restaurant (transcribed as 'Ed at Braun', likely Ed Wilson at Brawn) served roast chicken on bread that soaked up all the juices; she found it delicious.
recommendations.quote: He'd put the bread underneath, so it would soak all the juices. So, you just had, like, this chickeny bread-soaked-, I mean, it was just delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Green beans with fresh almonds, basil, raw peaches and a mustardy vinaigrette
recommendations.reason: A seasonal summer dish she puts on her restaurant menu; Ed plans to book in August to get it.
recommendations.quote: We put it as a dish on the restaurant. It just works because the peaches are never so sweet, you know, they are sweet and they're ripe
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Italian red wine from Piedmont (Barolo or Barbaresco)
recommendations.reason: Prefers Piedmont to Tuscany; a medium wine that works with supper or on its own, and carries on into the cheese course.
recommendations.quote: I'd go Italian red and I would go from Piedmont rather than Tuscany. So, some of the Barolos or Barbarescos up there.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Cheese course (Vacherin, cheddar, Gorgonzola, British cheeses)
recommendations.reason: Wanted cheese with her red wine before dessert; she says Patricia at La Fromagerie does cheese best and just asks her for a selection.
recommendations.quote: Well, Patricia does it best, doesn't she? La Fromagerie, that shop in London who does great cheeses.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Vanilla tart with nutmeg
recommendations.location: Chain: Gary Usher's restaurants in North West England
recommendations.reason: Her all-time favourite dessert; Gary Usher makes an amazing one with the right wobble, not overly sweet, with proper vanilla and biscuity pastry.
recommendations.quote: my favourite all time dessert is a vanilla tart. I think one of the best people that make it is a guy called Gary Usher, up North
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Vin Santo with madeleines and Ricciarelli
recommendations.reason: Instead of a full dessert she likes something small and sweet with sweet wine; she brought madeleines fresh from her husband Neil's restaurant.
recommendations.quote: I bought you some madeleines from Neil's place because Neil's helped write this book as much as me.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Hartnett

recommendations.item: Gammon with parsley sauce
recommendations.location: St John Street, Smithfield, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Ed recently had a really nice gammon there and loved the old-school dining room.
recommendations.quote: I had a really nice bit of gammon at St John, actually, quite recently, with the parsley sauce and all of that.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Flapjacks (chilli and lime chocolate, marzipan, etc.)
recommendations.reason: James's sister's flapjack company; Ed loved trying each flavour, especially chilli and lime chocolate.
recommendations.quote: Fabjacks Bakery is the name of the company. Fabjacksbakery.co.uk, that is where you can order the flapjacks from
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 151: Rob Brydon
episodes.summary: Rob Brydon picks San Pellegrino, sourdough with salted butter, oysters with a Kir Royale, a Welsh roast leg of lamb cooked by Angela Hartnett with cabbage and dauphinoise, Barolo, and a chocolate bomb from Il Riccio's Room of Temptation on Capri.

recommendations.item: Sparkling San Pellegrino in a glass bottle
recommendations.reason: Always sparkling and typically San Pellegrino; he finds Badoit too salty and gets crates delivered at home.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling, and it's typically San Pellegrino.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Top-quality sourdough with salted butter
recommendations.reason: Yeasty bread affects his gut and skin but he can eat sourdough, and in a dream restaurant he'd have the best with salted butter.
recommendations.quote: I'd have some of the best sourdough bread and I would have salted butter with it. That would just be delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Six oysters with shallot vinaigrette
recommendations.reason: He discovered oysters on a seafood platter at an outdoor restaurant by Sydney Harbour Bridge on his first trip to Australia; they make him feel special.
recommendations.quote: I love oysters. They always make me feel, like, something special. Because you tend to have them with champagne.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Kir Royale with the oysters
recommendations.reason: He loves champagne with cassis, introduced to him by his wife Claire, and would drink it with the oysters.
recommendations.quote: I would've had the Kir Royale with the oysters and then once the lamb is served, I'm on Barolo.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Sunday roast leg of Welsh lamb with gravy, parsnips, carrot and swede mash, roast potatoes and Yorkshire puddings, cooked by Angela Hartnett
recommendations.reason: A Sunday roast done just right and served piping hot, with gravy midway between Welsh and English thickness; Angela Hartnett would cook it because she's a laugh.
recommendations.quote: it's got to be done by someone who knows what they're doing.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Savoy cabbage and potato dauphinoise
recommendations.reason: He loves dauphinoise when done well and a properly cooked Savoy cabbage.
recommendations.quote: I'm having the cabbage and the dauphinoise.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Barolo
recommendations.reason: He discovered Barolo filming The Trip to Italy when Michael Winterbottom chose it, and has stuck with it since.
recommendations.quote: It's a lovely wine and as I say, I have no great knowledge of wine, but Michael had chose this
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Chocolate bomb with salted caramel ice cream and a crumbled chilled Flake
recommendations.reason: Chosen from the chilled 'room of temptation' full of desserts at Il Riccio, the clifftop Capri restaurant from The Trip to Italy that was perfection on the day they filmed.
recommendations.quote: you're on a terrace that is atop a cliff and they have a room of temptation which is a chilled room full of desserts you just walk into.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Salt crust rib-eye steak with potato dauphinoise
recommendations.reason: One of the greatest meals he ever had, alone overlooking Bondi near the end of a trip.
recommendations.quote: one of my greatest meals I ever had was again in Sydney, there's a great restaurant called Icebergs that looks down on Bondi.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Oysters with a view of the seaplanes
recommendations.reason: He took James Corden to this lovely Rose Bay restaurant where Corden tried, and spat out, his first oyster.
recommendations.quote: There's a lovely restaurant in Rose Bay called Catalina. From there, you see the seaplanes landing and taking off. It's so gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

recommendations.item: Chef's table dinner with Tom Jones
recommendations.reason: Where he watched Tom Jones order a dozen oysters and squeeze a lemon in the manliest way possible.
recommendations.quote: we go for dinner at this, sort of, chef's table at Corrigan's restaurant, which is in Mayfair.
recommendations.speaker: Rob Brydon

episodes.title: Ep 153: Joseph Quinn
episodes.summary: Joseph Quinn builds a boozy multi-course feast: pre-dinner oysters and Guinness, steak tartare and a dirty martini at Musso & Frank, orecchiette alla barese, a big buttery turbot, and madeleines with a pistachio affogato and Fernet-Branca at The French House.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (wavered to still)
recommendations.reason: He picks sparkling, briefly switches to still over worries it rots teeth, and ends up taking sparkling.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling. But, where do you stand on the whole, it's bad for you thing? Because I think it's a myth.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Assortment: crusty sourdough with salted butter, focaccia and cheesy Genoa-style focaccia
recommendations.reason: He loves crusty, gooey bread with salty butter and had great focaccia in Puglia and cheesy focaccia in Genoa.
recommendations.quote: in Genoa they do this focaccia with cheese on it. I can't remember the kind of cheese that it is but that'll blow your head off.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Pre-meal six oysters, a pint of Guinness and thin frites with mayo, from a shack across the road
recommendations.reason: He wants to sit outside before entering the restaurant with oysters and Guinness, a great start to a night out.
recommendations.quote: So, you're sat outside, and I want six oysters and a pint of Guinness.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Steak tartare with a briny dirty martini and side jar
recommendations.reason: An old LA institution where he celebrated a friend's birthday; he loved the whole experience, especially the martini side jar.
recommendations.quote: It's in West Hollywood and it's just fucking great. And we went in and we had this amazing steak tartare with this dirty Martini.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Pasta course: orecchiette alla barese (sausage and broccoli) with bang-average white wine
recommendations.reason: A Puglian dish of little-ear pasta with fennelly sausage, broccoli, chilli and garlic; paired with forgettable wine so the next one feels better.
recommendations.quote: they do this dish and it's sausage and broccoli, and I want it.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Big buttery turbot with brown butter, capers, samphire and lemon, plus a dry white (Picpoul, Sancerre or Arneis)
recommendations.reason: A huge sharing fish taken off the bone with friends; the vibe of BRAT's turbot, though not necessarily from there.
recommendations.quote: you get a fish and it's big and it's buttery, and it's brown butter and there are capers, maybe there's some samphire and there's lemon.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Garlicky sauteed greens and surprise potatoes (James chose dauphinoise)
recommendations.reason: The fish is the star, so he just wants something green and garlicky and is happy to be surprised by the potato.
recommendations.quote: I just want something kind of green and garlicky next to it
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Filthy, briny dirty martini
recommendations.reason: His favourite drink: briny, cold and boozy.
recommendations.quote: My favourite drink is, you know, just filthy Martini.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Four freshly baked madeleines with a pistachio affogato and Fernet-Branca
recommendations.reason: His favourite lunch spot, with a handwritten changing menu; the madeleines are always on and baked fresh to order.
recommendations.quote: Basically, it's my favourite place to go and get lunch. It's in Soho.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Turbot cooked over open flames
recommendations.reason: Ed suggests Brat's turbot and Joe says he loves the restaurant; Ed calls it amazing.
recommendations.quote: They do a lot of cooking on open flames and stuff, it's an amazing restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Huge Duke's martini
recommendations.reason: Famous for a very strong martini they only serve you once; Joe has heard they are really good and plans to go after dinner.
recommendations.quote: apparently it's five shots, five shots of vodka, one of vermouth, and you only get one.
recommendations.speaker: Joe Quinn

recommendations.item: Dirty oyster martini
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls having a vodka martini with a whole oyster in it there.
recommendations.quote: In Bob Bob Ricard in Soho, I had a dirty oyster martini.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Warm madeleines
recommendations.reason: Ed praises St John's madeleines as an amazing way to finish a meal.
recommendations.quote: the madeleines they do at St John as well, what an amazing way to finish a meal, warm
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 154: Esther Manito
episodes.summary: Esther's dream menu is a Lebanese mezza starter followed by a very hot prawn vindaloo Indian meal with poppadoms, saag bhaji, rose Moet champagne, and a cheese board plus lemon sorbet.

recommendations.item: San Pellegrino sparkling water with lemon
recommendations.reason: She likes the taste of San Pellegrino, especially with lemon in the glass, as she eats a lemon a day.
recommendations.quote: I just like the taste of it, I don't know why. It goes well when you've got your lemons in it.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with lime pickle, plain yoghurt, sweet coconut and onion
recommendations.reason: Full Indian-restaurant poppadoms, broken up and dipped in a barrel of plain yoghurt with lime pickle.
recommendations.quote: I would have poppadoms. ... I do break up the poppadom to dip it in.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Mezza: baba ganoush, tabbouleh and hummus b'lahmeh with bread
recommendations.reason: A Lebanese mezza with dips, tabbouleh and hummus topped with shawarma-style meat and pine nuts; her Lebanese dad cooks great food at home.
recommendations.quote: hummus, but with the shawarma meat cut up in it with bread. Call it hummus b'lahmeh, in Arabic, and it's my favourite.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Prawn vindaloo with real chillies, poppadoms, pilau rice and onion raita
recommendations.reason: She loves a really hot curry made with fresh chillies for flavour, not chilli powder.
recommendations.quote: I want the vindaloo made with chillies, not chilli powder, that is a pet peeve of mine.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Saag bhaji (spinach cooked with onions)
recommendations.reason: Spinach cooked with onions to go alongside the curry.
recommendations.quote: saag bhaji is just, like, the spinach all cooked with onions.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Rose Moet champagne
recommendations.reason: Her husband bought her a bottle when she did Live at the Apollo and the rose made it feel special.
recommendations.quote: my husband bought me a bottle when I did Live at the Apollo, and it felt just very special the fact that it was rosé.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Cheese board with blue stilton, salty crackers and grapes
recommendations.reason: She prefers a cheese board to pudding, with grapes against salty stilton.
recommendations.quote: Grapes, blue stilton, and some salty crackers.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Lemon sorbet served in a lemon
recommendations.reason: A compromise after Ed's protests, the classic Indian restaurant lemon sorbet.
recommendations.quote: I'll have a lemon sorbet, yes?
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Lebanese food
recommendations.reason: Where her family used to go for Lebanese food on Edgware Road.
recommendations.quote: when we used to go out for Lebanese food, we always used to go to Maroush, on Edgeware Road.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Posh Lebanese food
recommendations.reason: Supposedly the poshest Lebanese, a top-floor restaurant opposite the Ritz.
recommendations.quote: If you really want to go to a really posh, famous one, there's one opposite the Ritz, called Fakhreldin.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: North Indian lunches, prawn curry
recommendations.location: India (lived in Mandaveli area, probably Chennai)
recommendations.reason: Where she got lunch of Sikh/North Indian food, including prawn curry, while living in India.
recommendations.quote: I used to go and get my lunch from a place called Punjabi Dhaba? ... it was, like, Sikh food. North Indian food.
recommendations.speaker: Esther Manito

recommendations.item: Lamb heart pide
recommendations.reason: Ed had an incredible thinly sliced, rare lamb heart pide here.
recommendations.quote: lamb heart pide, and it was just incredible. So good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Curry
recommendations.reason: James rates it the best curry in the country, with real chillies and lots of flavour.
recommendations.quote: the best curry I've had in the country was in Buxton, in a curry house called ... Indian Palace
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 155: Taron Egerton
episodes.summary: Taron Egerton's menu centres on home: his mum's slow-cooked lamb madras with crumbled poppadoms, bookended by Social Eating House's mushrooms in a bag, Nobu's rock shrimp tempura, And Union Saturday Lager and Windowsill Pies' pecan pie.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He loves sparkling as the 'gentler cousin of champagne' but chose still so he wouldn't feel full too quickly.
recommendations.quote: the association of drinking sparkling water I think will make me feel fuller quicker
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney, raita and lime pickle (some kept back to crumble on the curry)
recommendations.reason: His meal is Indian-themed, and he likes to smush a whole poppadom and crumble it over his curry for crunch.
recommendations.quote: I like to take a whole poppadom smush it in my hands and then crumble it over a curry.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Mushrooms in a bag with mushroom pâté on sourdough toast
recommendations.reason: Paul Hood's signature dish: wild mushrooms steamed in a bag and cut open at the table, with a nice bit of communal theatre; he urges them to bring it back.
recommendations.quote: There's just a really nice little bit of theatre to this, and you all take a piece from the middle and it's just lovely and it's completely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Mum's slow-cooked lamb madras
recommendations.reason: Cooked from scratch over three hours by his mum (and stepdad Guy) whenever he comes home; it fills the house and means family and homecoming.
recommendations.quote: it's just a sense of coming home and family. Yes, I just think Indian food done well is amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Fried chicken with chips, mayo and mozzarella; chicken and hash brown sandwich (honourable mention)
recommendations.reason: A long-running family-run junk food spot he's visited since first going out with mates; it tastes of his teenage years.
recommendations.quote: It's been there for a very, very long time, it's ran and operated by one family from the area, and it's just somewhere I've been going since I first started going out with my mates
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Rock shrimp tempura with spicy creamy sauce
recommendations.reason: Light but decadent battered prawns that Nobu did first or best; best saved as a special event with a gang.
recommendations.quote: it's quite light, but it also feels, sort of, decadent and battered and fried, and it's just lovely and I love it.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Saturday Lager by And Union
recommendations.reason: A simple, full-bodied lager in a plain white can sold in Waitrose; lager and curry can't go wrong.
recommendations.quote: at the moment, the one I like is called Saturday Lager.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Warm pecan pie with vanilla bean ice cream
recommendations.reason: A colleague, hair designer Anne Morgan, brought pies onto the make-up bus while he filmed in New Orleans; crunchy, buttery and insane.
recommendations.quote: she bought me some pecan pie from a place called Windowsill Pies New Orleans.
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Tasting menu
recommendations.reason: The best meal he's ever had, though special-occasion food rather than every day.
recommendations.quote: the best meal I've ever had was L'Enclume
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Strawberry cheesecake
recommendations.reason: The best cheesecake he's ever had; he highly recommends it to Ed and James.
recommendations.quote: they do a strawberry cheesecake and it's the best cheesecake I've ever, ever, ever had
recommendations.speaker: Taron Egerton

recommendations.item: Katsu sando and matcha French toast
recommendations.reason: James goes so often staff know him by name and prepare his French toast; Ed calls the katsu sando outstanding.
recommendations.quote: Oh they're so good, the katsu sando there is outstanding.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Craft beers (passionfruit beer)
recommendations.reason: Ed describes the Danish brewery's London bar as fantastic.
recommendations.quote: I went to Mikkeller, it's a really fantastic brewery called Mikkeller, it's a Danish brewery but they've got a place in London
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 156: Amy Gledhill
episodes.summary: Amy Gledhill orders orange and mango squash with Whitby-water ice cubes, a warm floury bap with a disc of salted butter, Chilli Heatwave Doritos with sour cream dip, a giant Yorkshire pudding stuffed with tarragon mash, roast chicken, veg and seaweed, Pepsi Max Cherry, and a self-invented Rolo-yoghurt marzipan trifle in a waffle bowl.

recommendations.item: Combo fruit squash (orange and mango) with ice cubes made from east-coast Yorkshire water
recommendations.reason: She doesn't like the taste of plain water so carries squash sachets; she thinks northern east-coast water is the sweetest.
recommendations.quote: Near the east coast is where it's like 'ooh la la'.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Warm soft white floury bap with a room-temperature disc of salted butter and rock salt
recommendations.reason: She wants soft bread that won't hurt her gums, ideally warm, with butter served in a round disc.
recommendations.quote: Something soft. I don't like it when it's crunchy and it hurts your gums.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Chilli Heatwave Doritos with sour cream dip
recommendations.reason: Crisps and dip whet her appetite rather than filling her up; a hot crisp with a cooling dip.
recommendations.quote: I want a hot crisp with a cooling, soothing dip.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Giant Yorkshire pudding filled with tarragon mash, peas, roast chicken, gravy, honey-roast carrots and turnips, air-fried broccoli and crispy seaweed
recommendations.location: Near Cottingham / Humber Bridge, East Yorkshire, UK
recommendations.reason: Her dream roast, inspired by a country pub on a big roundabout outside Hull that offered seaweed on the mash; the venue couldn't be identified on the show (her mum suggested Home Farm near the Humber Bridge).
recommendations.quote: Tarragon mash is my favourite thing in the world. It has to be creamy, it has to be buttery, but the tarragon is what elevates it
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Pepsi Max Cherry
recommendations.reason: The opposite of water, full of flavour; she thinks no other cherry cola compares. Also good with amaretto, like a Bakewell tart.
recommendations.quote: Pepsi Max Cherry, bit of ice, oh god, it's perfect. Just the perfect drink.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Invented trifle in a waffle-cone bowl: marzipan and icing base, giant Rolo-yoghurt chocolate layer, custard, cream, hundreds and thousands, cherries
recommendations.reason: Rolo desserts are too small, so she built a supersized trifle around the chocolate layer; James calls it the greatest pudding on the podcast.
recommendations.quote: I want that, but really big... I could just make that into the base of a trifle, my own special trifle.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

recommendations.item: Cheese and onion pasty, chicken baguette, six-pack of Yum Yums
recommendations.reason: Her go-to fast food chain because it has hot, cold and sweet options.
recommendations.quote: I think you've got more variety. You know, you've got your hot stuff, you've got your cold stuff.
recommendations.speaker: Amy Gledhill

episodes.title: Ep 157: Professor Brian Cox
episodes.summary: Professor Brian Cox eats inside a black hole: sparkling water, poppadoms, Martian smoked salmon, steak and kidney pudding, chips and gravy from his childhood Oldham chippy with mushy peas, 2008 Dom Ruinart champagne, and Welsh rarebit for dessert.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: He chooses sparkling, to be drunk inside the event horizon of the M87 black hole before time ends.
recommendations.quote: We'd just be sitting here eating and drinking and drinking the water. Sparkling, by the way, I'll have.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Poppadoms
recommendations.reason: He simply fancied one, then set listeners a challenge to cut out the middle of a poppadom to make Saturn's rings.
recommendations.quote: It's no deeper than I just fancied a poppadom.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Martian smoked salmon (first idea: chips and curry sauce from potatoes grown on Mars)
recommendations.location: Jezero Crater, Mars (3.5 billion years ago)
recommendations.reason: He swapped The Martian-style potatoes for salmon released into the ancient rivers of Mars's Jezero Crater.
recommendations.quote: we could take the salmon with us, put them in the rivers of Mars, and then we could eat Martian salmon.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Steak and kidney pudding (foil-wrapped), chips, peas and gravy
recommendations.reason: His favourite childhood meal from the chip shop behind his house, eaten every Saturday growing up in Oldham.
recommendations.quote: Haggit Chippy in Oldham, where every Saturday we used to go and have steak and kidney pudding, chips, peas, and gravy.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Mushy peas in a polystyrene cup
recommendations.reason: He ranks mushy peas well above boring garden peas, and they come from the chippy with his main.
recommendations.quote: Aren't the mushy peas the side dish?
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: 2008 Dom Ruinart blanc de blancs champagne
recommendations.reason: Guinness now gives him headaches, so he goes for vintage Ruinart, a 100% Chardonnay champagne from a good year.
recommendations.quote: I would go for the vintage Ruinart, which is Dom Ruinart, and I would probably go for 2008.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Welsh rarebit with Worcestershire sauce (and a Sauternes)
recommendations.reason: He doesn't like sweet things, so he often orders rarebit for dessert in restaurants, to James's horror.
recommendations.quote: I often go that way actually because I don't like sweet things, so I often go for the rarebit.
recommendations.speaker: Professor Brian Cox

recommendations.item: Welsh rarebit on the dessert menu
recommendations.reason: Ed praises it as a fantastic restaurant with a wonderful rarebit on the dessert menu.
recommendations.quote: St John , a fantastic restaurant has a wonderful rarebit on the dessert menu.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 158: Maisie Adam
episodes.summary: Maisie Adam orders still water, poppadoms, breaded Brie from her village pub The Black Swan, her granny Muriel's braising steak served in a Prague-style bread bowl, curly fries in a bucket from Blackpool Pleasure Beach, her fiancé's Chock-work Orange cocktail from Shuffle in Brighton, and his mum Diane's chocolate orange cheesecake.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She thinks sparkling water is a scam, basically lemonade without the lemon.
recommendations.quote: Oh, still every time. Still every time.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with dips and chutneys
recommendations.reason: Restaurant bread is boring and comes with butter that's too hard; poppadoms come with dips and chutneys.
recommendations.quote: Poppadoms however, they come with a selection of dips and chutneys and-, yes, I love it, I really love a poppadom.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Breaded Brie with cranberry sauce and salad with balsamic
recommendations.location: Maisie's home village (not named), Yorkshire, UK
recommendations.reason: Her village pub, with a log fire, where she and school friends did the Monday pub quiz and her grandparents always took the family.
recommendations.quote: we loved it, and it was a really nice pub. It was run by this guy who lived in the village.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Granny Muriel's braising steak, served in a Prague-style bread bowl
recommendations.reason: Her granny's slow-cooked braising steak (framed recipe, Henderson's Relish, Morrisons ingredients), served like the bread-bowl goulash she fell for in Prague.
recommendations.quote: my granny's braising steak is something else.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Curly fries in a bucket with a spade-fork
recommendations.venue: Blackpool Pleasure Beach (curly fries stall by the Big Dipper)
recommendations.reason: Family holidays with 25 relatives every summer; the stall outside the Big Dipper serves what she calls the best curly fries ever.
recommendations.quote: they are the best curly fries you will ever ever have.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Chock-work Orange cocktail (vodka, triple sec, chocolate sauce, orange bitters, half and half)
recommendations.reason: Created by her fiancé, who runs the jukebox cocktail bar where they met; it tastes like a Terry's Chocolate Orange.
recommendations.quote: It's the best thing I've ever tasted. It's so, so good.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Chocolate orange cheesecake topped with Maltesers
recommendations.reason: Her fiancé's mum makes it for her every Christmas so she doesn't feel left out of the family's Christmas cake.
recommendations.quote: his mum, Diane, does every Christmas for me a chocolate orange cheesecake.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Maisie insists you go: a family firm since just after WWII that only does vanilla, made to a secret recipe.
recommendations.quote: If you ever go to Blackpool you've got to go here.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

recommendations.item: Jam doughnut and birthday cake gelato
recommendations.reason: James loved the jam doughnut ice cream and Ed loved the birthday cake gelato.
recommendations.quote: in Brighton I've been to an ice-cream parlour that does a jam doughnut ice-cream that was insanely good.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Family holiday hotel and cabaret bar
recommendations.reason: Every summer the family stayed at Pat Mancini's hotel with its cabaret bar and Elvis convention; she remembers it fondly.
recommendations.quote: It was the ultimate, like, Blackpool hotel.
recommendations.speaker: Maisie Adam

episodes.title: Ep 159: Felicity Ward
episodes.summary: Felicity Ward chooses room-temperature still water, bread with basil, buffalo mozzarella and tomato, Gaggan's yoghurt explosion, Harry's Singapore chilli mud crab in Sydney, a Corfu Greek salad, a fruity mint mocktail from a Melbourne restaurant, and crème catalana from The European in Melbourne with a Campos coffee.

recommendations.item: Still water, room temperature, in a big bottle
recommendations.reason: She has no interest in sparkling and dislikes iced water, which gives her a 'cold stone' in her throat; she drinks a lot.
recommendations.quote: A dream restaurant, I'd go a nice bottle of still water, and probably in a big bottle because I drink a lot.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Bread with basil leaves, olive oil, buffalo mozzarella and tomato
recommendations.reason: She builds a little tricolore around the bread, served in ramekins, but no balsamic because 'it's not 1997 anymore'.
recommendations.quote: That is what I am doing, a little tricolore, I think it's called.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Yoghurt explosion
recommendations.reason: Booked after seeing it on Chef's Table, she got seated at the chef's table; the spiced yoghurt sphere that bursts in the mouth moved her to tears.
recommendations.quote: I have never cried before over food but I got tears in my eyes and I felt like I was having a childhood memory of a childhood I never had.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Steak
recommendations.reason: Ed recalls a very good meal at this New York steakhouse despite a 90-minute wait.
recommendations.quote: we went to St. Anselm. It's an amazing steakhouse and it was really good
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Chilli mud crab
recommendations.reason: A 30-year Sydney institution (closed last year) whose messy chilli mud crab, eaten with tools, a bib and finger bowls, blew her mind.
recommendations.quote: They did a chilli mud crab that blew my fucking mind and it's filthy
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Greek salad (feta, olives, tomato, cucumber, red onion, oregano, olive oil)
recommendations.reason: On the first night of a holiday in Corfu, a beachside restaurant's Greek salad tasted like the most perfect, freshest one she'd ever had.
recommendations.quote: the only other time I've become emotional about food was in Corfu... it tasted like the most perfect Greek salad I've ever had.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Waiter-invented non-alcoholic drink of fruit, ice and mint (perhaps passion fruit and ginger beer)
recommendations.reason: Made for her by the waiter on a solo 'date with herself' at an unnamed Melbourne laneway restaurant where he also ordered her a son-in-law egg.
recommendations.quote: he brought back this god-damn vat of fruit and ice and mint and sweet and yummy and tangy. It was just the night of my life
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Crème catalana with a little orange empanada and mandarin ice cream
recommendations.reason: An iconic late-opening Melbourne restaurant; she still remembers its orange crème catalana a decade on.
recommendations.quote: They did something called a crème catalana which is like an orange crème brulee that comes from Catalan and it was amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Coffee with dessert
recommendations.reason: An ex-barista, she remembers the original Campos across from the university roasting incredible beans with a strict 45-minute rule.
recommendations.quote: they roasted their own beans... Everyone went there for coffee. We made good coffee but they were incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Cheese and wine
recommendations.reason: Next to The European; both she and James love it, and it has enough cheese to interest a non-drinker.
recommendations.quote: Supper Club is wonderful. They specialise in cheese and wine
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Late-night tapas
recommendations.reason: James's favourite late-opening tapas bar for eating after shows in Melbourne.
recommendations.quote: when you were saying, like, somewhere in Melbourne, I was like, Hairy Canary... That's great to go and eat at.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: OMG wrap
recommendations.reason: James's first stop every time he arrives in Melbourne.
recommendations.quote: It's the first place I go every time I arrive in Melbourne, it's just around the block from the hotel. I go to Schnitz, I get an OMG wrap.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Burgers
recommendations.reason: Both Felicity and James declare their love for the Australian burger chain.
recommendations.quote: it's next to a Grill'd and my God, I love a Grill'd. Love a Grill'd.
recommendations.speaker: Felicity Ward

recommendations.item: Korean food
recommendations.reason: Ed and his wife were obsessed with this short-hours Korean place; when he finally went, the food was excellent.
recommendations.quote: there's just a queue for two hours solidly and they're just pumping people in and out and it's such good food.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.reason: James names this independent family-run spot the best pizza in his home town.
recommendations.quote: The best place to get pizza in Kettering is Frank's pizza... Independent, family run place, delicious pizza
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 160: Sir Lenny Henry
episodes.summary: Sir Lenny Henry chose still water, a hessian sack of poppadoms, hand-dived scallops at The Ritz, his mum's Jamaican Saturday soup, fall-off-the-bone ribs, a rum punch plus Puligny-Montrachet, and a chocolate-whisky brioche bread pudding from a Manchester restaurant.

recommendations.item: Still tap water
recommendations.reason: He doesn't get sparkling water; still tap water ('council pop') is what he grew up with, ideally with sugar stirred in.
recommendations.quote: Still please, because sparkling thing is like, I don't get sparkling. It's like lemonade but crap.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Poppadoms (a hessian sack of them)
recommendations.reason: He always over-orders poppadoms at the family Friday curry and could eat twelve or fifteen; they're like a giant crisp.
recommendations.quote: Poppadoms are great. I used to over order, all the time because we had a curry every Friday
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Hand-dived scallops
recommendations.reason: After seeing chef Spencer Metzger on Great British Menu he took his mother-in-law to The Ritz; the scallops were one of the best things he's ever eaten and the chef came out to chat.
recommendations.quote: hand-dived scallops at the Ritz, it arrives and for the five minutes I was eating it, I just thought, 'This is one of the best things I've ever had,'
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Mum's Jamaican Saturday soup (mutton, yam, dumplings, potatoes, carrots, thyme)
recommendations.reason: His mum made it every Saturday after a week of pilchards; it meant home, safety and stability, and he'd drive home overnight from gigs for it.
recommendations.quote: This is mum. My mum was a great cook... Saturday was Saturday Soup, which is what I'm going to choose.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Two fall-off-the-bone spare ribs in sauce
recommendations.reason: He loves slow-cooked ribs that fall off the bone, like his mum made, and recalls an unnamed Chinatown restaurant whose ribs are to die for.
recommendations.quote: There's a restaurant in China Town, where they serve this 1 where it's obviously been cooking for a long time, and the ribs are to die for.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Lightly made rum punch with fruit
recommendations.reason: Strong enough but won't ruin the meal, unlike a Martini; nice to sip with the starter.
recommendations.quote: My dream drink is a rum punch, because it's quite strong but it doesn't mess up the meal
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Puligny-Montrachet white wine with the meal
recommendations.reason: He likes a glass of white wine during the meal and names Puligny-Montrachet as one he used to love.
recommendations.quote: I like a glass of wine. I used to like, Polleni Montrachet, was a nice white wine.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Brioche bread pudding with currants, chocolate and whisky
recommendations.reason: A sleek little Manchester restaurant (name forgotten) served it; it was mind-blowing and the chef gave him the recipe, which he makes to impress.
recommendations.quote: chef made a bread pudding with brioche, it had currants in it, chocolate, and a thimble full of whisky. It was literally mind blowing.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Mutton Saturday soup with red peas and hard food
recommendations.reason: Eating their Saturday soup in Soho reminded him so strongly of his late mum that he cried.
recommendations.quote: I went in, and I had it, and I started to cry, because my Mum had passed away, and it reminded me of my Mum.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

recommendations.item: Chicken curry with naan, eaten by hand
recommendations.reason: Promoter Phil McIntyre took him to an unnamed cheap Bradford curry café whose food was unctuous and delicious; he recommends seeking one out.
recommendations.quote: I highly recommend going to Bradford and finding a curry café, rather than a posh restaurant.
recommendations.speaker: Sir Lenny Henry

episodes.title: Ep 161: Flo & Joan
episodes.summary: Sisters Nicola and Rosie Dempsey (Flo & Joan) order separate menus: Nicola has a bucket of fantasy olives, Wun's Tea Room's Iberico char siu, green veg, her first homecoming cup of tea and stale Wotsits; Rosie has a steak platter from Bespoke Butchers in Toronto, a spread of spicy curries, her mum's spag bol, champagne and Steam Whistle pilsner and old-school pick-n-mix.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water (both)
recommendations.reason: Both chose sparkling; Rosie says it feels like a 'thriving method' rather than survival.
recommendations.quote: Water feels like a survival method, and sparkling feels like a thriving method.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Nicola: poppadoms
recommendations.reason: She is a picker and you can snap poppadoms without judgement; she won't order bread in restaurants because she made it in Food Tech.
recommendations.quote: I'm a poppadoms person, straight out. Poppadoms firstly because you can pick at them and no-one's judging
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Rosie: artisanal bread (sourdough) with spoonfuls of butter
recommendations.reason: She admires artisan bread, crusty outside and pillowy inside, with Homer Simpson-sized amounts of butter.
recommendations.quote: Crusty on the outside, and soft and spongy pillow-like on the inside.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Nicola: a seaside bucket of giant fantasy pitted olives with sun-dried tomatoes and chorizo
recommendations.reason: Picky food that won't fill her up; she wants big meaty stuffed olives.
recommendations.quote: I want, like, a bucket of olives... I feel like you can pick at them and not get full.
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Olives
recommendations.reason: Ed holds up Nando's big olives with garlic and mushroom bits as a model for Nicola's olive bucket.
recommendations.quote: Oh, the Nando's olives are an absolute shoo-in for that, I think.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Rosie: platter of six or seven thinly sliced steak cuts (rib-eye, sirloin, sous vide chuck tail, hanger, hanger tartare) with garlic butter
recommendations.reason: She worked as a butcher there for 18 months, and the chefs would cook and slice new steaks for staff to sample.
recommendations.quote: It was called Bespoke Butchers in Toronto... It was the best job ever, it was so good.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Nicola: Iberico char siu pork with clay pot rice
recommendations.location: Greek Street / Old Compton Street, Soho, London, UK
recommendations.reason: One of the greatest things she's eaten: sweet-salty caramelised pork in a basement with a retro 60s/70s vibe and great cocktails.
recommendations.quote: they do this iberico char siu pork with, like, a sugar skin, and it's one of the greatest things I've ever eaten in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Rosie: a selection of spicy curries plus a chicken tikka masala, Peshwari and garlic naan, pilau rice, poppadoms, chutneys, lime pickle and onion salad
recommendations.reason: She loves spicy curry and mixes hot and sweet sauces bite by bite.
recommendations.quote: at the end of the day, it's a spicy curry that I really-, that is my dream meal.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Half roast suckling pig, octopus, croquetas
recommendations.reason: Ed's birthday meal: a suckling pig so tender they cut it with a plate, and everything on the menu was amazing.
recommendations.quote: Absolutely everything on the menu was amazing. It was such a good meal.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Nicola: steamed green veg (tenderstem broccoli, asparagus, green beans) with butter, garlic and sesame
recommendations.reason: Not a veg lover, but she feels she needs something green to offset the salt and sugar.
recommendations.quote: I'm not adding these because I particularly, like, love vegetables, but I feel like I need a vegetable.
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Rosie: a small portion of mum's spaghetti bolognese
recommendations.reason: Her mum simmers it for ages with extra tomato until it's lovely and soupy.
recommendations.quote: She really simmers it for ages... She'll do chopped tomatoes and passata. So, it really, like, just creates this lovely soupy.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Nicola: the first cup of PG Tips tea after being away
recommendations.reason: She drinks eight to ten big mugs a day and misses tea made her way when touring.
recommendations.quote: I want the first cup of tea you make when you've been away for a long time.
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Rosie: champagne, plus Steam Whistle pilsner with the curry
recommendations.reason: Steam Whistle reminds her of living in Toronto; champagne feels luxurious.
recommendations.quote: there's a beer company called Steam Whistle. It's a Pilsner and I just remember drinking it and thinking, 'This is perfection.
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Nicola: a bowl of stale Wotsits
recommendations.reason: She doesn't like desserts and loves the chewy texture of stale Wotsits from 90s kids' parties.
recommendations.quote: the Wotsits go stale and they taste so lovely and chewy.
recommendations.speaker: Nicola Dempsey

recommendations.item: Rosie: a big bag of slightly old pick-n-mix, plus Willy Wonka's edible teacup with chocolate river
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic old-school Woolworths-style pick-n-mix, and the fantasy of tasting Wonka's teacup.
recommendations.quote: I really love pick-n-mix that, you know the old, like in Wilco's, you get the Candy King, or like an old sweet shop?
recommendations.speaker: Rosie Dempsey

recommendations.item: Giant cherry cola bottles
recommendations.reason: James's childhood corner shop where he bought giant cherry cola bottles and they never counted the sweets.
recommendations.quote: At Paul's corner shop, around the corner from where I grew up in Kettering, that would be my go-to. The giant cherry cola bottles.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Curried mutton, chicken and tarragon, and Bakewell pies
recommendations.reason: The hosts thank Willy's Pies for amazing pies, especially the curried mutton and the pastry.
recommendations.quote: especially that curried mutton... the pastry is delicious, and that's what makes a pie, man.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 162: Matt Lucas
episodes.summary: Matt Lucas picks a comfort-food menu of his own matzo ball soup, a long-lost Bristol student-days chicken chow mein, Yorkshire pudding, Pepsi Max Lime and the discontinued Wall's Romantica with whipped cream.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He thinks the bubbles in sparkling water change the taste unpleasantly.
recommendations.quote: I don't know what it is about sparkling water, it just has not a very nice taste.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Poppadoms
recommendations.reason: He loves the drop of grease dancing on the surface and the pleasure of saying the word.
recommendations.quote: I like a poppadom. I like the little drop of grease, as well, that's, sort of, dancing around the surface of the poppadom.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Homemade matzo ball soup (chicken soup with hard matzo balls and noodles)
recommendations.reason: He makes a giant 36-hour batch every October with kosher boiler chickens and freezes it for the winter.
recommendations.quote: And I make it myself now, so I'd actually like, rather obnoxiously and conceitedly, to have my own matzo ball soup
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Chicken chow mein from a lunchtime set menu
recommendations.reason: A tiny Chinese restaurant near his university halls in 1993-94 with a stern owner who watched him eat; he's never tasted better. He doesn't know its name.
recommendations.quote: the chicken chow mein that he made was extraordinary and I've never tasted anything as good since.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Yorkshire pudding with a Bisto gravy pot
recommendations.reason: He could eat Yorkshire puddings every day: crispy top, bready body, drenched in gravy.
recommendations.quote: I could have Yorkshire pudding every day. In fact, if you lose the word could from that sentence, you'll have an accurate depiction
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Pepsi Max Lime
recommendations.reason: He always adds lime to diet cola, and this new drink already has it built in.
recommendations.quote: It's the Pepsi Max lime... you don't need to do it with a Pepsi Max Lime, it's already got the synthetic lime flavour.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Wall's Romantica ice cream cake with whipped cream
recommendations.reason: A lost early-90s butterscotch ice cream cake with a biscuit base; he'd originally considered just whipped cream.
recommendations.quote: the dessert I'm choosing is Wall's Romantica, which was around in the early 90s, and it was an ice cream cake in a, kind of, butterscotch flavour
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: A box of After Eights
recommendations.reason: An after-dinner treat, with the joke of putting empty wrappers back in the box.
recommendations.quote: No, I'll have the box.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Kosher boiler chicken for chicken soup
recommendations.reason: Where he buys kosher boiler chickens for his matzo ball soup.
recommendations.quote: I go to Panzer's Delicatessen in St John's Wood, because there you can buy, not just chicken, you can buy kosher chicken
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Souffle of the day, lamb and rhubarb trifle
recommendations.reason: James went on Tom Davis's recommendation and found every course mind-blowing.
recommendations.quote: Every course was mind blowing. I had a rhubarb trifle for dessert, which absolutely blew my socks off.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Japanese-fusion food
recommendations.reason: Ed still goes in all the time and loves it; James misses its original toban mushrooms.
recommendations.quote: Shack-Fuyu the other day, popped in, of course I do, always going in, love it to bits, still great.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Hot soggy French fries
recommendations.reason: The best fries he's ever eaten (he wrote about them in his book), though they've since stopped making them.
recommendations.quote: The best French fries I've ever eaten in my life were from this restaurant called la Mercerie
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

recommendations.item: Hot soggy fries
recommendations.reason: He says their hot, soggy chips are amazing.
recommendations.quote: Five Guys do hot, soggy chips and they're amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Matt Lucas

episodes.title: Ep 163: Rylan Clark
episodes.summary: Rylan Clark's 'moody foody' menu: sparkling water, poppadoms with smooth mango chutney, deep-fried mozzarella with spicy tomato dip, four upside-down East End pies with liquor, mac and cheese, a Peroni and a giant pastel de nata.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels a bit more exotic, the choice for a date or work meeting.
recommendations.quote: if it's a date, sparkling because it's just a bit more exotic
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with smooth mango chutney, mint raita, onion salad and aioli
recommendations.reason: Poppadoms won't fill you up like bread; he pours smooth (never chunky) mango chutney over them.
recommendations.quote: I love a mango chutney, but I don't like a chunky mango chutney.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Deep-fried breaded mozzarella (mozzarella in carrozza) with a dark spicy tomato dip
