recommendations.reason: He loves anything cheesy, melty and breadcrumbed, even worth a burnt lip.
recommendations.quote: I love anything deep-fried cheese in breadcrumbs, with a dirty, spicy tomato sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Four East End pie and mash shop mince pies, upside down, with liquor, vinegar and white pepper
recommendations.reason: Proper East End pie and mash; he flips the pies, eats the insides and saves the burnt tops for last. A family ritual his mum shares.
recommendations.quote: Upside down so I can cut into them, lick her over the top, vinegar
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Macaroni cheese with lots of breadcrumbs
recommendations.reason: Mac and cheese as a side makes him feel like he's having two dinners; he orders a heavily breadcrumbed one from an unnamed place.
recommendations.quote: I love a macaroni cheese on the side because I feel like I'm having two dinners.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Peroni
recommendations.reason: He's a Peroni boy, ideally on a beach.
recommendations.quote: Love a bottle of Peroni, whenever, with whatever, with whoever.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: A giant serving-sized pastel de nata
recommendations.reason: He loves slightly burnt pastéis de nata and wants a big sliceable one, with a bell rung when it's ready like in Lisbon.
recommendations.quote: I want a big pastel de nata. Why have we not got big ones?
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Pastéis de nata fresh from the oven
recommendations.reason: James found the best custard tart place in Lisbon, where a bell rings for each fresh batch; Rylan has been too and loved it.
recommendations.quote: when they've got a new batch, they ring the bell and everyone-,
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Mozzarella in carrozza and spicy tomato calabrese
recommendations.reason: His current Deliveroo 'food mood' is ordering Prezzo repeatedly.
recommendations.quote: I'm in a Prezzo mood at the moment.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Chilli cheese bites
recommendations.reason: Rylan praises their dirty, thick-battered cheese bites.
recommendations.quote: I'll tell you what's nice, chilli cheese bites.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

recommendations.item: Half-baked cookies
recommendations.reason: He loves Domino's cookies because they're barely cooked and still gooey.
recommendations.quote: them cookies at Domino's. They're handsome because they're not really cooked.
recommendations.speaker: Rylan Clark

episodes.title: Ep 164: Richard E Grant
episodes.summary: Richard E Grant wants a seaside meal of ice-cold sparkling water, warm bread with olive oil, crab linguine, a barbecued lobster, prawn and squid platter with a tub of homemade lemon mayonnaise, fresh orange juice with ice on the side, and Christmas pudding with lychee sorbet.

recommendations.item: Ice-cold sparkling water in a glass full of ice
recommendations.reason: Everything he drinks has to be brain-freezingly cold, all year round.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling water please, ice cold with a glass full of ice and I don't care how much water there is in there, but it has to be ice cold every day of the year.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Warm good bread dipped in olive oil
recommendations.reason: He has misophonia so poppadom crunching is unbearable; he doesn't eat butter, so wants warm bread soaked in olive oil.
recommendations.quote: Oh, dipping it in so that it all absorbs. Nothing like good bread.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Linguine with fresh white crab meat, medium chilli, coriander, lemon and olive oil
recommendations.reason: A dish he cooks regularly, served in a modest Italian starter portion to prime him for the main.
recommendations.quote: A bowl of linguine with fresh white crab meat, medium chilli, coriander, lemon and olive oil.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: White crab meat
recommendations.reason: His fishmonger, run by Stewart, supplies the amazing white crab meat for his linguine.
recommendations.quote: there's a great fishmonger called Sandy's run by a guy called Stewart in Twickenham... he has absolutely amazing white crab meat.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Barbecued seafood platter of lobster, giant Mozambique/Madagascar prawns and squid in garlic butter
recommendations.reason: Simple quality seafood by the sea, eaten greedily with his hands and a bib, with lemons to squeeze.
recommendations.quote: A barbecue seafood platter of lobster, giant prawns from Mozambique or Madagascar, and squid. Just those three ingredients covered in garlic butter.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Big tub of homemade lemon mayonnaise with Maldon salt
recommendations.reason: He makes it with lots of lemon, egg yolk and Dijon and dunks whole lobster into it; he carries Maldon salt everywhere.
recommendations.quote: Taking a whole lobster out of the shell and then dunking it into that big bowl of lemon mayonnaise
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Freshly squeezed orange juice with a separate glass of ice
recommendations.reason: Allergic to alcohol; he orders ice separately so he gets a full glass of undiluted juice.
recommendations.quote: A glass of fresh orange juice, fresh squeezed orange juice, and a glass of ice.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Fresh orange juice from a juicing machine
recommendations.reason: While filming Hotel Secrets he had the best fresh orange juice he'd ever drunk there and was shown the machine.
recommendations.quote: I stayed at The Gritti Palace on the Grand Canal in Venice, and they took me into the kitchen, because I said, this is the best fresh orange juice I'd ever drunk.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Christmas pudding with lychee sorbet
recommendations.reason: He stockpiles cut-price puddings in January and eats one a month; lychee sorbet gives a cold, acidic contrast as he avoids dairy and alcohol.
recommendations.quote: I think there's nothing like a Christmas pudding... It's food of the gods, yes.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

recommendations.item: Traditional British puddings (bread and butter pudding, sticky toffee pudding)
recommendations.location: Three Ways House Hotel, Mickleton, Gloucestershire, UK
recommendations.reason: He belonged to the club twenty years ago and loved gorging on platters of puddings.
recommendations.quote: twenty years ago, I belonged to The Pudding Club of England... It's the best.
recommendations.speaker: Richard E Grant

episodes.title: Ep 165: Richard Ayoade
episodes.summary: Richard Ayoade wants still water, poppadoms with all the dips, layered sweet-and-salty popcorn from North Cross Road, his twenty-year usual order of lamb madras at Gandhi's in Kennington with bhindi bhaji, a grapefruit alcohol-free beer from Hop Burns & Black plus a mango lassi, and ice creams and fruit from Fabulous Ice Fires.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He already has as much wind as he can cope with, and his dentist warned him sparkling attacks his teeth.
recommendations.quote: I'll have still please. I have as much wind as I can deal with already.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Poppadoms broken into shards with all the dips (no warm tomato)
recommendations.reason: He's having a curry so poppadoms make sense; they are part of his usual Gandhi's order, with toppings spooned onto each shard.
recommendations.quote: I will have a curried meal. So, I think a Poppadom makes sense. And, I'll always have to have all of the dips on, each section of the Poppadom.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Sweet and salty popcorn, layered with salt on top
recommendations.location: North Cross Road, East Dulwich, London, UK
recommendations.reason: He avoids starters but eats a big bag a week of first-class popcorn from an outlet near his home on North Cross Road; it's too silly to be sad while eating it.
recommendations.quote: there's very good popcorn outlets near where we live... Their popcorn is first class. It's first class popcorn.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Lamb madras with pilau rice, onion bhaji, brinjal and Peshwari naan
recommendations.reason: He has ordered exactly the same meal at Gandhi's for twenty years, sometimes twice a week, and says everything there is excellent.
recommendations.quote: As often as I can. There were times when it would be twice a week, sometimes... Everything's excellent. I always had the exact same meal.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Bhindi bhaji (okra)
recommendations.reason: Part of his usual Gandhi's order, which he shares; he loves okra, including the slimy okra his dad served with pepper soup.
recommendations.quote: Lamb madras, pilau rice, half an onion bhaji, brinjal, bhindi bhaji, Peshawari naan, three poppadoms with all the dips.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Grapefruit (or mango) alcohol-free beer, e.g. Lervig
recommendations.reason: He now prefers alcohol-free beer and would have it chosen by Glen and Jen, the New Zealand owners of this beer shop, whom he calls excellent purveyors.
recommendations.quote: I'd get it from Hop Burns & Black, from Glen and Jen... It's excellent, yes. Excellent purveyors.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Mango lassi
recommendations.reason: An additional drink to go with the curry; he loves mango.
recommendations.quote: Possibly if I were allowed an additional drink, I would have a mango lassi.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Selection of fresh ice creams (e.g. Strawberry Fields Forever, rum and raisin) and fruit
recommendations.reason: He calls it the finest ice cream you'll ever have, made by its award-winning owner Tazir, who sets aside a tub of rum and raisin for him.
recommendations.quote: this is the finest ice cream you'll ever have... Their rum and raisin, they put aside for me.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Pølse hot dog with crispy onions, Norwegian mustard and potato salad
recommendations.reason: His mum was Norwegian, and he always gets (often two) of the hot dogs sold at the airport in Norway.
recommendations.quote: I'd have the hot-dogs that you get in the airport in Norway. My mum was Norwegian. I'd always have a hot-dog there, pølse, white bun.
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Belgian chocolates, especially pralines
recommendations.reason: His mum's fancy Belgian chocolate shop, where he spent every day after school; he says the chocolates were excellent.
recommendations.quote: I'm choosing to say that the chocolates were excellent, so much so that I can't really eat any chocolate now without having a slight snobby reaction
recommendations.speaker: Richard Ayoade

recommendations.item: Small plates
recommendations.reason: James ordered only starters there at a meal with Richard and Nish because all the small plates sounded delicious.
recommendations.quote: we were at Artusi, which is a very nice Italian place, and all of the small plates just sounded delicious.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 166: Paul Chowdhry
episodes.summary: Paul Chowdhry's chaotic dream menu: still water and Ribena, avocado on toast with anchovies, soft-shell crab and crispy prawns, cacio e pepe (and a 'bat of cheese'), Dorchester chips on a cheat day, tiramisu and a Johnnie Walker hot toddy.

recommendations.item: Thin-cut chips with ketchup (cheat day)
recommendations.reason: He thinks the Dorchester restaurant does very good thin hotel-style chips, and he took his dad there for his birthday last year.
recommendations.quote: I think the Dorchester do very good chips.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe
recommendations.reason: He loved the cheesy, peppery cacio e pepe he had in Italy while filming, served in a big wheel of cheese; he found the Camden Market version terrible.
recommendations.quote: It's very cheesy. It's very peppery.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Cacio e pepe
recommendations.reason: Ed suggests Padella as a London place likely to do a good cacio e pepe.
recommendations.quote: Padella, I reckon, you'd get some good cacio e pepe.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Soft-shell crab and deep-fried king prawns with chilli sauce
recommendations.reason: He likes crispy fried soft-shell crab and prawns from a Chinese restaurant, with chilli sauce on the side.
recommendations.quote: I do like a soft-shell crab. That's probably one of my favourite starters.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Avocado on toast with anchovies and olive oil
recommendations.reason: Prompted by his Montreal avocado-on-toast order, he adds anchovies, which he values after paying 30 quid for a tin in Italy.
recommendations.quote: Yes, with anchovies on it.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Still water (waiter's recommendation) plus Ribena
recommendations.reason: He asks the waiter to recommend, and ends up with still water and Ribena 15 minutes before eating.
recommendations.quote: what would you recommend?
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Pipistrelli (bat-shaped cheese ball)
recommendations.reason: A muddled 'bat of cheese' that became a Halloween cheese-ball canape.
recommendations.quote: But I do like a bat of cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Tiramisu
recommendations.reason: He likes coffee in a dessert, and a cream-and-cocoa topping.
recommendations.quote: I like a coffee in a dessert.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

recommendations.item: Hot toddy with Johnnie Walker red label, honey, lemon and ginger
recommendations.reason: His only alcohol, a medicinal hot toddy, drunk after dessert.
recommendations.quote: you've got to mix it with honey and lemon.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Chowdhry

episodes.title: Ep 167: Rina Sawayama
episodes.summary: Rina Sawayama's menu: still water, a Joe & the Juice Joe's Club sandwich as her bread, Le Gavroche's cheese souffle, a feast of beef rolls, dumplings, noodle soup and wok-fried green beans from Mr. Dragon's Noodle House near Pasadena, a sudachi sour and a strawberry mochi cake from Natural Lawson in Tokyo.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She avoids anything fizzy because she's always talking and singing and doesn't want burps on stage.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to say still... I don't want to be gassy.
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Joe's Club sandwich (chicken and avocado) on their Nordic-style bread with pesto
recommendations.reason: The dark, crispy, dimpled bread used for their sandwiches is the best part and can't be bought anywhere else.
recommendations.quote: everything's very expensive at Joe and the Juice, but their bread is insane. And, like, please try the sandwich just for the bread.
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Cheese souffle
recommendations.location: Upper Brook Street, Mayfair, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Her ex-boyfriend's wealthy family took her there in her early twenties; the famous souffle was the best version of the thing she's ever eaten - it tasted of cheese and wealth.
recommendations.quote: it's just this amazing, fluffy, just the most refined cheese soufflé you've ever tasted
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Beef rolls, pan-fried/steamed juicy dumplings and hand-pulled noodle soup
recommendations.location: Pasadena area, Los Angeles, California, USA
recommendations.reason: A random stop when a hotpot place was closed - literally the best Chinese food she's ever had, huge portions and very cheap.
recommendations.quote: is literally the best Chinese food I've ever had in my whole life
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Wok-fried green beans with minced meat
recommendations.location: Pasadena area, Los Angeles, California, USA
recommendations.reason: Cooked fast over a fierce flame for wok hei smokiness while staying crisp - the opposite of the over-boiled veg of her childhood.
recommendations.quote: The green beans are definitely wok fried, which I believe is the most superior way of cooking vegetables
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Hotpot with shrimp paste balls in spicy tallow broth
recommendations.reason: Ed, obsessed with hotpot, loved cooking the shrimp balls in the spicy broth there.
recommendations.quote: when we went to Haidilao a couple of months ago, Leicester Square, and the shrimp, like, the shrimp balls... absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Sudachi sour (sudachi citrus, vodka, sparkling water); also umeboshi plum sour
recommendations.reason: Her favourite Japanese sour - a more bitter, limey citrus close to yuzu, and very refreshing.
recommendations.quote: It's a much more bitter version of a lime. It's, kind of, close to yuzu... that is my favourite.
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

recommendations.item: Mochi cake with cream, sponge and a whole strawberry in the middle
recommendations.reason: From the convenience store across from her Akasaka hotel where she wrote 'Akasaka Sad' - texture of cake with the pull of mochi.
recommendations.quote: It's got the texture of a cake, but it's got the pull of the mochi.
recommendations.speaker: Rina Sawayama

episodes.title: Ep 168: Alison Spittle
episodes.summary: Alison Spittle chooses home-village tap water, prawn crackers with mini Chinese takeaway dishes, her granny's mystery soups, Ainsley Harriott's 'pasta cream bean dream', a watermelon Bacardi Breezer Ice Blast in a Minion cup, and the passion fruit soufflé from The Greenhouse in Dublin with Murphy's sea salt ice cream.

recommendations.item: Tap water from her home village
recommendations.reason: She hates paying for water and wants tap water from her village (just not from when the lake was polluted).
recommendations.quote: So yes, I'd love from my village from now and not when the lake was polluted, I'd be quite happy.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Prawn crackers with little bowls of Chinese takeaway dishes (sweet and sour chicken with pineapple, dan dan noodles, gloopy Chinese-Irish curry, barbecue sauce)
recommendations.location: Westmeath, Ireland (the takeaway she worked at, now closed)
recommendations.reason: She bagged prawn crackers as a teenager at a Chinese takeaway and still thinks they're the best part of a Chinese meal.
recommendations.quote: I love a prawn cracker. For me, like, it's the best part of Chinese takeaway
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Mystery soup - her granny Minnie's soups, salty Irish funeral vegetable soup in a hollowed demi-baguette, Moroccan lentil soup
recommendations.reason: Her gran's soups were either incredible or disastrous, and she loves the thrill of not knowing; funeral soup is a favourite.
recommendations.quote: sometimes the soup would be incredible and sometimes the soup would be leftover lamb stew with a can of tuna thrown in on top of it.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Pasta cream bean dream (Ainsley Harriott's Meals in Minutes recipe: pasta, lardons, onion, green beans, lettuce, crème fraîche)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's 90s family recipe that every fussy sibling expected to hate but all loved; she now cooks it for her boyfriend.
recommendations.quote: it's a recipe that we all thought would be disgusting and then, when we ate it, it was incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Stewed red cabbage; tinned tomatoes boiled down with Worcestershire sauce
recommendations.reason: She orders red cabbage whenever it's on a menu, and the thick Worcestershire-laced tomatoes are her favourite fry-up element.
recommendations.quote: any time that there's red cabbage on a menu, no matter the meat or no matter what's served, I always order it
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Cumin and Sichuan pepper lamb skewers
recommendations.reason: Her friend Fern took her to a Chinese place in London whose name she can't remember; the skewers were the best things she's eaten.
recommendations.quote: it's a Chinese place with lamb skewers and they're incredible. They were, like, the best things I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Watermelon Bacardi Breezer made into a Tango Ice Blast, served in a Minion cup
recommendations.reason: Her favourite discontinued alcopop combined with the slushy texture of an Ice Blast.
recommendations.quote: Tango Ice Blast but Watermelon- flavoured, after Bacardi Breezer, let's do it.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Passion fruit soufflé with white chocolate and ginger sauce
recommendations.reason: A rare fancy-restaurant treat; she calls the soufflé the greatest thing she's had in her life.
recommendations.quote: the GreenHouse has this souffle that's made of passion fruit with a white chocolate and ginger sauce that you pour into it.
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Sea salt ice cream (with sweet communion wafers on top)
recommendations.reason: They make their own salt and ice cream; she says it's the greatest she's ever had.
recommendations.quote: Murphy's sea salt ice cream. Which is from an ice cream shop in Dublin and they make their own salt themselves
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Irish coffee flambéed tableside from a brass trolley
recommendations.reason: She loves the drama of the posh restaurant, which treated her hoodie-wearing boyfriend kindly, and its theatrical Irish coffee.
recommendations.quote: In Chapter One, they have, like, this special Irish coffee, which they wheel it to you on this big brass trolley
recommendations.speaker: Alison Spittle

recommendations.item: Thin cumin-dusted lamb skewers
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends the Uyghur restaurant's amazing thin lamb skewers dusted with cumin.
recommendations.quote: I've had lamb skewers from a uyghur restaurant called Etles in Walthamstow which do amazing thin lamb skewers
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 169: Ania Magliano
episodes.summary: Sweet-toothed comedian Ania Magliano orders sparkling water from a Yo! Sushi tap, peshwari naan, a Colin the Caterpillar face for starter, the tofu pad Thai from her Thai boxing camp, pick 'n' mix (plus a bite of flatmate Harry's fried chicken from The Plimsoll), Lambrusco and an apple crumble party.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water from the table tap
recommendations.reason: Seeing sparkling water gush out of the swan-neck table taps at Yo! Sushi blew her mind; she'd mix still and sparkling.
recommendations.quote: seeing sparkling water come out of a tap, I think just blew my mind when I went there. So, I want sparkling because of that.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Peshwari naan with raisins
recommendations.reason: Sweet coconut 'sugar bread'; during lockdown takeaways with her parents they had to order her her own because she wouldn't share.
recommendations.quote: I think the first time I tried it, I was like, 'This can't be right. They can't have done this.' They can't have made this on purpose, it's too good.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Colin the Caterpillar cake - a thin slice of the face and neck
recommendations.reason: A huge fan of M&S's Colin the Caterpillar; she always 'brings the Colin' to birthdays and eats the eyes first.
recommendations.quote: I want the whole cake, but I want to eat the face, but I want it when you chop off his face and you get a little bit of neck in there.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Tofu pad Thai piled high, with lime and crushed peanuts
recommendations.reason: Cooked by the family who ran the Thai boxing camp where she spent a month; the best she's ever had, and Bangkok street vendors' versions were great too.
recommendations.quote: they made, like, the best food I've had outside of my other choices.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Pick 'n' mix (white and pink chocolate mice, fizzy watermelons, Jazzies)
recommendations.reason: Being true to herself; she always carries pick 'n' mix and asks new friends for their top three.
recommendations.quote: It would be so inauthentic if I didn't pick pick n mix, like, you don't understand.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Fried chicken with a jammy sauce (bite of Harry's meal) from a Supa Ya Ramen pop-up
recommendations.reason: She took her flatmate Harry for his birthday to a Supa Ya Ramen pop-up at The Plimsoll; the fried chicken was so good they ordered another.
recommendations.quote: they had this, like, fried chicken that was really amazing. It had, like, a little jammy thing with it
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Lambrusco (fizzy red wine)
recommendations.reason: She first had fizzy red wine in Italy and loves the fun of unexpected bubbles in red wine.
recommendations.quote: I've only had this, like, once or twice, I don't know if it has a proper term, but red wine when it's fizzy.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Apple (or apple and rhubarb) crumble at a crumble party, with custard or vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Crumble is the one thing she can make; she wants a party where everyone brings a homemade crumble.
recommendations.quote: I want to hold a crumble party. Where everyone has to bring a different flavour of crumble, that they make themselves.
recommendations.speaker: Ania Magliano

recommendations.item: Pub food from the Four Legs team
recommendations.reason: James praises the Four Legs guys behind The Plimsoll for very good cooking and one of London's best burgers.
recommendations.quote: the Four Legs guys that went to their original place, lovely, there's such good cooking, they did one of the best burgers in London
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 170: Babatunde Aléshé
episodes.summary: Babatunde Aléshé goes for ice-cold sparkling water with crushed ice, toasted ciabatta with M&S truffle chicken liver pâté, fried prawns from Pappagone, his wife's Caribbean oxtail with Nigerian party jollof, crispy fried plantain, a cold Supermalt and apple crumble with ice cream.

recommendations.item: Ice-cold sparkling water with crushed ice
recommendations.reason: On a hot day, crisp cold sparkling water with gentle bubbles hits differently; crushed ice gives it a slushy appeal.
recommendations.quote: You know what, cold sparkling water hits differently.
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Warm toasted ciabatta with truffle chicken liver pâté
recommendations.reason: He discovered pâté late and loves the M&S chicken liver version topped with a truffle layer, a special-occasion treat because it's expensive.
recommendations.quote: Marks and Spencer do one with truffle on top. What? Are you mad? Have you tasted truffle?
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Deep-fried breaded prawns with sweet chilli sauce
recommendations.location: Stroud Green Road, Finsbury Park, London, UK
recommendations.reason: The Italian restaurant he and his wife regularly go to; the whole menu is fantastic but the starters are off the hook.
recommendations.quote: So, Pappagone's, their starters are-, their whole menu's fantastic, but their starters are crazy, off the hook.
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Caribbean oxtail with Nigerian party (smoked) jollof rice, salad and coleslaw
recommendations.reason: A fusion of his and his wife's heritage that she cooks at home; the oxtail is buttery and succulent, and smoky Nigerian party jollof beats all other jollof.
recommendations.quote: My wife's cooking at home, yes, because you wouldn't be able to buy jellof rice at a Caribbean restaurant
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Crispy fried plantain, African style
recommendations.reason: He prefers it fried crispy and savoury, firm inside, rather than the soft, sweet Jamaican way.
recommendations.quote: Africans, we like ours savoury so we'll fry it very crispy, that's how we like ours.
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Ice-cold Supermalt
recommendations.reason: It goes hand in hand with jollof and oxtail, and takes him back to childhood when kids drank it while the adults had Guinness.
recommendations.quote: all the kids were reaching for a Supermalt because it made us feel like big people
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Hot apple crumble with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: He calls it the best dessert ever; he's an ice cream man since lumpy school custard put him off custard.
recommendations.quote: It's beautiful, man. It's the best dessert, whoever came up with that, big them up, boy.
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

recommendations.item: Caribbean oxtail
recommendations.reason: He recommends it as a good London Caribbean restaurant for the hosts to try oxtail properly.
recommendations.quote: In London you're probably looking at Brown Eagle, Caribbean restaurant, they're really good.
recommendations.speaker: Babatunde Aléshé

episodes.title: Ep 171: Chloe Petts
episodes.summary: Chloe Petts orders two menus, a 'girlfriend menu' (bruschetta, A Putia's pistachio pesto shrimp pasta, fennel and orange salad, tiramisu) and a meaty 'ghost menu' (mini fry-up, a barbecue platter with all the sides, bacon pancakes), plus sparkling water, a London bread platter, pale ale and red wine.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: A recent convert after years of ordering tap to save money; she sees it as the ultimate luxury because nobody needs it, and it's great on a hangover.
recommendations.quote: I just think it's the most luxurious drink you could possibly drink, because you don't need it.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Bread platter (sourdough, focaccia) with endless pats of butter
recommendations.reason: Thinks London is in a golden age of bread and Pophams is her number one.
recommendations.quote: I honestly think we're in a golden age of bread, in London... Where you go to Pophams, Jolene
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Bread
recommendations.reason: Her second favourite bakery in London's bread renaissance.
recommendations.quote: Those are my favourite two.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Guinness bread
recommendations.reason: Amazing Guinness bread with the perfect blend of dark and fluffy inside and crispy outside.
recommendations.quote: they did amazing Guinness bread. And it was just, like, the perfect blend of, like, dark and fluffy, and, like, crispy on the outside.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Tomato bruschetta with sun-warmed tomatoes, flaky salt and basil (girlfriend menu)
recommendations.reason: Based on what she ate at A Putia in Sicily, elevated with great crusty bread and tomatoes warmed by the sun.
recommendations.quote: this is pretty similar to everything that I ate at A Putia, this place in Ortigia in Sicily.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Mini full fry-up with black and white pudding, fried bread, tattie scone (ghost menu)
recommendations.reason: Her true meat-loving self; breakfast as the starter of the day, eating the tomato first so the rest feels like a reward.
recommendations.quote: Full fry-up. I just want, like, a never-ending carousel of meat.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Frilly pasta with pistachio pesto, cream and tiny shrimp (girlfriend menu)
recommendations.reason: One of the best things she has ever eaten; she went back three times on holiday and finished her friends' portions too.
recommendations.quote: this dish from A Putia in Sicily. Which I think is one of the best things I've ever eaten, and I went back for it three times
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Barbecue platter: brisket, pork and beef ribs, burnt ends, smoked turkey, jalapeño cheddar sausage (ghost menu)
recommendations.reason: An obsession with slow-cooked barbecue meat that began after she went vegetarian, fed by Instagram reels of brisket being cut.
recommendations.quote: So the main course of the ghost menu is all of the barbecue food you could possibly imagine.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Crunchy salad of fennel, orange and dill (girlfriend menu)
recommendations.reason: Chosen to add crunch, sweetness and acidity against the rich, soft pasta.
recommendations.quote: what the salad needs is crunch and then a bit of sweet and acidity
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Barbecue sides: cornbread, mac and cheese, collard greens, Texas toast, fried pickle coins, vinegar coleslaw (ghost menu)
recommendations.reason: Conventional barbecue sides; she loves frickle coins for maximum fried surface area and vinegar slaw to cut through the rich meat.
recommendations.quote: Very conventional barbecue fair, cornbread, macaroni cheese, collared-, what is it?
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Pint of pale ale on a semi-empty stomach, then a glass of red wine (with any drink available)
recommendations.reason: She wants to arrive at the meal a bit tipsy, as drunk food tastes best, then drink red wine chosen by Ed, eaten outdoors in Italy as when she was a nanny in Perugia.
recommendations.quote: I get myself a pint of a delicious pale ale, I drink it on a semi-empty stomach, so by the time I'm ready to sit down and eat this meal I'm a little bit tipsy.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Tiramisu (girlfriend menu)
recommendations.reason: Completes the Italian theme; she has grown to love the coffee-soaked sponge, and her girlfriend made her a tiramisu cake.
recommendations.quote: I'm going to complete the, sort of, Italian theme and I'm going to go in with a tiramisu.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Fluffy pancakes with crispy bacon and unlimited maple syrup, followed by three Rennies (ghost menu)
recommendations.reason: Keeps the all-meat breakfast-to-dinner theme; loves sweet and savoury together.
recommendations.quote: I think I'm just going to have pancakes, bacon and maple syrup.
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Funnel cake
recommendations.reason: A childhood theme-park treat she found transformative and has chased ever since; mentioned as an alternative dessert.
recommendations.quote: it was just transformative when I was a child, it was so wonderful and I've always tried to, sort of, hit that high ever since
recommendations.speaker: Chloe Petts

recommendations.item: Texas barbecue
recommendations.reason: James gave it a shout-out; he went on two of his three days in Dallas.
recommendations.quote: Pecan Lodge, shout out to Pecan Lodge, Dallas... I was in Dallas for three days, I went there for two of the days.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Savoury soufflé pancakes with butter, avocado, asparagus and poached eggs
recommendations.reason: James had the best pancakes he's ever had there: the fluffiest and most flavourful.
recommendations.quote: Fucking hell, I had the best pancakes I've ever had the other day... It's in Manchester and the pancakes were just the fluffiest
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 172: Stanley Tucci
episodes.summary: Stanley Tucci chooses San Pellegrino, a martini, salty Florentine schiacciata, oysters three ways, his mother's lasagne bolognese with charred spinach, Villa Sparina white and a soft red, and blueberry pie with vanilla ice cream.

recommendations.item: Gently sparkling San Pellegrino
recommendations.reason: He likes mellow sparkling water to settle the stomach, and is a San Pellegrino ambassador who genuinely loves it.
recommendations.quote: No, I really do love it. They asked me to, you know, be their ambassador a couple of years ago
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Schiacciata / Ligurian-style focaccia with olive oil and lots of salt
recommendations.reason: He prefers the thinner, pressed-down Florentine schiacciata to fluffier UK focaccia, with lots of oil and salt and a nice crunch.
recommendations.quote: Just the bread with olive oil and tonnes of salt.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Vodka or gin martini to start
recommendations.reason: He loves pre-dinner cocktails like his father served, and would open with a martini.
recommendations.quote: I would do the martini at the start, then I would have a glass of the white then I would have a glass of the red.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Raw oysters, oysters Rockefeller and fried oysters
recommendations.reason: Oysters give him energy without filling him up; he adds Rockefellers and the best fried oysters of his life from a Vancouver oyster bar whose name he can't recall.
recommendations.quote: They were literally the best fried oysters I've ever had-, In my life. Like, you could not stop eating them.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Lasagne bolognese made by his mother
recommendations.reason: Perhaps the most delicious pasta ever made, when done properly; his mum's version with slow-cooked sauce, béchamel and spinach and wheat pasta layers.
recommendations.quote: my Mum's lasagne bolognese is just one of the greatest things ever.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Charred spinach with garlic, olive oil, salt and lemon
recommendations.reason: A stupidly simple leafy green is all you need alongside a lasagne that has everything in it.
recommendations.quote: really simple, olive oil with a little bit of garlic, but you cook it with the garlic
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Villa Sparina white wine, then a soft low-tannin red
recommendations.reason: Radiation treatment means he can't drink tannic wines; Villa Sparina's white was served at his wedding and comes from a beautiful vineyard hotel they stayed at in Piedmont.
recommendations.quote: That white wine, not really crazy expensive or anything, but absolutely delicious.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Blueberry pie with a dollop of vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Not a big sweet fan, but he loves blueberry pie made with East Coast blueberries, with hot and cold mixing.
recommendations.quote: blueberry pie, I love blueberry pie. Like, with blueberries from, like, the East Coast of the US, like Maine
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Black Velvet served in a pewter tankard
recommendations.reason: Ed loves Rules' ice-cold Guinness and champagne Black Velvet in pewter tankards.
recommendations.quote: It's ice cold in a pewter tankard, Guinness and champagne. It's fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Schnitzel with brown butter, capers, mushrooms and lingonberries
recommendations.reason: Ed had a phenomenal hungover schnitzel there the day after a wedding, despite a lingonberry exploding on his new shirt.
recommendations.quote: I had a fantastic schnitzel at a restaurant called Bar, but it's like a brown butter sauce with capers in it
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Oysters with pecorino garlic butter meal kit
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about Decatur's barbecue oyster kits with insane pecorino garlic butter.
recommendations.quote: they send this amazing pecorino garlic butter that you put on them and then do them on the barbecue. And, that is just the best.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Guinness tasting
recommendations.reason: Tucci remembers the two half-pints at the end of the tour tasting different from any other Guinness, like a seven-course meal in a glass.
recommendations.quote: That's a seven-course meal, I mean, that's like-, in a glass.
recommendations.speaker: Stanley Tucci

recommendations.item: Guinness
recommendations.reason: Ed was told by everyone in Belfast that it's the pub to go to for a Guinness.
recommendations.quote: there's a pub that everyone said, 'You've got to go there and get a Guinness.'
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 173: Chris Redd (Live at Just for Laughs Montreal)
episodes.summary: Chris Redd's live Montreal menu: still water, bruschetta from Halifax, a dozen oysters, branzino over angel hair with olive cream sauce, sauteed spinach with bacon fat, a perfect Bulleit old fashioned and his mum's coconut pound cake.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: He is a still man; sparkling has the consistency of Sprite without the fun.
recommendations.quote: Still. I'm a still man.
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Bruschetta (over garlic bread)
recommendations.reason: He loves bruschetta because the tomatoes take it to another level, and the best he has had was at Halifax.
recommendations.quote: it's a restaurant called Halifax and it's really good and they, like, a really great bruschetta there.
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Twelve oysters with cocktail sauce, horseradish and lemon
recommendations.reason: He hated oysters most of his life until a friend got him into them a year ago; now one of his favourite things.
recommendations.quote: I've hated oysters, like, most of my life until the last year, my friend put me on oysters and it's now one of my favourite things.
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Branzino over angel hair pasta with olive cream sauce
recommendations.reason: A perfectly cooked sea bass over angel hair with olive cream sauce, breadcrumbs and little slices of tomato.
recommendations.quote: a perfectly done branzino over angel head with, like, an olive cream sauce and some saute spinach
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Sauteed spinach with garlic and a drizzle of bacon fat
recommendations.reason: Easy but hard to mess up; he cooks it with garlic and adds a little rendered bacon fat.
recommendations.quote: I like saute spinach a lot so I think that would be my side dish. It's, kind of, easy but people can't fuck it up.
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Perfect old fashioned with Bulleit bourbon (plus a Sprite on the side)
recommendations.reason: He wants one made by a real bartender with the right balance of bitters, sugar and orange and a giant ice cube.
recommendations.quote: Perfect old fashioned with bullet bourbon.
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Southern coconut pound cake with icing
recommendations.reason: His mum makes it every time he goes home; unusually for a pound cake it has a thin, just-sweet-enough icing.
recommendations.quote: this coconut pound cake with icing that my momma makes. It's a pound cake, it's a southern pound cake that actually has icing on it
recommendations.speaker: Chris Redd

recommendations.item: Oysters
recommendations.reason: Ed and James ate there the day before; Ed says the oysters were very good and the server was excellent and patient.
recommendations.quote: They were good oysters, though, at Joe Beef, they were very good.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 174: Mel Giedroyc (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Christmas special: sparkling water with elderflower, poppadoms, mackerel pate on Melba toast, a pyramid of posh Scotch eggs, bread sauce/gravy/stuffing as Christmas dinner, a tiny Hugh Grant as a side, Bacardi and diet Coke, and Ferrero Rocher.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a dash of elderflower or raspberry
recommendations.reason: Mel dislikes neat water so wants sparkling with a flavour splash.
recommendations.quote: I'll have a sparkling water with a dash of, let's say, elderflower.
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with a full array of chutneys
recommendations.reason: She prefers crispy, snacky poppadoms with lime, mint and mango chutneys over claggy bread.
recommendations.quote: It's pops all the way. Because you have the beautiful array of your lime, you lime chilli, your lime chutney, your mint chutney
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Build-your-own mackerel pate on Melba toast
recommendations.reason: Loves mackerel pate and wants to assemble it herself on crisp toasts.
recommendations.quote: I want to build it myself.
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Pyramid of posh Scotch eggs (spicy lamb one by Big Zuu's chefs, a Gloucestershire pub one, a black pudding one)
recommendations.reason: Wants expensive, hot, soft-yolked Scotch eggs; the lamb version from Big Zuu's show was better than any she'd had. The Gloucestershire pub was not named.
recommendations.quote: I want an absolute, expensive, humdinger of a Scotchegg.
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Christmas dinner: bread sauce, gravy, stuffing (plus pigs in blankets) on a prison tray
recommendations.reason: Strips Christmas dinner down to the highlights, kept separate, and repeated as a Boxing Day sandwich.
recommendations.quote: Those are the highlights of the meal, guys.
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: A tiny Hugh Grant on a plate
recommendations.reason: A joke side dish: a miniature Hugh Grant she might lick.
recommendations.quote: If he was curled up on a little plate, just being his normal little self
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Bacardi and diet Coke
recommendations.reason: Bacardi for the fun, diet Coke to keep it going.
recommendations.quote: The fun prolonger, if you will, all in one drink.
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Pyramid of Ferrero Rocher plus the Taskmaster exotic sandwich
recommendations.reason: Ambassador's-reception pyramid of chocolates, plus her Taskmaster sandwich.
recommendations.quote: Oh I do love a Ferrero Rocher, can we have those for pudsies?
recommendations.speaker: Mel Giedroyc

recommendations.item: Scotch egg with Naga chilli
recommendations.location: Under Temple Meads Station, Bristol, UK
recommendations.reason: Ed recommends this bakery by the station for its spicy Naga chilli Scotch egg.
recommendations.quote: They did a Scotch egg with Naga chilli, so it was quite spicy. Fantastic.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: The Bruce chocolate fudge cake
recommendations.reason: Ed raves about the 12-layer Bruce Bogtrotter-inspired cake they sent him (a mail-order company).
recommendations.quote: Twelve layers of this chocolate fudge cake thing... it's the best thing ever.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 175: Alex Horne (Christmas Special)
episodes.summary: Alex Horne's deliberately unfussy Christmas menu: Orangina, Mighty White with Primula, crisps and a friend's crackling, his student-style pesto pasta with Boursin and frankfurter, communion wafers, a moules-marinière-and-bread-sauce drink and a Mars bar.

recommendations.item: Orangina (instead of water)
recommendations.reason: He doesn't like the texture of water; Fanta or, abroad, Orangina is nicer, and he likes shaking the bottle to 'wake the taste'.
recommendations.quote: I like that it's asleep when you buy it and you've got to wake it up and then drink it. Surprise.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Mighty White medium-sliced bread with wrapped butter, Primula shrimp cheese spread and American cheese slices (plus a Biscoff Pop-Tart)
recommendations.reason: He insists white bread is best; he loved squeezing Primula shrimp cheese onto bread as a kid, tearing the bread as his mum Sheila taught him.
recommendations.quote: White bread. Anyone who doesn't have white bread is lying to you.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Crisps and dips (Pringles, McCoy's, Taytos) with pork crackling
recommendations.reason: A crisp platter alongside crackling his friend Jules Watson made at the weekend, which was really nice.
recommendations.quote: Cooked by my friend Jules Watson because he made me crackling at the weekend, and it was really nice.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Penne with Saclà pesto, Boursin, sliced frankfurter and grated cheddar, cooked by Jay Rayner
recommendations.reason: The only meal he can cook and still makes; he'd love to see a chef make it to check it's as good as his.
recommendations.quote: I do cook it for myself, but I'd love to see a chef making it and see if it was as good as mine.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Jamie Oliver pork/sausage roll from motorway service stations (second main)
recommendations.reason: He eats them a lot now and thinks they're a cut above the norm.
recommendations.quote: Jamie Oliver sausage rolls from the service stations. They are incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Christmas: Buck's Fizz, turkey with trimmings, the pineapple-leaf counting game and After Eights
recommendations.reason: His family Christmas traditions, especially guessing the number of leaves on a pineapple, which inspired his pineapple tattoo.
recommendations.quote: every Christmas we have a game where grandpa-, we all have to guess how many leaves are on the top of a pineapple
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: A couple of communion wafers, flavoured 'nice and spicy'
recommendations.reason: He had one once at church, didn't mind it and would like another, purely for the physical wafer.
recommendations.quote: It's the wafers you get at church.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Moules marinière liquor mixed with bread sauce and a glug of Baileys, at room temperature in an engraved pewter tankard
recommendations.reason: An invented combination of what he calls the two nicest liquids in the world, made by Jay Rayner.
recommendations.quote: We're going to have the liquid from a moules marinière stirred in with some bread sauce because they're the two nicest liquids in the world.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Mars bar (room temperature, 'fun-sized' meaning bigger)
recommendations.reason: He thinks it's the nicest pudding and even argued for Mars bars to be handed out at his wedding.
recommendations.quote: for pudding, I'm having a Mars bar and I think it's the nicest pudding
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

recommendations.item: Birthday drinks
recommendations.reason: Pineapple-obsessed Alex goes to the Pineapple pub every year for his birthday.
recommendations.quote: we go to the Pineapple Pub obviously for my birthday every year, so I love pineapples.
recommendations.speaker: Alex Horne

episodes.title: Ep 176: Paul Mescal
episodes.summary: Paul Mescal orders an ice bucket of Mexican Coca-Cola, Brat's anchovy flatbread (plus their bread and butter), his mum's Christmas broccoli and potato soup, a cave-restaurant carbonara in Puglia, Elephant & Castle Dublin buffalo wings with NoMad fries, a Sergeant Pepper cocktail from NoMad London, and an invented cookie-dough skillet with chocolate lava cake and double cream.

recommendations.item: Mexican Coca-Cola in glass bottles, kept in an ice bucket
recommendations.reason: Instead of water he wants Mexican Coke throughout the meal; made with cane sugar, from a glass bottle, it tastes better and feels special. He discovered it in LA.
recommendations.quote: Coke is my favourite thing. Like, that's the cornerstone of my menu, is Mexican Cola.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Puffed sourdough flatbread with anchovies (plus the bread and butter)
recommendations.reason: The flame-grilled, slightly burnt bread with salty anchovies is the best bread he's ever eaten, and he says there are no misses on Brat's menu.
recommendations.quote: It's the best piece of bread I've ever eaten.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Broccoli, potato and onion soup with double cream, with O'Donnell's brown bread and Kerrygold butter
recommendations.reason: The one Christmas experiment of his mum's that really worked; thick, salty and hearty, and he'd eat buckets of it.
recommendations.quote: she makes this broccoli, potato, onion soup... I would eat buckets of it.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Spaghetti carbonara
recommendations.reason: His first carbonara in Italy, with perfect simple ingredients and salty pancetta, eaten in a cave restaurant at sunset with bats flying around (restaurant not named).
recommendations.quote: the restaurant that we were in was this cave in Puglia with sunset and bats were flying around and I was like, 'This is pretty perfect.'
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Chicken wings in buffalo sauce (circa 2010s)
recommendations.reason: The wings from his first teenage trips into Dublin, lathered in buffalo sauce; he says they've since shrunk and got drier.
recommendations.quote: chicken wings and chips and it was just lathered in this beautiful buffalo sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Fries with mustard seed sauce
recommendations.location: Bow Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: He wants NoMad's fries with their mustard seed sauce alongside the wings instead of Elephant & Castle's chips.
recommendations.quote: Actually, the fries I would love to have from the Nomad hotel.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Sergeant Pepper cocktail (jalapeno tequila, pineapple, coriander)
recommendations.location: Bow Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: A cold, green, spicy-sweet tequila cocktail he wants throughout the meal; he also loves the hotel's library bar.
recommendations.quote: they do this cocktail called the Sergeant Pepper and it is just stunning.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Skillet of half-baked cookie dough with a molten chocolate lava cake and cold double cream
recommendations.reason: A dream combination he invented, inspired by a British Airways chocolate fondant: hot gooey cookie dough and oozing cake with cold cream, in a portion too big to finish.
recommendations.quote: it's a dream thing that I haven't actually had, but that I'm putting together.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Bacon cheeseburger with mustard seed sauce
recommendations.location: Bow Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: An honourable mention that nearly made his menu; he recommends having the burger and fries in the library bar.
recommendations.quote: it's just a perfect big cooked burger with bacon and cheese and this mustard sauce
recommendations.speaker: Paul Mescal

recommendations.item: Small plates, pitta with tahini, sourdough and butter, celeriac shawarma
recommendations.reason: Ed enjoyed a solo bar lunch at Ottolenghi's restaurant where the chefs sent over all their breads as a lovely gesture.
recommendations.quote: very lovely gesture from the chefs at Ottolenghi's ROVI.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Mexican restaurant (Santiago Lastra)
recommendations.reason: Ed calls Santiago Lastra's restaurant wonderful, recalling a mezcal-fuelled night at its test kitchen.
recommendations.quote: Santiago Lastra's Test Kitchen before he opened the wonderful restaurant KOL.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Cocktails
recommendations.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World, Florida, USA
recommendations.reason: James had delicious cocktails at this Disney World bar and plans to go back.
recommendations.quote: You go there and you get some delicious cocktails.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 177: Kathy Burke
episodes.summary: Kathy Burke's seedless, mostly home-cooked pescatarian menu: Cranks wholemeal toast, The Ivy's tomato tart, homemade spaghetti pesto, pan-fried sea bass with 'Kath's continental potatoes', steamed greens, a pint of milk-first tea, and her friend Pete's blueberry pavlova.

recommendations.item: Still bottled or filtered water (not tap)
recommendations.reason: She loves water and drinks a lot of it, but avoids tap water because of her delicate stomach. She can't stand cucumber 'spa water'.
recommendations.quote: I drink a lot of water and I drink bottled water... I don't like water straight out the tap because I've got a funny tummy
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Cranks wholemeal toast with olive spread (no seeds)
recommendations.reason: A dense wholemeal loaf from the brand of the pioneering Soho vegetarian restaurant she relied on when she first went veggie. Diverticulitis means it must be seedless.
recommendations.quote: I love Cranks wholemeal, it's quite dense but I love it, it's the best toast, it's wonderful.
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Roasted tomato tart with flaky pastry and balsamic dressing
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: She found it so delicious that she dreamt about it that night and went back a week later just to eat it again.
recommendations.quote: they did a tomato tart that was so delicious I dreamt about it that night and I went back to the restaurant a week later
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Pasta course: spaghetti with homemade pesto
recommendations.reason: She makes her own pesto (basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan, a few spinach leaves) about once a week because restaurant pesto is often from a jar.
recommendations.quote: my little pasta course would be my spaghetti pesto, home-made pesto.
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Pan-fried sea bass with chilli-oil crispy skin and Kath's continental potatoes
recommendations.reason: A simple fish dish she cooks herself, served with a potato, onion and tomato traybake in garlic oil that she invented from leftovers.
recommendations.quote: I will have very simple pan-fried sea bass. I pan fry it skin down in a little bit of chilly oil
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Steamed medley of broccoli, spinach and peas
recommendations.reason: She wants something steamed to cut through the oil of the main course, and absolutely no creamed spinach.
recommendations.quote: we need something steamed
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: A pint of tea, milk in first, in a tall glass
recommendations.reason: She loves tea and always makes her own, milk first. She drinks it by the pint so she doesn't keep having to make another mug.
recommendations.quote: I thought, 'What am I doing? I could just have a pint of tea and then I haven't got to keep making another mug of tea.'
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Blueberry pavlova with golden caster sugar meringue, mascarpone and fromage frais
recommendations.reason: Her friend Pete made it seedless for her after a strawberry one, and it was out of this world: a chewy meringue, a filling that isn't too creamy, and blueberry juice poured over.
recommendations.quote: he made a pavlova with blueberries. It was out of this world. It was just incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Kathy Burke

recommendations.item: Burrata salad with peas and courgette, and other salads
recommendations.reason: James and Ed rave about the salads at this rotisserie chicken place, which James orders on Deliveroo.
recommendations.quote: their burrata salad with peas and courgette is one of my favourites, really big peas.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 178: Fern Brady
episodes.summary: Fern Brady orders sparkling water, GAIL's potato and rosemary sourdough with Quicke's whey butter, a tofu jianbing from Chinese Tapas House, a fiery malatang, Bubala's confit potato latkes, a red wine she first loved at The Stand in Edinburgh, and cardamom buns followed by fancy single-origin chocolate.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: She read sparkling water is slightly bad for you, so drinking it makes her feel like a rebel.
recommendations.quote: whenever I drink it I feel like a rebel now, which is quite sad, because it is just water.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Potato and rosemary sourdough with Quicke's whey butter (or whipped butter)
recommendations.reason: She loves bread more than anything, and GAIL's potato and rosemary sourdough is the best; Ed orders the same thing.
recommendations.quote: GAIL's potato and rosemary sourdough.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Tofu jianbing (Chinese savoury crepe with egg, hoisin, pickles, crispy wonton skins and spicy tofu sticks)
recommendations.reason: Her all-time favourite food, first handed to her by her brother at a street stall in Shanghai; now she gets it in London near Chinatown.
recommendations.quote: this is, like, my all-time favourite food in the whole world
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Malatang at the spiciest level, with rice noodles, Chinese doughnuts, eggs, veg and lotus root
recommendations.reason: Her brothers in Shanghai introduced her to the pick-your-own-ingredients spicy soup; it's the numbing chilli broth she loves.
recommendations.quote: It's the actual soup base is so tasty.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Confit potato latkes with toum
recommendations.reason: Wafer-thin confit potato layers that she and everyone she knows who's been can't stop talking about; the vegetarian restaurant also does halloumi with black honey.
recommendations.quote: Something, I've come back to over and over again... It's Bubala confit potato latkes.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Red wine (transcribed as 'Baron de Balzac Caringion')
recommendations.reason: One of the first wines that showed her you could drink something really nice without getting hammered; she suspects they stock it because the name sounds like 'ball sac'.
recommendations.quote: it was one that they served at the Stand in Edinburgh.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Kardemummabullar (cardamom buns)
recommendations.reason: She loves them more than cinnamon buns, makes and braids them herself, and her Swedish friend Evelyn Mok approved.
recommendations.quote: They're better than cinnamon buns, I would say.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Fancy single-origin chocolate (e.g. Pump Street)
recommendations.reason: A chocolate subscription box got her hooked on posh chocolate, which she says gives a coffee-like buzz.
recommendations.quote: once you start eating it, you can't go back.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Strawberry-flavoured speciality coffee
recommendations.reason: She thinks it's the best coffee shop in the UK.
recommendations.quote: there's this coffee shop in Edinburgh called Fortitude that I honestly think is, like, the best coffee shop in the UK.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Indian deli
recommendations.reason: She visited while filming a travelogue and recommends it; the owner turned out to be Meera Sodha's relative.
recommendations.quote: Bobby's Deli, it's amazing, by the way
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Fancy croissants
recommendations.reason: Fern says it does 'insanely fancy croissants', and Ed is obsessed with it on Instagram.
recommendations.quote: We went on a trip to this place, Fitzroy, in Melbourne, that does insanely fancy croissants
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Pizza
recommendations.location: Hither Green, Lewisham, London, UK (closed; owners moved back to Naples)
recommendations.reason: Her 'allergy pizza': so good she kept ordering it even though it made her lips swell; she's never had a better one.
recommendations.quote: I've never had a pizza that good since.
recommendations.speaker: Fern Brady

recommendations.item: Hotpot
recommendations.reason: James and Ed rave about the hotpot place as a brilliant night out with good ingredients.
recommendations.quote: Hai Di Lao, near Leicester Square, absolutely brilliant. Such a good night out.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Confit potatoes
recommendations.reason: Ed compares Bubala's latkes to Quality Chop House's confit potatoes, which he calls the best potatoes.
recommendations.quote: the confit potatoes that Quality Chop has and they're just the best potatoes
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 181: Cariad Lloyd
episodes.summary: Self-confessed sugar addict Cariad Lloyd picks a pain au chocolat from Miel, Osaka okonomiyaki, her husband's roast chicken, her sister-in-law's miso soup, an elderflower spritz and a four-pudding trolley from Amass, The Sportsman, her own pavlova and Mamie Gateaux, plus Hawksmoor Rolos and Pierre Herme macarons.

recommendations.item: Still tap water with a little ice and a slice of lemon
recommendations.reason: She's very gassy and doesn't see why you'd add more gas to a body; she loves plain water.
recommendations.quote: it's still, because I don't understand why you would add more gas to any situation of a body.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Pain au chocolat
recommendations.reason: One of the best patisseries in London; proper layered, buttery French-style pain au choc with good chocolate.
recommendations.quote: It's just near Warren Street and it's one of the best bakery patisseries in London... Everything from that shop is incredible.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Okonomiyaki with Kewpie mayo, sauce and bonito flakes
recommendations.reason: First had at a local spot in Osaka when her brother married her Japanese sister-in-law; all the English guests lost their minds.
recommendations.quote: All of the English people were like, 'This is so good. This is amazing.' We lost our minds.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Roast chicken (leg) with goose-fat roast potatoes, honey-roast carrots, a small Yorkshire pudding and proper gravy, plus mum's boiled carrots and broccoli
recommendations.reason: Comfort food cooked by her foodie husband, with her mum's slightly undercooked veg for nostalgia.
recommendations.quote: if I'm sad or things are rubbish just that home comfort of proper roast chicken.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Homemade miso soup with seaweed and finely sliced carrot
recommendations.reason: Her Japanese sister-in-law's basic home cooking, which feels comforting and cleansing.
recommendations.quote: you drink it and you think, 'I feel better.' That's how I feel about really good miso soup.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Non-alcoholic elderflower spritz with peeled cucumber ribbons and fresh mint
recommendations.reason: She gets drunk on half a glass of wine; elderflower is refreshing and cuts through all the sugar.
recommendations.quote: I am big into elderflower. An elderflower spritz, and if it comes with some shaved cucumber
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Marigold custard with wild Swedish blueberries, bee pollen and lavender honey
recommendations.reason: A tiny pudding at a posh Copenhagen restaurant that tasted like summer, using ingredients grown on site.
recommendations.quote: it was like summer. Like someone had made summer into a pudding and put it in your mouth.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Bramley apple souffle with salted caramel ice cream
recommendations.reason: The best souffle of her life; it tasted of bonfires and autumn and left them speechless.
recommendations.quote: when you dug it in, it tasted of bonfires and autumn.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Her own homemade pavlova with Chantilly cream, raspberries, passion fruit and mint
recommendations.reason: She perfected a chewy-centred pavlova using cornflour and vinegar.
recommendations.quote: I make a really good pavlova because I love pavlova, so I perfected the recipe of pavlova.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Raspberry and pistachio frangipane with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: A cafe opposite where she lived in Paris, baking fresh frangipanes daily; she went almost every day.
recommendations.quote: they used to make a raspberry pistachio frangipane, which was just-, yes... and we lived opposite it, and I went there a lot.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Thick Italian hot chocolate
recommendations.reason: Discovered interrailing in Italy after school; a hot chocolate you can stand a spoon in.
recommendations.quote: I also want a really good hot chocolate, an Italian hot chocolate. Like, one you stand your spoon up in.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Petit fours: homemade salted Rolos
recommendations.reason: Big fat salted Rolos that are what a Rolo should be; Ed agrees they are fantastic.
recommendations.quote: It's like what you want a Rolo to be but a Rolo isn't.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Macarons, especially passion fruit and chocolate
recommendations.reason: The best macarons, which she says arrive in London fresh on the Eurostar.
recommendations.quote: They're the best macarons, passion fruit and chocolate particularly.
recommendations.speaker: Cariad Lloyd

recommendations.item: Strawberry cheesecake
recommendations.reason: James's best cheesecake ever; Henry Widdicombe said it was what he'd been chasing his whole life.
recommendations.quote: if you're ever in Copenhagen again, I have to recommend this place to you because it is the best cheesecake I've ever had ever.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: White chocolate and miso cookies
recommendations.reason: Ed and James rave about the miso white chocolate cookies.
recommendations.quote: But those miso white chocolate ones were the best.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Blackberry souffle
recommendations.reason: Ed had an amazing, not-eggy blackberry souffle there.
recommendations.quote: I had an amazing soufflé at The Hand and Flowers, a blackberry soufflé, that was not eggy
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 183: Motsi Mabuse
episodes.summary: Motsi Mabuse picks sparkling water with lemon, dark German Vollkornbrot, a shared Italian antipasti platter, a wafer-thin schnitzel and rösti from the Kempinski hotel near her home, Chocolate Block wine and a chocolate fondant (plus crema catalana to share).

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with lemon, ice cubes and glitter
recommendations.reason: She finds still water joyless; sparkling feels like something is happening, the 'Strictly of waters'.
recommendations.quote: Sparkling. Still water is death guys.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: German Vollkornbrot (dark wholegrain bread) with butter, from a German bakery selection
recommendations.reason: She loves the heavy dark German breads and the huge choice in German bakeries.
recommendations.quote: Healthy, nice, thick and then you have some butter on it. That's amazing when it's freshly done.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Italian antipasti platter: tomato and mozzarella, salami, mushrooms, melon with prosciutto, sun-dried tomatoes, fried courgette
recommendations.reason: She loves a house platter she can mix and share with her husband (and all the Strictly judges).
recommendations.quote: Yes, antipasti, exactly but a yummy one.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Wafer-thin pork schnitzel with cucumber salad, lingonberry sauce and fries
recommendations.location: Falkenstein, Königstein im Taunus, near Frankfurt, Germany
recommendations.reason: A proper thin, crunchy schnitzel; she wants it from the hotel restaurant near her home, which she says does everything brilliantly.
recommendations.quote: Like, it's thin, thin, thin, thin, thin, and then it's crunchy
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Potato rösti with fresh truffle to grate over
recommendations.location: Falkenstein, Königstein im Taunus, near Frankfurt, Germany
recommendations.reason: Her favourite rösti comes from this hotel restaurant, which has views over Frankfurt; she adds truffle because she loves anything truffle.
recommendations.quote: So, there's a Kempinski Hotel there and in the Kempinski there's a nice restaurant
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: The Chocolate Block (South African red wine)
recommendations.reason: Her beloved South African wine, rich like drinking velvet; she used to fly bottles over in her suitcase.
recommendations.quote: It's rich and it feels like you're drinking velvet.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Chocolate fondant with ice cream, plus crema catalana shared with her husband
recommendations.reason: She sticks with chocolate, and splits a crema catalana with her husband, who always orders an extra pudding.
recommendations.quote: Yes, yes, yes, and he'll probably order something on top, because he does that.
recommendations.speaker: Motsi Mabuse

recommendations.item: Ribs and boozy takeaway daiquiris
recommendations.reason: After missing out on tacos, James ate ribs there late at night that he'd make the side of his US tour dream menu.
recommendations.quote: if I was to make a dream menu of that tour that I had in America, they would be my dream side was these ribs.
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Banana pudding
recommendations.reason: James always gets the banana pudding in New York because of Sex and the City.
recommendations.quote: I go to Magnolia Bakery and get the banana pudding all the time
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

recommendations.item: Artisan chocolate (including Marmite chocolate and brownies)
recommendations.reason: Ed praises the chocolatier's amazing chocolate; James loved his Marmite brownie.
recommendations.quote: He makes amazing chocolate. You should absolutely seek him out
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 187: Lily Allen
episodes.summary: Lily Allen's chicken-heavy high-low menu: weak peach Robinson's barley water, poppadoms with all the dips, Dorian's chicken liver parfait soldiers, a Harrods food hall chicken tikka wrap, chicken and yoghurt with moong dal and pumpkin from Afghan Kitchen, The Ivy's cauliflower gratin, a Hendrick's G&T and McDonald's soft serve with chocolate sauce.

recommendations.item: Robinson's peach barley water squash, made weak (still, room temperature)
recommendations.reason: Still because bubbles upset her digestion; the peach barley squash is the only thing she'll drink to hydrate and she has it shipped to the US.
recommendations.quote: It's that Robinson's Barley Water squash with the peach flavouring in... So good.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney, onions, lime pickle and mint sauce on a mini lazy Susan
recommendations.reason: She prefers ordinary, non-posh poppadoms that disintegrate in your hand, with all the dips.
recommendations.quote: I'd prefer just like, you know, those ones that just disintegrate in your hand.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken liver parfait piped onto toast soldiers (amuse-bouche)
recommendations.reason: A restaurant she's been to whenever in London since it opened; the rich parfait on a soldier is a pre-starter.
recommendations.quote: they have these delicious chicken liver parfait... They put it onto a soldier.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken tikka wrap with pomegranate, coriander, onions and extra green chillies
recommendations.reason: Her post-gym treat from a counter in the food hall, made in front of her and eaten on the steps outside.
recommendations.quote: there's this little counter where they do chicken tikka wraps... they're absolutely delicious and they feel very naughty.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Chicken and yoghurt with rice, moong dal and pumpkin with yoghurt
recommendations.reason: Probably her favourite London restaurant; owner-chef Habib, who gave her bus money as a schoolgirl, still makes the same few dishes daily.
recommendations.quote: you'll eat and it will be one of your favourite places you've ever been and you'll think, 'Why the hell didn't I do this ten years ago?'
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Cauliflower gratin (cauliflower cheese)
recommendations.location: West Street, Covent Garden, London, UK
recommendations.reason: She loves cauliflower cheese in her weekly roasts, and orders The Ivy's breadcrumbed gratin when she's in theatreland.
recommendations.quote: I sometimes go to The Ivy... They have cauliflower gratin, which is cauliflower cheese, basically.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Hendrick's gin and tonic with a swirl of cucumber
recommendations.reason: As a recovering alcoholic she misses the taste most - thirst-quenching and classic with cucumber.
recommendations.quote: Hendricks gin and tonic with a bit of, like, a swirly bit of cucumber.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

recommendations.item: Soft-serve ice cream with hot chocolate fudge sauce
recommendations.reason: The one fast food she'll eat, usually on road trips; she likes its reliable consistency and simplicity after a heavy meal.
recommendations.quote: Soft-serve ice cream with the chocolate sauce.
recommendations.speaker: Lily Allen

episodes.title: Ep 190: Kiell Smith-Bynoe
episodes.summary: Kiell Smith-Bynoe orders still water with cucumber, Jamaican hard dough bread, P.F. Chang's dynamite shrimp, confit duck leg with dauphinoise and honey-roast veg, creamed spinach, a cherry vanilla Old Fashioned and an M&S Black Forest gateau on his birthday.

recommendations.item: Still water with cucumber slices
recommendations.reason: He thinks sparkling water is 'bullshit' after being ambushed by it at a Ghosts cast lunch; someone showing him cucumber in water changed his world.
recommendations.quote: Still. Sparkling's bullshit.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Jamaican hard dough bread with butter
recommendations.reason: Dense, slightly sweet, buttery-tasting bread from his childhood, great with butter, corned beef and hot pepper sauce or a Jamaican breakfast.
