recommendations.quote: Favourite bread is hard dough bread. Ever heard of hard dough bread? You've got to get into that man.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Dynamite shrimp in a big cocktail glass
recommendations.reason: Shrimp in a creamy, spicy, five-spice sauce he's tried and failed to recreate; he picks it over Busaba's calamari so as not to copy Edgar Wright.
recommendations.quote: They do a dynamite shrimp and it comes in a cocktail glass, a big cocktail glass
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Confit duck leg with dauphinoise potatoes, honey-roast carrots and parsnips
recommendations.reason: His rule is to order duck whenever it's on a menu; this plate combines all his favourite foods.
recommendations.quote: Duck and dauphinoise, I can't ignore that on a menu.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach
recommendations.reason: Normally he'd choose mac and cheese, but with cheesy dauphinoise that would be too much, and cheese late at night gives him nightmares.
recommendations.quote: I think I would go cream spinach because, usually, in any other scenario, my dream side will always be mac and cheese.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Cherry vanilla Old Fashioned
recommendations.reason: He loves sweet drinks and had this at a nice new bar in Wanstead that has since become a pizza place; he's never seen it anywhere else.
recommendations.quote: I really hope that somewhere will do them again because I've never seen a cherry vanilla old fashioned anywhere.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Tequila and apple juice ('The KSB')
recommendations.reason: A special mention for a sweet drink he claims as his own invention.
recommendations.quote: Tequila, apple juice, it's the one. London Hughes will say that she invented it, she's full of shit.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: M&S Black Forest gateau, on his birthday
recommendations.reason: Since about age 13 his mum made it his birthday tradition, and he couldn't wait for it every year.
recommendations.quote: My mum was like, 'This is his thing. One his birthday, it's an M&S black forest gateau,' and I could not wait for that.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Krispy Kreme doughnut burger with bacon, cheese and egg (his 'death row meal')
recommendations.reason: A former girlfriend made one for him on Valentine's Day; it's what he'd eat going out all guns blazing.
recommendations.quote: That's my death row meal.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Thai calamari
recommendations.reason: He calls it the best calamari out there, a view James shares.
recommendations.quote: I love calamari. I think the best calamari out there has got to be Busaba.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Confit duck with mash
recommendations.reason: One of the best restaurants he's ever been to, by the castle in Lisbon; the duck meal is in his top five ever.
recommendations.quote: It was Chapito A Mesa in Lisbon and it was in a castle.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Surf and turf (whole Mexican lobster and beef fillet)
recommendations.reason: The best surf and turf, lobster and steak he's ever had, though it cost $300.
recommendations.quote: surf and turf, that surf and turf I had in Taboo, in Cancun, wow.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Dinner and rum Old Fashioneds
recommendations.reason: Angela Hartnett's restaurant where he ate with the hosts; the food was great and the rum Old Fashioneds greater.
recommendations.quote: No, the food was great, and the rum old fashioneds greater.
recommendations.speaker: Kiell Smith-Bynoe

recommendations.item: Creamed spinach (lockdown delivery box)
recommendations.reason: Ed calls it the best steak restaurant, and its finely chopped, nutmeg-heavy creamed spinach phenomenal; James ate a whole box in one go.
recommendations.quote: they would put in the boxes, their creamed spinach, which you just warmed up in a pan, and it is phenomenal.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Pulled pork and nduja doughnut
recommendations.reason: A barbecue hatch in Hackney whose pulled pork doughnut with nduja and crackling is one of the best things Ed has ever tasted.
recommendations.quote: had their del pierro pulled pork doughnut, which is one of the best things I have ever tasted in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Thai prawn crackers
recommendations.reason: James was so excited by the prawn crackers there that he texted everyone he knew.
recommendations.quote: I was like, 'You've got to go to Tao Tao Ju, the crackers here are fucking off the chain, they're amazing.'
recommendations.speaker: James Acaster

episodes.title: Ep 193: Arlo Parks
episodes.summary: Arlo Parks picks a sunny LA-and-Mexico menu: sparkling water with lime, rosemary focaccia, burrata and tomato salad from Speranza, carnitas tacos from Guisados, elote, fresh orange juice and pumpkin pie from House of Pies.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water, no ice, with a wedge of lime to squeeze herself
recommendations.reason: She hated sparkling water for half her life, then woke up one day loving the little tingle; she wants to squeeze the lime herself.
recommendations.quote: I feel like I just like the little tingle it gives me.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Warm focaccia with rosemary, salt and black pepper
recommendations.reason: Her favourite bread, warm with rosemary and seasoning.
recommendations.quote: Warm with, like, a bit of rosemary on top, and, like, some-, Yes, some salt and black pepper.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Tomato and burrata salad with basil, black pepper and olive oil
recommendations.reason: She loves simple, comforting Italian food and Speranza's homemade pasta and Italian cooking.
recommendations.quote: There's a restaurant in LA called Speranza that is really really good Italian food, and I love that, and all the pasta's home made.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Slow-cooked carnitas tacos with guacamole, black beans, coriander and pico de gallo
recommendations.reason: A hole-in-the-wall taco spot with tortillas made fresh every morning; she eats there for lunch at the studio almost daily.
recommendations.quote: they make the tortillas fresh every morning and it's just, like, a nice little hole in the wall spot, my favourite one's the one at Echo Park
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Elote (Mexican street corn) on the cob
recommendations.reason: Corn with cheese, coriander, crema and butter, a little spicy.
recommendations.quote: They've got, like, coriander and they've got crema fresca and butter and it's just a nice little side
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Fresh orange juice
recommendations.reason: She just wants fresh orange juice, ideally in the sun.
recommendations.quote: My dream drink, I feel like I would just go for, like, fresh orange juice, that's it.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Pumpkin pie with vanilla ice cream
recommendations.reason: Open until 3am with around 55 pies; she has pie after nights out and even schedules deliveries for when she gets home.
recommendations.quote: There's this place called House of Pies where you can get pies till, like, 3:00am, that's after a night out
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

recommendations.item: Avocado baby rolls
recommendations.reason: Her go-to order, since she is allergic to fish; it was what she had on the day of recording.
recommendations.quote: I always have just the avocado baby rolls, because I can't have fish, I'm allergic.
recommendations.speaker: Arlo Parks

episodes.title: Ep 201: Angela Barnes
episodes.summary: Angela's menu is a salt-fat-sugar tour of Newfoundland, Edinburgh and Berlin: sparkling water, toutons, deep-fried haggis, Berlin calves' liver and cabbage, Ziggy Peelgood's poutine, a chilli margarita and school chocolate sponge with mint custard.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water
recommendations.reason: Loves the fizz as a dopamine hit and, with hearing aids, enjoys being able to hear it.
recommendations.quote: It's fizzy. It's joy. It gives you a little dopamine hit.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Toutons (fried bread dough with butter and molasses)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's family are Newfoundlanders and this hiking-trail cafe makes the best homemade toutons, fried and served with butter and black molasses.
recommendations.quote: they are the best homemade toutons. They are not worried about cholesterol in the Mad Rock Café.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Deep-fried haggis supper with salt and sauce
recommendations.reason: A late-night Edinburgh chippy-style place with a huge amount of haggis, cheap and, to her, beautiful; the same woman has worked there since 1995.
recommendations.quote: It's disgusting, and beautiful, and there's so much haggis in it.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Berliner Leber (calves' liver with apples and onions) with Grunkohl cabbage
recommendations.reason: Hot food from a cash-only stall at a Berlin Christmas market with gluhwein; slow-cooked, tender and warming.
recommendations.quote: in the right environment, it's the best taste. It's so warming, and Christmassy, and your cheeks are cold
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Deluxe poutine with dressing
recommendations.location: George Street, St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada
recommendations.reason: The late-night poutine truck on George Street, where she gets fries, cheese curds, gravy and sage-and-onion 'dressing' after the pub.
recommendations.quote: instead of getting a kebab or whatever, you go to the poutine truck. And it's called Ziggy Peelgood's.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Hot apple pie
recommendations.reason: Eaten in memory of comedian Phil Jerrod, who hated them and would rant about them.
recommendations.quote: If I'm eating a hot apple pie I can hear a Phil Jerrod rant in my head and I miss it.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Chilli margarita (husband's recipe, salt rim, no ice)
recommendations.reason: Beer now gives her hangovers, so 100% agave tequila margaritas made by her husband have taken over; the chilli one is his best.
recommendations.quote: his best is his chilli margarita.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Hot chocolate sponge with green mint custard
recommendations.reason: A school dinner pudding served in a plastic bowl; she says she has never had a chocolate sponge as good.
recommendations.quote: They were the best days at school.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

recommendations.item: Haggis pie
recommendations.reason: The pie shop across the road is her fallback when she crosses the road to avoid City Restaurant.
recommendations.quote: so I end up with a haggis pie instead.
recommendations.speaker: Angela Barnes

episodes.title: Ep 202: Jimi Famurewa
episodes.summary: Food critic Jimi picks sparkling water, Babur and BiBi poppadoms, a trio of slider sandwiches, his mum's Nigerian ewa riro, beef suya, Orangina and peanut milk, a many-sourced sundae and a custardo coffee.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with ice and lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels like a little treat and a bit of fun compared with tap water at home.
recommendations.quote: it feels like a treat, put you in that, kind of, mindset. That little bit of effervescence.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with mango chutney
recommendations.location: Forest Hill, South East London, UK
recommendations.reason: Legendary 30-year-old local Indian with great poppadoms and a proper chunky mango chutney.
recommendations.quote: there's one near me in South East London, Babur. ... absolutely legendary Indian restaurant, it's been going like over 30 years now and their poppadoms are great.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Cheese papad (giant Quavers)
recommendations.reason: Fancy high-end Indian whose cheese poppadoms are essentially giant Quavers.
recommendations.quote: BiBi in London which is, like, really good high end Indian and they do, like, these cheese poppadoms that are essentially giant Quavers.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Mackerel pide (slider-sized)
recommendations.reason: Pillowy Turkish bread, charred mackerel and dill mayo; he loved the scarcity of the pandemic takeaway version.
recommendations.quote: Amazing, pillowy Turkish bread, beautifully charred piece of mackerel. A dill mayo in there as well, outrageously good
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Dexter cheeseburger (slider-sized)
recommendations.reason: The greatest burger he has had: a nostalgic smash burger with crackly edges and Wimpy-like burger sauce.
recommendations.quote: The greatest burger I've ever had, I think. ... it's got, like, a wimpy quality to it. ... It's a smash burger so it's got the crackly edges
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Zinger Tower burger (mini)
recommendations.reason: Nostalgia for post-work KFC at Bluewater; he loves the odd wrongness of the hash brown and cheese.
recommendations.quote: There's something about the hash brown and the cheese. There's just this, sort of, wrongness to it that I just absolutely love.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Ewa riro (Nigerian stewed beans) with fried plantain
recommendations.reason: Comforting Yoruba stewed beans like his mum's, which he could never match himself.
recommendations.quote: I just don't think I could get even close to, like, my mum cooking them. ... it is such a good combo.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Beef suya
recommendations.reason: Addictively fiery barbecued beef in peanut yaji spice; this Peckham spot delivers nationally and gives an extra bag of spice.
recommendations.quote: there's a place that delivers nationally actually called Alhaji Suya which I would massively recommend. They're in Peckham
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Ice cold Orangina
recommendations.reason: Nostalgic childhood soft drink, brought by a beloved uncle.
recommendations.quote: just something about an ice cold Orangina.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Peanut milk
recommendations.reason: A pre-pudding drink that echoes the peanuts in the suya.
recommendations.quote: Really, really good. ... it's, kind of, a drink that's basically a, sort of, pre-pudding as well.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Toasted rice soft-serve gelato in sundae
recommendations.reason: Unbelievable toasted rice gelato from Brooks Headley's punk-spirited vegetarian burger place.
recommendations.quote: the toasted rice gelato from a place called Superiority Burger ... It was like rice crispy cereal milk but ... even better than that sounds.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Frosty in sundae
recommendations.reason: Childhood memory of visiting family in America and discovering Wendy's square burgers and the Frosty.
recommendations.quote: a Frosty which I was also fascinated that it wasn't-, there wasn't a flavour, it was just the Frosty
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Brown butter custard tart (crumbled over sundae)
recommendations.reason: Their brown butter custard tart gives crunch and flavour to the sundae.
recommendations.quote: maybe we'll crumble a bit of the Marksman's brown butter custard tart in there.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Malted ice cream sandwich (crumbled in sundae)
recommendations.reason: One of the most perfect puddings; he and his wife had to stop buying them.
recommendations.quote: genuinely one of the most perfect, kind of, puddings that you can get.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Custardo (espresso with frozen custard)
recommendations.reason: Espresso over house-made frozen custard, what an affogato should be, tasting like eggnog.
recommendations.quote: a custardo feels like what an affogato should be like it's amazingly creamy, sweet, rounded custard with this beautiful intense shot of coffee in it
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Fine-dining plantain and jollof
recommendations.reason: Two-Michelin-star West African influenced restaurant with jollof rice and an amazing plantain dish.
recommendations.quote: Ikoyi, which I mention in Settlers, they've got jollof rice on their menu and it's a two Michelin star restaurant now.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Suya-spiced bavette steak
recommendations.reason: Acclaimed restaurant by Joke Bakare with a bougie version of suya on bavette steak.
recommendations.quote: she does, like, really nice bavette steak with the spicing on top.
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

recommendations.item: Thai food
recommendations.reason: Pulse-pounding spicy Thai that Ed returned to the following week.
recommendations.quote: the one dish at Speedboat Bar ... It's the Chinese sausage and the mustard green salad. Oh, it's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

recommendations.item: Thai food
recommendations.location: Arcade Food Hall, Centre Point, London, UK
recommendations.reason: Intensely spicy Thai, served with pink milk shots to tame the heat.
recommendations.quote: Plaza Khao Gaeng, ... in Arcade below Centre Point ... they'd bring out little, sort of, ... shots of pink milk that are, kind of, meant to tame the spice
recommendations.speaker: Jimi Famurewa

episodes.title: Ep 203: Paul Foot
episodes.summary: Paul Foot's surreal menu: still water, poppadoms with every dip plus a cherry cola poppadom sauce, quail and flat champagne aspic, wagyu fillet, Dover sole sashimi from a Tokyo restaurant, twelve drinks and a shape-shifting fruit souffle.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Sparkling water makes him bloated, as he has never been able to burp.
recommendations.quote: the last thing I need is more bubbles inside me
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Poppadoms with all the dips and a cherry cola sauce
recommendations.reason: He loves poppadoms with mango chutney, lime pickle, raita and the chopped onion, and invents a cherry cola dip.
recommendations.quote: The little pickles and there's always one that no one likes. The onion... I like the chopped onion one.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Quail and flat champagne aspic soup
recommendations.reason: He likes soup because it gives the flavour with no chewing, and wants quail and champagne together in a jelly.
recommendations.quote: you get the flavour of what the soup is, but without having to actually eat whatever the thing is.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Wagyu fillet steak, rare, with poppadom sauce
recommendations.reason: He hates gristle and fat but loved tender wagyu he recently tried; fillet has none.
recommendations.quote: wagyu fillet steak and then not only do you have the tenderness of the wagyu, no gristle at all.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Dover sole sashimi
recommendations.reason: He remembers a three-Michelin-star yet unpretentious Tokyo restaurant, named after the grunt fish, where sole sashimi and a perfect carrot were among his best meals ever.
recommendations.quote: I had, like, some of the best food ever there. I had, like, a carrot and it was the best carrot I've ever tasted my whole life.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Pornstar Martini on arrival, then Pineau des Charentes, Campari and soda, sherry, Chardonnay, Riesling, red wines, Chartreuse, Chambord, milk
recommendations.reason: A twelve-drink tasting-menu pairing reflecting his love of sweet, bitter and sour flavours.
recommendations.quote: I like sweet. I like bitter. I like sour. I like umami.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

recommendations.item: Souffle that changes fruit flavour every mouthful
recommendations.reason: Inspired by exotic fruits he ate in Penang, with rambutan, lychee, passion fruit, dragon fruit, violet, rose, bubblegum and sour cherry.
recommendations.quote: So, each mouthful, it changes.
recommendations.speaker: Paul Foot

episodes.title: Ep 204: Carol Vorderman
episodes.summary: A Richard Whiteley-style long lunch: sparkling water with fresh lime juice, bread with Welsh butter, scallops and giant butterflied prawns instead of a main, tomatoes, mash and microwaved sprouts, Margaux and Bollinger, and a dry-ice afternoon tea of minis.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a jug of fresh lime juice
recommendations.reason: Her standard restaurant order: sparkling for a sense of occasion plus a splash of lime juice to liven up bland water.
recommendations.quote: Can I have a sparkling water please? And can I have a jug of fresh lime juice?
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Artisan bread with yellow Welsh butter and salt crystals
recommendations.reason: Chooses bread over poppadoms, with Welsh butter nodding to her farming family roots.
recommendations.quote: it would have, like, yellow Welsh butter with, like, salt crystals on it.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Three scallops in the shell with garlic butter and onions
recommendations.reason: Loves the 70s-style scallops with roe, served in the shell with garlic butter and onions, eaten slowly over an hour.
recommendations.quote: I like it, you know, in that very '70s way, when it's in the shell.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Big butterflied prawns with onions (second starter in place of a main)
recommendations.reason: She does not like main courses, so takes a second starter of giant prawns.
recommendations.quote: I am going for the big prawns, that they're, like, butterfly chopped.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Tomatoes and red onion; mashed potato and microwaved sprouts with butter
recommendations.reason: Sprouts are her favourite vegetable, microwaved in the bag and loaded with Welsh butter, salt and pepper.
recommendations.quote: I will often buy a bag of sprouts a day.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Chateau Margaux red wine, plus a bottle of Bollinger champagne
recommendations.reason: Tied to a memorable date in America with an astronaut; Bollinger is her champagne of choice.
recommendations.quote: We had a Margaux, and that was very expensive red wine. I remember that, and oh God, it was good.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Dry-ice afternoon tea tier of minis: Eton mess, trifle, lemon meringue, ice cream, Viennese whirl
recommendations.reason: Not a pudding person, so wants lots of little tastes presented with theatrical dry ice, as she has seen in Bristol.
recommendations.quote: Again, it's about the performance of the food.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Long lunches
recommendations.reason: She and Richard Whiteley held records for some of the longest lunches there.
recommendations.quote: we held the record... for quite a few of the longest lunches in various restaurants including The Wolseley.
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

recommendations.item: Post-theatre late night hangout
recommendations.reason: Theatre-crowd restaurant where they ended a long lunch and met Bianca Jagger.
recommendations.quote: all the actors after the theatre go down there
recommendations.speaker: Carol Vorderman

episodes.title: Ep 222: Nabil Abdulrashid
episodes.summary: Nabil's menu celebrates northern Nigerian (Hausa) food plus Indo-Malaysian roti canai: still water, roti canai with curry, mixed balangu/suya, miyan taushe, moi moi, zobo and shahi tukray.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: Distrusts sparkling water as regular water 'the Illuminati farted in'.
recommendations.quote: I can't drink sparkling because I believe it's regular water that the Illuminati farted in.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Roti canai with Indo-Malaysian curry
recommendations.reason: Fell in love with Indo-Malaysian food through a silat martial arts group; recommends Rasa Sayang in Chinatown for it. The roti canai is soft and pancake-like.
recommendations.quote: if you want to try good Indonesian, Indo-Malaysian food, Rasa Sayang, which is literally a straight line from Soho Theatre. It's in Chinatown. Amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Mixed balangu and suya (lamb, chicken, fish) with masa rice cakes
recommendations.reason: Northern Nigerian barbecue roasted for hours, served in newspaper with byadgi chilli powder and onions; he sends listeners to a Hausa-run place in Norbury.
recommendations.quote: there's a place called Baba Foundation in Norbury and he actually is a Hausa man like me ... especially when it comes to our BBQ stuff
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Miyan taushe (pumpkin and peanut butter stew) with ground rice
recommendations.reason: A distinctly northern Nigerian sweet, nutty, spicy stew that aunties send him when he visits home.
recommendations.quote: it's a sweet, nutty, spicy dish. It's amazing.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Moi moi (steamed bean cake)
recommendations.reason: Steamed ground-bean cake, high in protein, with a boiled egg inside; also related to akara and Brazilian acaraje.
recommendations.quote: you get beans ground into a paste, and you can get put in like a boiled egg in there ... and steam it
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Zobo (hibiscus drink)
recommendations.reason: Chilled hibiscus drink with ginger, cloves and cinnamon that he says is one of the best things he has tasted; he is teetotal.
recommendations.quote: that drink is probably one of the best things I have ever tasted in my life.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Shahi tukray (bread pudding)
recommendations.reason: His wife's auntie's Pakistani-style bread pudding with cinnamon and rose petals; chosen partly to represent his wife's culture.
recommendations.quote: Sweet, cinnamony, bready.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Nigerian Chapman drink
recommendations.reason: Says it is the only restaurant outside Nigeria making a proper Chapman and he suspects magic is involved.
recommendations.quote: only one restaurant anywhere outside of Nigeria makes it and it's called Enish.
recommendations.speaker: Nabil Abdulrashid

recommendations.item: Indo-Malaysian food
recommendations.quote: Or Uncle Lim's in Croydon.
recommendations.speaker: Ed Gamble

episodes.title: Ep 224: CMAT
episodes.summary: CMAT's butter-heavy, French-leaning dream menu: still water, baguette with a flight of Bordier butter, fried artichoke and broccolini, salmon risotto from a Paris bistro, butter beans, Chablis and Cool Swan, and Nigella's Christmas bread and butter pudding.

recommendations.item: Still water
recommendations.reason: She dislikes fizzy water, which she says feels wrong in the mouth unless it has lemon in it.
recommendations.quote: Still. I'm not a psychopath. I want still water with my meal.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: French baguette with a flight of Bordier butter
recommendations.reason: She is obsessed with a video of Monsieur Bordier crying over his hand-made butter and has never managed to find it in Paris. She wants a plank with seaweed, chilli, salted and unsalted butters.
recommendations.quote: I think because this is my dream and I haven't had it yet, I'm going with the Bordier butter.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Parmesan-battered deep-fried artichoke and broccolini
recommendations.reason: She had the battered, parmesan-dusted fried artichoke here in summer and loves a 'filthy vegetable'. The transcript spells it 'Lena Stores'.
recommendations.quote: I think something that's very important to me in this life is a filthy vegetable.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Deep-fried parmesan-battered broccoli and broccolini
recommendations.reason: A Brighton restaurant near where she lives doing a similar fried, powdered-parmesan broccolini that she finds unbelievably good. Spelling is from the transcript.
recommendations.quote: it's genuinely unbelievably good.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Risotto with poached salmon and mussels
recommendations.reason: The best main she ate that year: a chorizo-stock risotto finished with double cream, mussels and perfectly poached salmon with crispy skin, on a roughly 30-euro set menu found via the Michelin Guide app.
recommendations.quote: it was absolutely the best main course I've had this year, it was unbelievably good.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Butter beans stewed in stock with vegetables
recommendations.reason: Served as a side to a mutton chop, the beans were arguably nicer than the chop. She also loved a home-cooked butter bean stew at a friend's mum's house in York.
recommendations.quote: the beans were arguably nicer than the chop.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Chablis (with food), Kylie Minogue Provence rose, and Cool Swan over ice with dessert
recommendations.reason: A dry white goes with fish and veg, and she adores Cool Swan, a white chocolate Irish cream liqueur from County Waterford.
recommendations.quote: I love wine within the context of food.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Nigella Lawson's Christmas bread and butter pudding with hot custard
recommendations.reason: She made it the week before, with mincemeat sandwiches layered in, and called it the best dessert of the year.
recommendations.quote: it is, like, the nicest dessert I've had all year.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Pint of Guinness
recommendations.reason: Her local, which she says pours the best pint of Guinness she has ever had.
recommendations.quote: I've never had a better pint than in Brady's.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Grasmere gingerbread
recommendations.reason: She bought boxes to calm the band and crew during rehearsals and calls it the nicest thing she has eaten.
recommendations.quote: the nicest shit I've ever had in my life.
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

recommendations.item: Challah with cinnamon raisin butter
recommendations.reason: A Jewish-Japanese restaurant serving mini challah with a sweet-savoury cinnamon raisin butter that blew her away, plus ramen with a matzo ball.
recommendations.quote: It was fucking great, would recommend
recommendations.speaker: CMAT

episodes.title: Ep 225: Susan Wokoma (Live in Bristol)
episodes.summary: Live Bristol show: sparkling water with lemon, warm bread with soft butter, unlimited rock oysters, truffle pasta from Paoli in Florence, her mum's okra soup, crackers with cheddar and ketchup, a tequila and pineapple Craig David, and a McFlurry with McDonald's chips.

recommendations.item: Sparkling water with a slice of lemon
recommendations.reason: Sparkling feels posh and worth paying for, with a decorative lemon slice.
recommendations.quote: It's like sexy water. I was like, 'I will part with money for that.'
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Warm soft bread with creamy melted butter, including fruit bread in a mixed basket
recommendations.reason: Loves a varied bread basket in a fancy place, with raisin bread among the selection and no sourdough or seeded loaves.
recommendations.quote: Warm, soft bread. We don't want anything too hard, and also, you need really, like, creamy, almost melted butter on it.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Unlimited rock oysters with Tabasco, a little vinegar and lemon
recommendations.reason: Big meaty oysters, as many as she wants without sharing politely, served on a ruler.
recommendations.quote: my dream starter would be oysters, but as many as I f-ing want.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Truffle spaghetti flamed in front of you
recommendations.reason: A friend took her here and the cheesy truffle pasta cooked with fire at the table was so good she cried and ordered three plates.
recommendations.quote: it was so good, I actually cried... I ordered three plates, and it was truffle pasta
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Okra soup (draw soup)
recommendations.reason: Her mum's Nigerian okra soup, stringy, spicy and grassy, made through her childhood; she likes it made by other people.
recommendations.quote: my mum was just King of making that all throughout my childhood
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: Jacob's crackers with cheddar and ketchup
recommendations.reason: The only thing she kept from a bad ex: a cracker, cheese and ketchup sandwich she found gorgeous.
recommendations.quote: Jacob's crackers, slice of cheddar, just a couple of slices, ketchup, bish bosh, put in your mouth, gorgeous.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: A Craig David (tequila shot with pineapple juice chaser)
recommendations.reason: A drink she learned on her New Year's Eve birthday; she loves tequila and pineapple juice.
recommendations.quote: a Craig David is a shot of tequila, and then you have a chaser of orange, not orange juice, geez, no... pineapple juice.
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma

recommendations.item: McFlurry (Crunchie) dipped with McDonald's chips
recommendations.reason: A stranger dropped chips into her and her sister's McFlurries as a teenager and the sweet-salty combo was delicious.
recommendations.quote: we ate it, and it was the most delicious thing I've ever tasted
recommendations.speaker: Susan Wokoma
